title: AI Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Germany.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

  • A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.

  • A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.

  • Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.

  • Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.

  • Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.

  • Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.

  • Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.

  • Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents.

title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

The team you'll join:
AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

What You'll Work On

Help build the future of how companies manage equity.

  • Ledgy Agent. You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.
  • Ledgy MCP. Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.
  • Measuring and improving the agent. You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.
  • Scaling. The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.

You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end
  • You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.
  • You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.
  • You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.
  • You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.
  • You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.

Our Tech Stack

We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.

You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First day: Get the app running locally and make your first commit. Your onboarding buddy helps you get there.

First week:

  • Meet the engineers, product managers, and designers you'll work with.
  • Learn the agent end to end: its tools, skills, MCP surface, and how we evaluate it.
  • Ship a few smaller features.

First month:

  • Meet the wider engineering team and learn how Ledgy works and how customers use it today. This is the background you'll use for decisions later.
  • Make larger contributions and take a bigger part in code reviews.

First 3 months:

  • Drive part of a larger piece of work, such as process, tooling, a new product, or new functionality.
  • Work with Product and Design to prove and deepen the value AI adds to the product.
  • Take part in architecture and long-term decisions.

After the first 3 months:

  • Take a bigger role in shaping where the team is heading. Own key parts of our AI platform and decide where we can add the most value for customers.
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar. Help teams across Ledgy add AI to what they build, whether that means advising, reviewing, or working alongside them.
  • Help shape Ledgy's technical direction, for AI and for everything else we build.

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • Behavioural (45 min): Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

title: Applied AI Developer - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our Applied AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows

  • Modern AI-native development workflow

  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

    • Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

    • Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

title: Arzt in der Unternehmensberatung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
• Du möchtest die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mitgestalten und innovative Lösungen vorantreiben?

  • Interessierst Du Dich für eine Position, die interprofessionelle Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht und Dir ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld bietet?

  • Und zudem ist Dir ein herzliches und wertschätzendes Miteinander im Team wichtig?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Bei der LOHFERT & LOHFERT AG setzen wir uns für ein modernes und nachhaltiges Klinikmanagement ein – effizient, qualitätssichernd und patientenorientiert. Wir optimieren medizinische Prozesse, entwickeln wegweisende Konzepte und stehen mit über 4.000 erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Projekten für ein wirtschaftliches und qualitätsgesichertes Klinikmanagement. Wir beraten Krankenhäuser ganzheitlich – von der wirtschaftlichen Planung, über die medizinische Strategie und Betriebsorganisation bis hin zur Digitalisierung. Konkret gehören dazu unter anderem die Begleitung von Sanierung- und Restrukturierungsmaßnahmen, Refinanzierungsrechnung und Unternehmensplanung sowie der Einkauf und das Management des medizinischen Sachbedarfs. Darüber hinaus verbessern wir klinische Prozesse und entwickeln strategische Standort- und Leistungsplanungen vor dem Hintergrund von Qualitätsanforderungen. Auch bei Bau- und Masterplanungen stehen wir unseren Kund:innen zur Seite, indem wir zukunftsfähige Betriebsorganisationsplanungen und leistungsadaptierte Raum- und Funktionsprogramme erstellen. Im Bereich Digitalisierung begleiten wir die Umsetzung von IT-Projekten, sowie die Entwicklung von IT-Architekturen und digitalen Strategien. Wir entwickeln eigene digitale Tools, die wir sowohl bei unseren Kund:innen als auch intern einsetzen. Damit können wir unsere fundierten Analysen bestmöglich darstellen und in Umsetzungsprozesse integrieren.

Unser Team umfasst ca. 60 Mitarbeitende und wir legen sehr viel Wert auf gegenseitige Wertschätzung, Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe und ein gutes Teamgefühl. Bei uns zählt jeder Einzelne – deshalb fördern wir eine offene und respektvolle Atmosphäre, in welcher Ideen geteilt, Erfolge gefeiert und Herausforderungen gemeinsam gemeistert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Medizinischer Sachbedarf mit strategischem Blick: Mit Deiner klinischen Erfahrung bist Du ein wichtiger Sparringspartner für unsere Kund:innen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team analysierst Du Kostenstrukturen im medizinischen Sachbedarf, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst praxisnahe Ansätze, um Wirtschaftlichkeit und Versorgungsqualität sinnvoll miteinander zu verbinden.

  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: In Projekten bist Du bei Bedarf vor Ort bei unseren Kund:innen im Einsatz und begleitest unter anderem Chefärzt:innenrunden zu sachbedarfsbezogenen Fragestellungen. Dabei präsentierst Du Analyseergebnisse, ordnest wirtschaftliche Potenziale medizinisch ein und bringst Deine klinische Perspektive in tragfähige Lösungen ein.

  • Den Markt im Blick: Du erhältst einen umfassenden Einblick in den medizinischen Sachbedarf – von Medizintechnik und Marktmechanismen bis hin zu Vergütungssystemen und aktuellen Entwicklungen im Gesundheitswesen

  • Vielfältige Projekte und Entwicklung in der Beratung: Auch mit Schwerpunkt auf medizinischem Sachbedarf bleiben unsere Projekte abwechslungsreich und interdisziplinär. Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu medizinischen Prozessen, Organisationsfragen und wirtschaftlichen Steuerungsthemen und übernimmst nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung zunehmend Verantwortung im Projekt.

Qualifikation

  • Hard Facts: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Medizinstudium und hast durch Deine mindestens zweijährige Klinikerfahrung ein gutes Verständnis für interne Prozesse

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du kannst Dich in unterschiedliche Themen zügig und detailliert einarbeiten

  • Office-Skills: Du hast einen souveränen Umgang mit dem Microsoft Office-Paket

  • Kundenorientiert mit Teamspirit: In Deinem Projektteam überzeugst Du durch kundenorientiertes und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten – im Sinne des Teams

  • Wir müssen es nicht betonen, aber wir erwähnen es: Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft sind Voraussetzungen

  • Und noch ein wichtiger Punkt als Info: Deine Einzahlungen ins Versorgungswerk können weiterhin erfolgen, und Dein Facharztstatus bleibt auch ohne das Sammeln von CME-Punkten erhalten.

Benefits

  • Flache Hierarchien:Das sagen wir nicht nur, sondern leben es auch - denn jeder Mitarbeitende ist wertvoll und nur als Team können wir wachsen

  • Flexibilität:Unsere Kernarbeitszeiten liegen zwischen 9:00 und 15:00 Uhr – darüber hinaus kannst Du Deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Nach erfolgreichem Onboarding reist Du - je nach Projekt und Einsatzfokus – 4-10 Tage im Monat

  • Sicherheit: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag ist eine Selbstverständlichkeit für uns

  • Urlaub: Und zwar 28 Tage sowie bis zu vier Ausgleichstage für Überstunden

  • Weiterentwicklung: Damit Du Deine Karrieremöglichkeiten optimal ausschöpfen kannst, haben wir ein internes Stufenmodell und halbjährige Entwicklungsgespräche. Zudem hast Du die Möglichkeit, Dich auch inhaltlich in den verschiedenen Projektteams weiterzuentwickeln

  • Weiterbildung: Wir bieten regelmäßige interne und externe Schulungen zu spannenden und für Dein Tätigkeitsfeld relevanten Themen an

  • Hemdenservice: Im Zuge Deiner Reisetätigkeit lassen wir gerne Deine Hemden reinigen

  • Sportlicher Zuschuss:Wir möchten Dich auch sportlich unterstützen, daher bezuschussen wir Deine Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM Wellpass

  • Corporate Benefits:Wir bieten Dir verschiedene Mitarbeiterrabatte bei namenhaften Unternehmen

title: Assistant Director, Regulatory Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. Today, we manage more than £2.5 billion for a broad range of investors across five key investment strategies: Private Credit, Social Housing, Clean Heat, Energy and Venture. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients. 

There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Places to Work  2025 & 2026'.

If this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on…

The Function & Team

The Compliance team is part of the 2nd line of defence who has responsibility and oversight of the Governance, Risk & Compliance functions within TriplePoint.  The Team is integral to the company's success, ensuring that all business operations adhere to the stringent regulations set by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

Joining the Triple Point Compliance Team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions directly impact the company's operations and overall success.

The team works closely with various departments to ensure that all business activities comply with regulatory requirements, thereby enabling the company to operate smoothly and efficiently. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on the company's growth and to develop professionally within a respected and forward-thinking organisation.

By joining the Compliance team within the GRC function, you will become part of a collaborative and professional team that plays an essential role in supporting the firm’s success. Your contributions will directly influence how the business meets its regulatory obligations, while providing you with broad exposure to the firm’s products, investments and operations. This is an opportunity to strengthen Triple Point’s compliance environment and to play a meaningful role in sustaining the company’s long-term resilience and reputation.  The role reports to theDirector, Regulatory Compliance.

Key Responsibilities

The Assistant Director, Regulatory Compliance will work alongside the Director, Regulatory Compliance as a deputy of a small, focused compliance department, providing technical support and leadership to the team, operating in a dynamic and fast-moving organisation.

The role has two core purposes: to provide strong technical regulatory expertise and practical, commercial advice to the business; and to support the growth of the Compliance team by developing the technical knowledge, skills and confidence of its members. The successful candidate will deputise for the Director, Regulatory Compliance when required.

The candidate will have extensive relevant compliance experience within the investment management or wider financial services sector, and a track record of providing proactive, commercial and value-adding regulatory advice in collaboration with Risk and Legal colleagues.

Compliance Framework and Advisory

  • Support the Director, Regulatory Compliance in developing and maintaining the Group’s Compliance framework, contributing technical and operational insight on best-practice frameworks and monitoring.
  • Provide day-to-day regulatory advice to the business, including at the early stage of initiatives, taking into account products and services, target markets and distribution strategy in support of Triple Point’s growth objectives.
  • Support the review and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures and guidance, ensuring they remain current and fit for purpose.
  • Support the firm’s engagement with regulators, including the preparation of responses to regulatory queries and requests.

Monitoring, Regulatory Change and Reporting

  • Oversee delivery of the compliance monitoring programme, including planning, performing and reporting on reviews, and tracking agreed actions to completion.
  • Monitor regulatory developments, assess their impact and support the business in implementing regulatory change.
  • Assist in the preparation of regular compliance reporting, e.g. the Annual Compliance Officer’s Report, Annual Consumer Duty Report.
  • Contribute to compliance MI and risk data analytics that feed into the Risk & Controls Committee and other governance forums.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting and escalation of issues to the Director, Regulatory Compliance and Senior Management.

Team Development and Technical Capability

  • Act as a technical point of reference for the Compliance team, helping colleagues to build their regulatory knowledge and judgement.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance to Compliance team members on a dotted-line basis, including coaching and quality-reviewing their work, and support the Director, Regulatory Compliance in their professional development and growth.
  • Identify technical skills gaps within the team and help design and deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Help design and deliver compliance training to the wider business.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to embed a strong compliance culture across all business units within the Group.

New products, product life-cycle and financial promotion

  • Assist the business in developing new products including by ensuring adequacy of permission in the context of new solutions.
  • Support the business in the various aspects of existing products’ life-cycle.
  • Oversee the delivery of the firm financial promotion requirements across the firm’s multiple channels, seeking continued efficiency and consistency.

The successful candidate:

  • Will exhibit strong technical and relationship management skills, building trust with colleagues, senior stakeholders and advisers;
  • Should have a curious mindset, be commercial, tenacious and a lateral thinker, who can help develop suitable compliance practices that protect our investors, the business and wider stakeholders;
  • Should have experience of coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to compliance professionals.

Experience

Essential

  • Extensive compliance experience within investment management or the wider financial services sector.
  • Solid technical knowledge of the FCA Handbook, relevant regulatory and/or product framework, including AIFMD and MiFID, and their practical application in a retail context.
  • Experience of delivering compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting and advisory activity.
  • A good understanding of alternative asset classes and financial service compliance, with commercial awareness in problem solving.
  • Strong organisational and communication skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred

  • Experience of coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to compliance colleagues, including in a matrix or dotted-line arrangement.
  • Knowledge of Consumer Duty, financial promotions including in the Restricted and Non-Mass Market Space, SM&CR, FCA’s rules and expectations in the context of retail distribution of products such as AIFs, UCIS, tax-advantaged investments, and services such as discretionary management.
  • Experience of supporting regulatory permission applications or direct engagement with the FCA.
  • A relevant professional qualification (e.g. ICA or CISI) or working towards one.
  • Familiarity with AI tools

Personal Qualities

  • Proactive and self-motivated.
  • Able to see the bigger picture while managing the detail.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt to change and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence others.
  • Generous with knowledge and committed to developing others.
  • High level of professionalism and ethical conduct.
  • Strong commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Why Join us?

  • You’ll join a talented, collaborative team in a connected environment where ideas and initiative are valued.
  • Be part of a growing and innovative team
  • We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and genuine opportunities for growth and progression.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

At Triple Point, high performance means living our values every day:

·       Stay Curious.

·       Be Generous.

·       Take Thoughtful Action.

·       Pull Together.

·       Own It.

In line with our values Stay Curious and Take Thoughtful Action every employee has access to AI tools. We see technology as a co-pilot, helping us improve efficiency and insight while keeping decisions grounded in thoughtful human judgement.

Triple Point offers a wealth of benefits including a contributory pension, hybrid/flexible working and ongoing learning and development opportunities. Check out our comprehensive list of benefits HERE. 

Apply today for further information!

Triple Point is dedicated to providing fair and equal opportunities for all individuals, including both current and potential employees. Discrimination of any kind based on factors such as age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, or marital status is not tolerated by the company.

Our aim is to create a welcoming and diverse work environment where people from all walks of life feel valued and supported. We actively encourage individuals from various backgrounds to apply for job vacancies and become part of our team. 

STRICTLY NO AGENCIES

  • Contribute to watchlist and early warning indicator processes, flagging deteriorating credits for further action.
  • Contribute case-level input to Lessons Learnt processes, covering challenged cases, watchlist trends and emerging risk themes.

Credit Underwriting Support & Origination Partnership

  • Partner with origination teams to evaluate new lending opportunities, providingcredit expertise and challenge at the appropriate stage.
  • Review credit papers ahead of submission from time to time, providing a clear recommendation to Credit Committee members.
  • Build strong working relationships with origination and portfolio management teams to ensure credit input is embedded early and effectively.

Portfolio Reporting & Advisory

  • Prepare and present internal reporting materials on portfolio health, performance and emerging trends for senior stakeholders.
  • Provide ad-hoc credit advisory support to portfolio management teams on existing positions as needed.
  • Contribute portfolio-level insight and findings into wider Credit & Risk reporting.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and help implement improvements to credit processes, frameworks and monitoring tools.
  • Drive efficiency through automation, reporting improvements and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Contribute to ad-hoc credit projects and process initiatives where required.

Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience in credit risk, credit analysis or portfolio management within a lending, private credit, or credit advisory environment.
  • Strong financial analysis and credit assessment skills, with the ability to review and challenge credit papers and identify key risks.
  • Experience with portfolio monitoring or review processes, including identifying early signs of credit deterioration.
  • Comfortable exercising judgement and holding delegated authority for credit decisions within defined parameters.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear reporting materials and provide credit recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Educated to degree level.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, build effective relationships across teams, and constructively challenge origination and portfolio management colleagues.

Desirable

  • Specific experience in private credit, alternative lending or direct lending (as opposed to traditional bank lending).
  • Exposure to mid-market/SME lending; familiarity with wholesale lending structures.
  • Experience with watchlist frameworks, early warning indicators, or provisioning/impairment processes.
  • Experience designing or improving credit risk frameworks, monitoring tools or reporting processes.
  • Experience using or implementing AI-enabled tools in a credit or risk context.
  • Familiarity with credit documentation and risk rating tools is advantageous.

Personal Qualities: 

  • Analytical and detail-oriented, with sound judgement when reviewing credit papers and portfolio data.
  • Confident exercising independent judgement within delegated authority, and clear about when to escalate.
  • A constructive challenger, able to provide credit input and push back on origination or portfolio management colleagues diplomatically but firmly.
  • Collaborative, building strong working relationships across origination, portfolio management and Credit & Risk.
  • Clear communicator, able to distil portfolio trends and risk into reporting that's useful to senior stakeholders.
  • Organised, with the ability to manage multiple portfolio reviews and reporting deadlines concurrently.
  • Curious and proactive, with a genuine interest in improving credit processes rather than just following them.
  • Comfortable with change, particularly given this role is expected to grow in scope and ownership over time.

Why Join us?

In line with our values Stay Curious and Take Thoughtful Action every employee has access to AI tools. We see technology as a co-pilot, helping us improve efficiency and insight while keeping decisions grounded in thoughtful human judgement.

title: Associate Venture Development – Commercial Product Energy (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:

title: Ausbildungsplatz zum Fachinformatiker – Systemintegration (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Stellenbeschreibung

Internet? Kann ich.

Zukunft? Kann ich.
Ausbildung? Kann ich.

Wir sind ropa – ein Internet Service Provider (ISP) aus Schwäbisch Gmünd. Seit über 25 Jahren beschäftigen wir uns mit Telekommunikation, leistungsfähigen Netzwerken und digitaler Infrastruktur.

Du nutzt täglich das Internet – aber weißt Du auch, was dahintersteckt?
Bei uns lernst Du die Technik kennen, die hinter einer zuverlässigen Internetverbindung steckt. Als ISP sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen und Unternehmen zuverlässig online sind und Du kannst ein Teil davon werden. Und das Beste: Du bist von Anfang an mittendrin!
Von der Netzwerkinfrastruktur und -technik über die Administration von IT-Systemen bis hin zur Analyse komplexer technischer Störungen.
Learning by Doing – so funktioniert Ausbildung bei ropa.
Statt nur zuzuschauen, arbeitest Du an echten Aufgaben mit, bringst Deine Ideen ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

  • Netzwerktechnik: Routing und Switching? Verstehe, wie Netzwerke funktionieren und Daten ihr Ziel erreichen.
  • ISP-Infrastruktur: Lerne den Aufbau der technischen Infrastruktur kennen und welche Komponenten für einen zuverlässigen Netzbetrieb notwendig sind.

Unser Mandant ist ein innovatives Schweizer Technologieunternehmen, das sich mit leistungsstarken SaaS-Plattformen für Corporate Reporting und Corporate Publishing im DACHLI-Raum eine führende Marktposition erarbeitet hat.

Die bewährten Cloud-Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen, ihre regelmäßigen Finanz-, ESG- und Unternehmensberichte nicht nur zu digitalisieren, sondern in einem durchgängig automatisierten, hochgradig kollaborativen Prozess gemeinsam zu erstellen – von der ersten Datensammlung bis zum finalen PDF, Printprodukt oder Online-Report.

Die Lösungen unseres Mandanten zählen heute zu den führenden SaaS-Produkten im Corporate-Reporting-Umfeld. Sie werden von zahlreichen bekannten Unternehmen aus dem Konzern-Umfeld und Mittelstand sowie von Organisationen genutzt.

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. The Role

We're looking for motivated and tech-savvy Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with a strong interest in AI to join our growing sales team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in building a healthy pipeline for our Account Executives by qualifying inbound leads and proactively prospecting into high-value target accounts. This is an opportunity to be at the frontlines of a fast-moving AI company, engaging in thoughtful, technical conversations with a knowledgeable customer base.

The ideal candidate is results driven, exhibits strong intellectual curiosity of the evolving AI space, and can operate in a fast-paced, highly-dynamic start up environment. You should be comfortable initiating outreach, handling nuanced product discussions, and helping prospects understand the impact of generative AI on their business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategically prospect into key accounts across email, calling and Linkedin, communicating Fireworks AI’s unique value proposition

  • Consistently meet new business opportunity and pipeline generation targets

  • Craft personalized, tailored outreach through various research methods to prioritize the right accounts and prospects

  • Qualify and engage inbound leads, ensuring a smooth transition to our Account Executive team

  • Act as a brand ambassador, educating prospects on the power and potential of our inference solutions

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies based on market feedback

  • Stay current on AI/ML trends to conduct informed, relevant conversations with technical and business audiences

Minimum Qualifications

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to engage confidently with technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field

  • Active interest in AI/tech communities with a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning in the space

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

title: Care Expert – Medizincontrolling & Pflegedokumentation Krankenhaus (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB.

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich.

💡 DEINE MISSION

Im Krankenhaus dokumentieren Pflegekräfte mit voize direkt am Bett. Die freigegebenen Einträge landen strukturiert im KIS, über unsere Integration mit ORBIS U von Dedalus. Damit ist Pflegedokumentation nicht nur Grundlage guter Pflege, sondern auch Grundlage für Kodierung, Abrechnung und MD-Prüfungen. Abgerechnet werden kann nur, was belegt ist.

Genau hier brauchen wir deinen Blick aus dem Medizincontrolling. Als Care Expert berätst du Kliniken, wie ihre Pflegedokumentation aufgebaut sein muss, damit erbrachte Leistungen vollständig und prüfsicher in der Akte stehen. Mit den strengeren MD-Prüfquoten ab 2027 wird das für viele Häuser zur wirtschaftlichen Frage. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Medizincontrolling, Pflegedirektion, Stationsleitungen und Klinik-IT. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Pflegekräfte Zeit gewinnen und die Dokumentation zugleich den Anforderungen von Kodierung und Prüfung standhält.

🚀 DEIN ALLTAG

  • Dokumentation verstehen, bevor es zählt: Vor dem Go-live analysierst du mit Medizincontrolling, Pflege und Klinik-IT, wie die Pflegedokumentation im KIS aufgebaut ist, von Assessments wie ePA-AC und Barthel über LEP-Maßnahmen bis zu Vitalwerten, Bilanzierung und Wunddokumentation.

  • Die Erlös- und Prüfperspektive einbringen: Du zeigst, welche pflegerischen Inhalte für die Rechtfertigung der Verweildauer, Nebendiagnosen, Komplexbehandlungen wie die geriatrische frührehabilitative Komplexbehandlung und die MD-Prüfung relevant sind, und wo heute Informationen auf dem Weg in die Akte verloren gehen.

  • Zwischen Pflege, Medizincontrolling und System übersetzen: Anforderungen aus Kodierrichtlinien und Prüfverfahren machst du für Pflegeteams greifbar, und Pflegealltag für das Medizincontrolling.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Gemeinsam mit den Kliniken legst du fest, woran sich Dokumentationsqualität messen lässt, und unterstützt bei ROI-Workshops mit Geschäftsführung und Medizincontrolling.

  • Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der KIS-Konfiguration, am Prozess auf Station oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product, und du bringst die Sicht des Medizincontrollings in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Krankenhaus-Produkts ein.

  • Kliniken begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager.

  • Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten und interne Enablements für den Krankenhausbereich, etwa zu DRG-Grundlagen und MD-Prüfungen für unsere Kolleg:innen.

🤝 DEIN PROFIL

  • Du hast mindestens eine Weiterbildung zur Medizinischen Kodierfachkraft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und Praxis im Medizincontrolling eines Krankenhauses. Erfahrung als Medizincontroller:in ist ein großes Plus.

  • Du bist sicher im aG-DRG-System, in ICD-10-GM, OPS und den Deutschen Kodierrichtlinien und kennst die Abläufe rund um MD-Prüfungen und die Prüfverfahrensvereinbarung aus eigener Fallbearbeitung.

  • Idealerweise bringst du einen pflegerischen Grundberuf mit, etwa in der Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege, und weißt, wie Dokumentation auf Station wirklich entsteht.

  • Du hast mit einem KIS gearbeitet, am liebsten mit ORBIS von Dedalus. Pflegerische Assessments und Leistungserfassung wie ePA-AC oder LEP sind dir vertraut oder du arbeitest dich schnell ein.

  • Systeme sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Du denkst in Abhängigkeiten und Ursachen und bleibst dran, bis du verstehst, warum etwas so ist.

  • Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, einer Pflegedirektion genauso wie einer Pflegekraft im Spätdienst oder der Geschäftsführung einer Klinik.

  • Du arbeitest gern beratend und strukturiert. Du gibst klare Empfehlungen und vertrittst sie auch.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Auf Englisch solltest du dich sicher verständigen können, weil ein Teil der internen Zusammenarbeit auf Englisch läuft.

  • Du bist gern bei unseren Kunden. Termine vor Ort gehören regelmäßig dazu, der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft remote.

🌱 GEMEINSAM WACHSEN – DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI voize

  • Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Startup. Du übernimmst neue Themen, wächst schnell und bewirkst etwas, das Pflegekräften mehr Zeit für die Menschen gibt.

  • Du gestaltest mit: Unser Krankenhausbereich wächst gerade, und du prägst, wie wir Kliniken fachlich begleiten.

✨ LUST AUF EIN GESPRÄCH? JETZT BEWERBEN.

title: Care Operations Strategist - End-of-studies internship (1,8K€/month)
descriptionHtml:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents for healthcare providers: they answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and handle confirmations and reminders, so medical teams can focus on care. Following our $25M Series A, we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York, working with around 240 healthcare organizations (imaging, ophthalmology, dental and more) across 700+ sites.

Our users are medical secretaries, center directors and practitioners. When something blocks them, they need a clear answer, fast. Support volume grew 5x in 12 months, and we are building a Customer Experience team that keeps up: faster answers, clients who are autonomous from day one, and processes that scale.

You join the CX team, within Operations, as Care Ops Intern, reporting to Sylvain, our CX Manager.

Your mission

Be the first point of contact for our users and make sure every request gets a fast, clear answer. Then make the next request unnecessary: turn recurring questions into guides, videos and Help Center content that make clients autonomous.

Expected outcomes

After 1 month:

  • You know the full client journey, from deployment to support, and who to call on for each topic

  • You handle level-1 Intercom tickets on your own, with growing complexity

  • You own a first recurring mission end to end (e.g. monitoring bot alerts)

After 3 months:

  • You handle complex tickets on your own and escalate bugs with a clear diagnosis

  • You have audited our training content (Vocca Académie) and shipped the first missing guides and videos

  • You bring recurring issues and product signals to Product and Tech every week

At the end of your internship (6 months):

  • A self-serve Help Center live, covering the most frequent requests

  • Onboarding content in use for the secretaries of new clients

  • Key CX processes documented (bug reports, escalations) and handed over cleanly

What you'll own

Customer support (70% of your time)

  • Handle incoming Intercom tickets quickly and clearly

  • Diagnose issues (configuration, Doctolib, bugs) and escalate to the right people

  • Write professional, accessible answers for a non-technical audience

  • Spot recurring patterns and bring weak product signals back to the team

Customer experience resources (20%)

  • Create and maintain clear user guides (Notion, PDF)

  • Produce onboarding videos: scripting, and light editing with AI tools

  • Build a self-serve Help Center that reduces support volume

  • Improve the activation journey of new clients, starting with secretary training

Process and scale (10%)

  • Document existing processes (bug reports, escalations)

  • Identify friction and propose concrete improvements

  • Work across the Product, Ops and Tech teams

This role is for you if

Must have:

  • You are available for a 6-month full-time internship, under an internship agreement (convention de stage)

  • Fluent written French: you write to French medical teams every day

  • You are comfortable with digital tools (Notion, Intercom, Claude), or you learn them fast. No technical background required.

What we'll assess:

  • Client writing: your messages are structured, adapted to the reader (secretary, practitioner, center director) and jargon-free, without losing accuracy

  • Diagnosis and product curiosity: faced with an unknown case, you ask the right questions in the right order and isolate the cause: usage error, configuration or bug

  • Organization and rigor: you prioritize by impact, not by order of arrival, and you close your loops

  • Proactivity: you have already spotted a recurring problem and built something others used: a guide, a FAQ, a template, a small automation

Nice to have:

  • A first experience in customer support, customer success or operations (internship, student job, association)

  • An interest in healthcare or AI

This role is NOT for you if

  • You want to process tickets without asking why they keep coming back

  • You would rather wait for the answer than dig into how the product works

  • You are looking for a role far from clients

Compensation

  • €1,800 per month for end-of-study internship

This role is where you start. If your internship goes well, we'd be very happy to have you join as a full-time employee!

Perks and benefits

  • At least 3 days a week in our offices in Paris (2nd arrondissement)

  • MacBook provided

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Interview with Sylvain, CX Manager (video, 30 min)

  2. Practical case: answer a real, anonymized client request in 15 min, then debrief with Sylvain (on-site, 1h)

  3. Team fit with Julie, Head of Operations (on-site, 30 min)

  4. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Compensation: €1.8K per month

title: CDI - AI Strategist Manager - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurablesL’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Et tout commence par vous.

Missions

En tant qu’AI Strategist Manager, vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA

Vous définissez la vision IA et la roadmap priorisée des cas d’usage, challengez la pertinence de l’IA et assumez les arbitrages. Lorsque c’est pertinent, vous conduisez des refontes de processus de bout en bout, en pensant lean avant de déployer l’IA et en mobilisant les équipes Engineering et AI Adoption pour les livrer. Vous concevez le modèle opératoire cible et sécurisez ses conditions de succès.

II. Analyses, business cases & prototypage

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse de la mission, business cases inclus, afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits, et vous revoyez le travail de l’équipe. Vous prototypez rapidement des cas d’usage pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

III. Delivery, livrables & collaboration

Vous dirigez les missions au quotidien en donnant de la visibilité aux sponsors clients : vous découpez chaque mission en streams, anticipez les risques et challengez le client lorsque c’est pertinent. Vous produisez en autonomie des livrables de niveau C-suite et des synthèses exécutives, structurez la storyline et veillez au respect des standards de qualité Artefact. Vous orchestrez les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur de confiance des directeurs métiers et des responsables de projets (Comex-1) : vous cartographiez les rapports de force entre les parties prenantes, animez les restitutions pour emporter l’adhésion et maximiser le NPS client, et gérez les tensions et escalades en préservant la confiance. Vous encadrez et faites grandir les consultants juniors et seniors, êtes counsellor de plusieurs collègues et participez au recrutement des futurs talents. Vous contribuez aussi à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des formations internes.

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + 10 000€ de variable, selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
descriptionHtml:

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

Join us at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide and help guide our customers to become the next Lighthouse Celonis customers.

Accountable Program Lead & Engagement Manager

Driving Customer Value

The Qualifications you need:

descriptionHtml:

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

Fin is transforming customer service through AI, helping businesses deliver fast, accurate, and reliable support at scale. Trust is foundational to that mission.

The Cloud Security team is responsible for protecting the platforms that power Fin. We partner closely with infrastructure and product engineering teams to secure cloud environments, detect emerging threats, respond to incidents, and build the security foundations that enable teams to move quickly with confidence. The team owns critical cloud security capabilities including detection engineering, cloud security monitoring, incident response, cloud security controls, and the security tooling that protects Fin's production environments. The team is responsible for securing the cloud platforms and production systems that underpin every Fin customer interaction.

The mission of the team is to help Fin build and operate trusted AI-powered customer service experiences by making security a natural part of how our cloud platforms, production systems, and engineering workflows are designed, deployed, and operated. As Fin continues to expand its capabilities and adoption, you'll help define how cloud security evolves alongside increasingly sophisticated systems and threat models. We're taking an AI-first approach to security, investing in areas such as AI-assisted detection engineering, automated investigations, continuous monitoring, and emerging defensive capabilities to help meet an evolving threat landscape.

What will I be doing?

  • Design and implement secure cloud architectures across our AWS environments.
  • Build and maintain protective and detective controls that improve visibility into threats across our cloud environments.
  • Develop detection engineering capabilities that identify attacker behaviour and reduce time to detection and response.
  • Lead cloud security investigations and incident response activities in partnership with engineering teams.
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation and help coordinate containment, remediation, and recovery efforts during security incidents.
  • Build automation that improves the scalability, reliability, and effectiveness of security controls.
  • Partner with infrastructure teams to embed security into cloud platforms, infrastructure-as-code workflows, and engineering practices.
  • Develop and improve cloud security standards, guidance, and best practices across Fin.
  • Drive security initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, and measurable outcomes.
  • Assess emerging threats to cloud environments and help evolve our defensive capabilities.

What skills do I need?

  • Strong experience securing and operating production AWS environments.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles, modern attack techniques, and security best practices.
  • Experience building or operating detection, monitoring, or threat detection capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience investigating security incidents, leading technical investigations, and driving remediation efforts.
  • Experience implementing security controls across cloud platforms and production environments.
  • Strong programming skills and experience building automation, tooling, or operational workflows.
  • Experience working with infrastructure-as-code practices and modern cloud-native technologies.
  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and engineering effectiveness.
  • Ability to communicate security concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • A pragmatic approach to balancing security, customer impact, and engineering velocity.

Bonus skills & attributes

  • Experience building detection engineering, threat hunting, or security operations capabilities at scale.
  • Experience with cloud-native security platforms, CNAPP technologies, or large-scale cloud security monitoring.
  • Experience applying AI to detection, response, threat analysis, or security operations workflows.
  • Familiarity with AWS networking, identity, and cloud security patterns.

title: Co-Investments & Partnerships Associate / Principal
descriptionHtml:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

KKR’s Co-Investments & Partnerships team is a growing, lean, and entrepreneurial group that leads co-investments alongside the firm’s investments across all asset classes globally, including Private Equity, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Credit, and Growth Equity. The team provides capital markets advice and develops and implements traditional and non-traditional capital solutions for KKR transactions seeking financing through co-investments and partnerships. It also acts as the firm-wide clearing house for secondary transactions, including GP-led continuation vehicles and LP-led fund and co-investment buybacks. The team plays an active role in Investment Committee meetings and offers significant exposure to senior leadership across the firm.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is seeking an Associate / Principal to join the Co-Investments & Partnerships team for an immediate start. The position will be based in London. This is a deal-focused role within a dynamic team, offering exposure to a broad range of transactions across KKR’s European portfolio. The role offers a long-term career path, with progression from deal support to deal leadership and beyond.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Run co-investment processes for KKR portfolio companies across all European strategies including private equity, infrastructure, credit and real estate
• Support and lead all aspects of co-investment processes including close coordination with deal teams and relevant KKR stakeholders, materials preparation, presenting to investors, and Q&A
• Develop a deep understanding of each transaction from an investor perspective
• Lead calls with investors related to live transactions including presenting the deals and answering questions
• Build and maintain relationships with co-investors, limited partners, and other investors
• Collaborate closely with internal deal teams across asset classes and geographies


QUALIFICATIONS

KKR seeks to hire individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, demonstrate strong ownership, and have a proven ability to combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution. The successful candidate will have:

• 3-6 years prior experience in investment banking or private equity investment teams / secondaries
