title: Deep Learning Engineer (Radar Computer Vision)
descriptionHtml:
Your next mission

Turn complex radar data into clear detections – so our software can spot birds, drones, and airborne threats in real time.

As our Deep Learning Engineer, you architect and implement object detection frameworks for non-natural radar imagery. You work side-by-side with fellow AI specialists, software engineers, and radar experts to ensure your research translates directly to edge computing hardware.

Reporting to the AI Lead, your models directly power live radar systems across the globe.

What you'll do

  • Framework design and architecture: Build robust detection, segmentation, and tracking models for complex 3D, 4D, and 5D radar data. Translate raw signal processing concepts into high-performing neural network architectures.

  • Data strategy and label management: Develop innovative strategies to handle imperfect, sparse, or missing radar labels. Automate dataset creation and labeling workflows to keep research moving fast.

  • Model optimization for the edge: Optimize neural networks using TensorRT for real-time, low-latency inference. Ensure every model runs smoothly on edge hardware deployed in the field.

  • Cross-functional integration: Partner closely with software and radar engineers to integrate your models into live products. Co-develop and refine deep learning approaches alongside your AI teammates.

What you bring

  • Master's degree in Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field

  • 7+ years of deep learning research experience in computer vision, specializing in non-natural imaging modalities (radar preferred)

  • Proven expertise in object detection, segmentation, and classification models

  • Deep familiarity with radar data or non-natural signal modalities like LiDAR, sonar, or medical imaging

  • Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing models for edge computing hardware

  • Advanced proficiency in Python and PyTorch

  • Experience with TensorRT or similar high-performance inference libraries is a strong advantage

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

descriptionHtml:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.

The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. 

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Portfolio Management

  • Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.
  • Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.
  • Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.

Technical Leadership and Program Development

  • Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.
  • Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.
  • Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.

Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships

  • Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.
  • Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.

Performance, Learning and Accountability

  • Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.
  • Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.

Qualifications

Education

  • Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.

Experience

  • At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.
  • Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.
  • Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.
  • Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $150,000 to $170,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment

title: Director Minerva Frontline (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

Minerva is STARK’s overarching Mission Operating System — the central cognitive backbone connecting all our unmanned platforms across air, land, and sea, while seamlessly integrating third-party systems and interfacing directly with national Battle Management Systems (BMS). Within this ecosystem, the Minerva Frontline organization owns the entire human-machine interface and operator experience on the ground. Our program brings together three specialized product pillars — Minerva Frontend Applications, Ground Control Stations (GCS), and Mission Simulation — distributed across Berlin and Munich. We operate with high autonomy, a mission-first mindset, and close collaboration between software engineers, hardware specialists, and operational experts to build reliable, intuitive systems that work when stakes are at their highest.

Your Mission

As Director Minerva Frontline, you are the holistic Program Owner and external face of STARK’s customer-facing software and mission control suite. Reporting directly to the VP of Software, you will lead the departments across Command & Control (C2) Applications, Ground Control Stations, and Simulation, unifying their efforts into one cohesive, battle-tested product experience. You will set the visionary product roadmap internally while representing our capabilities externally to military stakeholders, procurement agencies, and partners across NATO nations.

  • Define and communicate a compelling product vision internally, aligning engineering and UX teams around operator needs so that software, ground station hardware, and simulation environments feel like one seamless system.
  • Serve as the primary external representative for Minerva Frontline, pitching and demonstrating our C2, GCS, and simulation capabilities to military end-users, defence ministries, and procurement bodies (e.g., BAAINBw).

  • Translate complex battlefield and customer requirements into structured, actionable engineering priorities, balancing rapid prototyping with mission-critical reliability and safety.
  • Establish and scale a lean Program Management Office (PMO) over time to professionalize program tracking, release planning, and cross-entity alignment.
  • Collaborate closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Physical Platform Leads to shape go-to-market materials, pricing models, and integrated system demonstrations at test ranges and customer sites.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Proven senior leadership and program ownership experience managing complex, multi-team software or cyber-physical product organizations, including responsibility for roadmaps, budgets, and delivery.
  • Strong technical background in building mission-critical software suites, ideally combining software engineering leadership with hardware-in-the-loop, robotics, C2 systems, or ground control interfaces.
  • Credibility and domain expertise in the defence or aerospace sector, with the ability to speak at eye level with military decision-makers, operators, and technical engineers alike.
  • Exceptional internal and external communication skills — you know how to inspire engineering teams with a crisp vision and persuasively represent complex technical products to B2G (Business-to-Government) customers.
  • High organizational rigor and an owner’s mindset, capable of turning startup ambiguity into clear structure and driving execution under high tempo.
  • Willingness to travel regularly between our hubs in Berlin and Munich as well as to customer sites, military bases, and test ranges across Europe.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

Nice-To-Have

  • Prior military service (e.g., former officer or reservist in the Bundeswehr or a NATO allied force), particularly within IT, Cyber, C2, or Air Defence domains.
  • Fluency in German, enabling seamless direct engagement with German defence stakeholders and procurement authorities.
  • An established network within the European defence ecosystem, military procurement agencies, or the NATO technology community.
  • Experience with tactical Battle Management Systems (BMS), military simulation environments, or unmanned systems (UxV) operations.

title: Director of Engineering - Risk and Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role overview | Context

Checkout.com built its name serving the world's largest enterprises. We're now growing into many more types of customer: businesses of every size, including self-serve, startups integrating straight from our docs, and platforms (software companies, payfacs and marketplaces) that onboard thousands of sellers through our APIs. As our product range grows, that takes us from thousands of customers to millions.

At that scale, the decision about who we work with, and on what terms, can't be a manual review at the end of a sales process. It has to be a product. It decides how quickly a good business goes live, how much it costs us to serve them, and how confident our regulators and scheme partners are in us. We're looking for a senior Engineering leader to own that decision.

This team decides which businesses we can work with and on what terms. It covers business verification, screening, underwriting, ongoing monitoring and financial crime. It's a shared platform that serves every one of our businesses. Its users are our customers (directly, or through the platforms they sign up with) and, internally, our Risk, Compliance and Financial Crime teams and the analysts who run reviews and investigations.

Much of what we have today was built segment by segment and market by market, for a smaller number of large customers. The next chapter is one opinionated, configurable decisioning platform. Enterprise, platform and SMB customers should all run on the same foundations, with the right depth of checks and the right terms for each. That way a new product, segment or market doesn't mean rebuilding our controls, and this team isn't on the critical path for every launch.

Role overview | Risk, Verification & Compliance

The remit covers:

  • Risk decisioning: underwriting, risk tiering, exposure limits, reserves and settlement terms, and when to restrict or offboard, re-assessed across the customer lifecycle.

  • Business verification: company, ownership, document, bank account and website checks, run once for every segment.

  • Financial crime: sanctions and PEP screening, AML and transaction monitoring, and the controls, audit trails and reporting behind our regulatory obligations.

  • Decisioning platform: the shared infrastructure that runs these checks automatically for every market and customer type.

You'll partner closely with the teams that own onboarding and identity verification.

Role overview | Remit and Responsibilities

You'll be comfortable building and scaling critical platforms in a regulated environment, where correctness, auditability and availability matter as much as speed. You'll balance two goals that are often in tension: making it fast and easy for good businesses to work with us, and keeping bad actors out and the business compliant.

This is a change role. You'll assess what we have, set a clear direction, and move us from segment-specific, analyst-led processes to an automated decisioning platform, without pausing the business while you do it. You'll do this in close partnership with Product, Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal, and with the leaders of the businesses that depend on the platform.

You'll directly lead an established team of engineers and managers of varying seniorities. Amongst other duties, you'll have impact across:

  • Setting the technical vision and strategy for Risk, Verification & Compliance. That includes deciding what we build once and share, and what each segment, product or market configures.

  • Building a decisioning platform that automates the decisions that don't need a human, safely, and sends the rest to the right analyst with the context they need. Our automation rate sets our cost to onboard and to serve.

  • Making risk dynamic across the customer lifecycle. New businesses start on terms that match the signals we see: limits, reserves and settlement speed. Those terms relax automatically as the business trades well, and we act quickly when the signals change. This starts with simple rules and evolves into machine learning.

  • Making decisions explainable, so that customers, partners and our own analysts understand why a decision was made and what happens next.

  • Giving Risk and Compliance the dials. Acceptance criteria, early-life controls and policy should be configuration that can be changed, tested and measured by cohort, not a code change.

  • Keeping our financial crime controls ahead of growth. Screening and monitoring have to scale from large enterprises to a very large base of smaller businesses, through new channels, payment methods and products.

  • Leading the design and delivery of verification, screening, underwriting and monitoring systems that are accurate, auditable and highly available.

  • Representing Engineering in regulatory, audit, scheme and partner conversations where needed.

  • Managing and developing a high-performing team of individual contributor (IC) Engineers and Engineering Managers, providing guidance, support and career development.

  • Striving for best practice on hiring, coaching and enablement, and being a magnet for top talent.

Role overview | Desired Background, Core Competencies

The ideal candidate for the role will bring:

  • Experience leading multi-level engineering organisations (EMs and ICs) through growth and change, with a track record of developing leaders, not just hiring them.

  • A record of transforming critical platforms while the business kept running: multi-year re-architecture, migrations, or consolidating several systems into one.

  • Experience building and operating mission-critical decisioning or rules platforms at scale. Ideally these served several customer segments, products or markets from a shared foundation.

  • Experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or similar), where compliance, auditability and risk are part of the engineering problem.

  • Deep technical understanding of cloud-native, distributed and data-heavy systems, including how to run ML models safely in production.

  • Exceptional collaboration skills, with a proven ability to partner with senior cross-functional stakeholders, particularly in Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal, and to make clear trade-offs in a complex stakeholder landscape.

  • Ideally, domain knowledge in KYB, AML and financial crime, underwriting, fraud or merchant risk. Experience with self-serve or high-volume onboarding, or with platforms and their sub-merchants, is a strong plus.

  • Humility, low ego and an ideal ambassador for our mission, values and operating principles.

If you feel that you don't meet all the requirements but think you might still be right for the role, please consider continuing in the process. We're always keen to build relationships with leaders who resonate with our mission and values.

 

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Essential skills

  • A systems thinker, comfortable working across hardware, software, and integration boundaries

  • Expertise in debug tools, DFT infrastructure, and validation automation frameworks
  • Proficient in C/C++, Python, and Linux-based environments; experience with large-scale validation clusters is an advantage

Benefits

title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. INTERVIEW PROCESS

Your bigger job is to take it further. Today, testing mostly happens once a release is nearly done. Embedded & Firmware Testing

title: EMC / Compliance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. Operating at these voltage and power levels, electromagnetic compatibility and regulatory compliance are not an afterthought – they are core to a safe, certifiable, and market-ready product across every region we serve.

As EMC / Compliance Engineer, you will own the EMC and regulatory compliance strategy for our power conversion systems – from early design guidance through formal certification with our external test houses and certification bodies. You will work closely with the Power Electronics, Firmware and Mechanical teams to make sure compliance is designed in from the start, not tested in at the end.

It is a unique opportunity to build the compliance function for a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.

Key Responsibilities

• Plan, execute and oversee EMC testing (conducted and radiated emissions and immunity) for our AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion systems, in collaboration with external test houses.

• Define and drive the regulatory compliance strategy and certification roadmap across our target markets and standards (e.g. UL, CE, IEC 62477, IEEE 1547, FCC/CISPR EMC standards).

• Work with the Power Electronics, Firmware and Mechanical teams early in the design phase to build in EMC and compliance considerations – shielding, filtering, grounding and layout – from the start.

• Own relationships with external certification bodies and test houses (UL, TÜV, and others), coordinating test plans, submissions and follow-up on findings.

• Prepare and maintain technical documentation required for certification – test reports, risk assessments, and declarations of conformity.

• Investigate and resolve EMC and compliance issues found during testing, supporting root-cause analysis and design changes together with engineering.

• Track evolving regulatory requirements across our target markets and communicate their impact on the engineering roadmap.

• Support the transition from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness by scaling compliance processes to serial production.

Qualifications

• BSc / MSc in electrical engineering or comparable education.

• 5+ years of experience in EMC engineering and/or regulatory compliance, ideally for power electronics or industrial medium-voltage equipment.

• Strong knowledge of EMC standards (e.g. IEC 61000 series, CISPR, FCC Part 15) and product safety / grid-tie standards (UL, IEC 62477, IEEE 1547).

• Hands-on experience with EMC test equipment and pre-compliance testing.

• Experience working with external test houses and certification bodies.

• Strong documentation skills; comfortable preparing test plans, reports and technical files for certification.

• Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with hardware and firmware teams early in the design cycle.

• Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

• The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich in Switzerland, with occasional travel to test houses and certification bodies.

Benefits

• Equity + competitive salary.

• Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

• Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Semiconductors
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to semiconductor organisations across the Netherlands. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with semiconductor equipment makers, chip designers and manufacturers, and the specialist suppliers around them. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the semiconductor and high-tech sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to semiconductor stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities across hardware and software engineering, R&D, manufacturing, supply chain and field service. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with semiconductor decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the semiconductor sector. Navigate complex, global, engineering-led organisations to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to semiconductor procurement cycles, R&D and capex budgeting, and supplier qualification processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse semiconductor market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within hardware and software engineering, design and verification, R&D, manufacturing and quality, supply chain and procurement, and customer support and field service. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for semiconductor applications
  • Navigate complex semiconductor stakeholder ecosystems including executives, engineering and R&D leadership, IT and security teams, digital transformation functions, legal and compliance, and procurement offices to build consensus
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from users and conveying semiconductor market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for semiconductor clients
  • Continuously refine the semiconductor sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles within semiconductor, high-tech or advanced manufacturing organisations, ideally in the Netherlands or wider Benelux, and securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and engineering use cases
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate large, global, engineering-led organisations and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, engineering and R&D leadership, and IT departments
  • Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements within high-tech procurement frameworks, including supplier onboarding, IP protection, security and data governance reviews
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various technical and business audiences, from engineering and R&D leads to senior executives
  • Deep understanding of semiconductor buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points, including the IP sensitivity, export control and supply chain pressures the industry operates within
  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the semiconductor market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
  • A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for semiconductor and high-tech use

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£330,000—£380,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Enterprise AI Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed
  • Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies
  • Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals
  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
  • Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes
  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 
  • Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.
  • AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.
  • Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.
  • Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.
  • Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Enterprise Applications Manager
descriptionHtml:
Enterprise Applications Manager

About the role

As SkyNRG grows, applications such as SAP Public Cloud, HubSpot, and our Inventory Management System are becoming increasingly important to our operations. We are looking for an Enterprise Applications Manager to take functional ownership of this landscape and ensure our systems effectively support the business.

You will connect business needs with IT solutions, translating requests into clear requirements and coordinated improvements. Working across Commercial, Operations, Maintenance, HSE, Finance and QA, you will create structure, improve adoption and act as the main point of contact for our enterprise applications.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Take functional ownership of SAP Public Cloud, including EAM and HSE, HubSpot, IMS, and other enterprise applications.

  • Translate business processes and needs into clear requirements, functional designs, user stories and test scenarios.

  • Manage functional support, incidents and change requests, coordinating with external partners and vendors where necessary.

  • Build and maintain the enterprise application roadmap, backlogs and change priorities with IT and business owners.

  • Configure applications within the functional scope and coordinate releases, testing and implementation.

  • Improve application adoption, data quality, reporting and integrations across the application landscape.

  • Maintain process documentation, user guides, application records and access roles in line with security and compliance requirements.

  • Train and support key users across the organization, helping teams make effective use of the available systems.

Your initial focus will include strengthening the use of SAP EAM and HSE, improving HubSpot’s commercial processes and reporting, and introducing a consistent intake and change process for business requests.

While this role does not have direct reports, you will coordinate external implementation partners and application vendors. You will also work closely with the wider IT team to ensure our enterprise applications are reliable, secure and aligned with business priorities.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You feel comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, take ownership, and thrive when things are still developing.

You understand both business processes and enterprise technology. You can move comfortably between conversations with business stakeholders, technical colleagues, and external partners, translating different perspectives into practical solutions. Structured and pragmatic, you take end-to-end responsibility rather than simply passing requests along.

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • At least five years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Application Owner, or in a comparable enterprise applications role.

  • Hands-on functional experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, in at least one relevant area such as EAM or Plant Maintenance, HSE or EHS, Finance, or Procurement.

  • Experience working with a CRM platform, preferably HubSpot.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business processes and needs into clear requirements, functional designs, and test scenarios.

  • Experience managing application vendors or implementation partners, including support agreements and service levels.

  • Understanding of change management, release management, testing and access control in an enterprise environment.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to constructively challenge business requests.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Experience in an industrial, energy, chemical, manufacturing or asset-intensive environment would be an advantage. Familiarity with system integrations, SAP BTP, APIs, Power BI or data-quality initiatives would also be beneficial. Knowledge of relevant regulatory and compliance frameworks, such as NIS2, ISO 27001 and GDPR, is considered a plus.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Documenter les solutions et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du produit et des process.

  • Partager ton expertise avec les équipes Support.


Le profil recherché

Tu peux venir de différents environnements : cabinet d’expertise comptable ou éditeur de logiciel comptable.

Nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • dispose d’une solide expérience en comptabilité et comprend les problématiques des cabinets et entreprises ;

  • a déjà travaillé sur des sujets complexes nécessitant analyse et coordination ;

  • parle anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ;

  • fait preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et de curiosité.

La connaissance de SQL est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ton envie de comprendre les systèmes et de monter en compétence sur les sujets techniques.

Pourquoi rejoindre Pennylane ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe au cœur de la qualité produit, en lien direct avec les utilisateurs, les développeurs et les équipes Produit. Tu travailleras dans un environnement international, en forte croissance, où ton expertise comptable aura un impact concret

title: Founding Legal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

Working directly with Grubel’s founding team, you will shape our research, development, and product: Translate complex legal processes into agentic workflows, evaluate our systems for legal soundness and utility, and work with customers to set our product and engineering standards. You need not write code, but you’re passionate about understanding our technology deeply. Working in a fast-moving team at the intersection of AI research, legal practice, and technology excites you.

What you’ll work on

  • Designing realistic tasks, datasets, and evaluation rubrics for training and evaluation of our legal AI systems

  • Translating complex legal processes into agentic workflows together with our researchers and engineers

  • Evaluating system outputs for legal accuracy, usefulness, and failure modes

  • Leading enterprise pilots and implementations

  • Supporting customer discovery, demonstrations, and go-to-market initiatives

You may be a good fit if

Logistics

  • Full time employment

  • Competitive salary plus a stock option grant in Grubel, Inc., our US parent company.

title: Functional Architect – AI-Driven Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?

Vision:

As a global software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust offers an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world’s leading Legal Tech company.

Our Impact:

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams across 12 offices in France, the United States, Mexico, Dubai, Morocco, Germany, Spain, Italy and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America and the Middle East.

Our Recognition:

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels every year since 2019.

The role

DiliTrust’s R&D organization is undergoing a deep transformation toward AI-driven engineering across every role, from Product and QA to DevOps, Engineering and Architecture. In this context, business knowledge becomes a strategic asset: it must be explicit, structured and shared so that both our teams and our AI agents can consistently build the right product.

Reporting to the Head of Architecture, you will be responsible for the functional coherence of the entire DiliTrust platform, covering all business modules and internal services. You will map our business domains, define functional design standards and ensure they are applied—including by building the AI agents that automate functional validation.

This is a role with real authority and a progressive mandate. You will start as a trusted advisor to Product and Engineering teams, then progressively become the approval authority for functional design across the platform. Your ability to simplify complex systems and connect business knowledge with technical execution will be central to your impact.

Missions:

  • Map the platform’s business domains: Build and maintain a comprehensive model of capabilities, processes, business rules and data entities across all business modules and internal services, starting with priority areas and expanding progressively.

  • Simplify and rationalize the functional landscape: Apply Domain-Driven Design to define bounded contexts, establish a ubiquitous language and map relationships between contexts. Identify overlaps, gaps and inconsistencies, and clarify shared concepts such as users, entities, documents, workflows, permissions and audit trails.

  • Establish functional design governance: Define principles, standards and reusable patterns; review and approve functional designs and specifications against the global model. Build a clear decision-making framework through documented rules, decision records and review rituals.

  • Make business knowledge usable by people and AI: Maintain a living, machine-readable source of truth comprising domain models, a business glossary and precise specifications. Support spec-driven development and embed this knowledge into the context, skills and tooling used by AI agents across R&D.

  • Build AI-driven functional validation: Design, build and maintain your own AI agents to check specifications, user stories and designs against the domain model and design rules. Assess and improve the functional quality and reliability of AI outputs across coding, testing and review.

  • Align functional and technical architecture: Work with technical architects on APIs, events and data models, ensuring that DDD bounded contexts translate into well-isolated domains within a hexagonal architecture, with business logic independent of infrastructure.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, QA and technical architects to resolve functional inconsistencies and ensure that product and engineering decisions remain coherent across the platform.

  • Coach teams and champion functional practices: Act as a reference on functional topics, onboarding and coaching teams on the domain model, design standards and ways of working.

Requirements

  • Based in France with full working rights.

  • Fluent in French and English.

Experience & seniority:

  • 10+ years of experience in software, including significant experience in system modeling and functional or solution design on complex B2B SaaS platforms.

  • Proven experience mapping and rationalizing a complex, multi-product platform with a long history.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect business needs, functional models and engineering decisions.

  • Legal Tech experience is not required.

Technical expertise:

  • Strong command of strategic and tactical Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, context mapping, aggregates, entities, value objects and domain events.

  • Proficiency in process and system modeling using approaches such as BPMN, UML, C4 and event storming.

  • Ability to write precise specifications, business rules and acceptance criteria, including formats such as Gherkin.

  • Solid understanding of hexagonal architecture, APIs, data models and event-driven architectures, enabling you to engage as a peer with technical architects.

  • Daily use of LLM assistants and AI agents, with the ability to quickly master new tools.

  • Hands-on ability to build and iterate on AI agents through prompting, context engineering, skills, MCP, scripting or low-code approaches as needed.

  • Good understanding of how to evaluate and improve the functional accuracy and reliability of AI outputs.

Leadership & collaboration:

  • Strong systems thinking: you understand the whole, recognize interactions and design for coherence over time.

  • A proven ability to simplify rather than add complexity, favoring clear concepts, clean boundaries and minimal models.

  • Structured, concise thinking and the ability to make complex topics understandable to others.

  • The ability to build trust and influence first, then hold a firm line on standards when needed.

  • Excellent communication, teaching and coaching skills across business and technical teams.

Education:

Your background may be functional—business analysis, product or functional architecture—or technical, such as software engineering or architecture. What matters is your ability to model complex systems and bridge business and technology.

Our Tech Stack

For information only: the stack evolves continuously, and hands-on expertise in every technology is not expected for this role.

descriptionHtml:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.

  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Graduate Agentic Software Engineer - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Instil's agentic product development team in 2027 and learn to build software the way it will be built in the agentic age: engineers owning the problem, the architecture and the key decisions, with AI agents accelerating everything in between.

About the role

At Instil, agentic product engineering is how we deliver. Our teams work alongside an agentic workforce that generates requirements, builds across parallel workstreams, runs continuous quality and security checks or monitoring systems in production. The result is software that ships faster, with lower risk.

The agents do a lot, but people stay firmly in charge - orchestrating. We own the problem, the architecture and the key decisions. That is the skill set we will help you build from day one.

As a graduate you will join a delivery team working on real client products for organisations ranging from ambitious start-ups to global brands. You will learn the fundamentals of great software engineering and, alongside them, how to direct, review and get the best out of AI agents.

What you'll do

You will work across our full delivery lifecycle, supported by experienced engineers and mentors.

  1. Plan: take part in discovery with clients, help shape requirements and use agents to turn ideas into rapid prototypes and a backlog ready to build.

  2. Build: write, review and test production code, directing agents across parallel workstreams and learning to judge when their output is right and when it is not.

  3. Ship: help release software to production, design for observability and use agents to monitor systems, analyse issues and drive improvements.

Along the way you will:

  • Learn to make sound technical decisions and explain them clearly

  • Build good habits in security, testing and code quality, so speed never comes at the cost of trust

  • Work directly with clients and colleagues as part of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team

  • Share what you learn, as our ways of working with agents are evolving all the time

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think than what you already know.

Essential:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline

  • Solid programming fundamentals in at least one modern language, such as TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, or C#

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or similar, through projects, hackathons or coursework

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the judgement to question an answer rather than simply accept it

  • Clear communication skills and an enjoyment of working in a team

Nice to have:

  • Side projects, open source contributions or a portfolio that shows what you have built

  • An interest in cloud platforms, security or web and mobile development

What you'll get

  • A structured graduate programme combining engineering fundamentals with hands-on training in agentic development

  • A mentor and regular feedback, with a clear path to progress

  • Real client work from your first months, not just internal projects

  • Access to the latest AI tools and the time to learn them properly

  • A collaborative culture where people share knowledge openly

Graduate details

  • Start date: September 2027

  • Location: Belfast

  • Working pattern: Hybrid – at least 3 days per week in our Belfast office

  • Right to work: Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK

Why Join Instil?

At Instil, we believe great work starts with happy, motivated people. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your wellbeing, growth, and life outside of work, because when you thrive, so do we.

  • Recognition That Matters: A discretionary annual performance bonus that rewards your impact and contribution to our success.

  • Flexibility Built In: Flexible working arrangements and summer hours, because life isn’t 9 to 5, and balance matters.

  • Financial Security: A highly competitive pension scheme with generous employer contributions, private healthcare, and life assurance for peace of mind.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Programme, mental health support, cycle-to-work scheme, and regular social events to keep our culture vibrant.

  • Time to Recharge: 35 days holiday, enhanced maternity pay, and family-first policies so you can focus on what matters most.

  • Learning Never Stops: From courses to certifications, we’ll invest in your development so you can keep growing and shaping what’s next.

  • Community & Culture: Opportunities to volunteer, give back, and be part of initiatives that make Instil a truly inclusive and connected workplace.

And that’s just the start, drop us a note to find out more.

Please note: We offer flexible hybrid working, but candidates should be based in Northern Ireland and able to attend our Belfast office when required.

Company Description

Instil has been delivering world-class software engineering and technology solutions for over 20 years, trusted by global brands to solve complex challenges and drive innovation. From modernising legacy systems to building cutting-edge applications, we help our clients navigate an ever-changing digital landscape with confidence and agility.

We’re proud to be an award-winning employer, reflecting how our people are at the heart of everything we do:
