title: Graduate Product Designer 2027 (London)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

There's a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love.

As a Graduate Product Designer, you'll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, or Customer Experience & Integrity. You'll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people.

  • You'll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship.
  • You'll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you'll quickly grow to own design end-to-end.
  • You'll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders.
  • You'll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human.
  • You'll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won't just shape your own projects - it'll shape how design is practiced across the team.
  • You'll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration.
  • You'll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation.

What You'll Need to Thrive

We're looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here's what you'll need to join us and thrive in the role:

  • You're in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027.
  • You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals - visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving.
  • AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience.
  • You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly.
  • You're excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters - solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. You'll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scaleWork on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fastShip, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownershipTake on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for buildersHigh standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:

Are you a recent or soon-to-be graduate in physics, engineering or a related field, keen to apply your technical appreciation of physics and engineering to guide investment and business choices in the telecommunications sector? Who we are 

Our Advisory team works at the forefront of emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation into commercial success. Although this role will spend most of its time supporting clients in the telecommunications sector, we encourage our consultants to bring their expertise across industries, particularly in areas where communications, infrastructure and energy are becoming increasingly interconnected. 

You'll work with a wide range of organisations, from fast-growing technology pioneers and infrastructure providers to telecoms operators and investors. Together, we help clients navigate uncertainty, evaluate opportunities and make informed strategic judgements. 

Projects typically involve assessing new markets, understanding competitive landscapes, shaping go-to-market strategies, supporting investment judgements and exploring future technology pathways. title: Head of Data
descriptionHtml:
Born in 1971, the roots of Mulberry are in Somerset, England. For more than fifty years, Mulberry has been a British lifestyle brand, internationally acclaimed for quality and design capturing the Mulberry Spirit.
Sustainability has been part of the Mulberry ethos since the brand's inception, in recognition of our purpose-driven approach, in 2024 we proudly achieved B Corp Certification.
Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited.
If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team.

Mulberry is looking for an experienced Head of Data to establish and lead our enterprise data capability.

This is a pivotal new role with the opportunity to shape how data is architected, governed, managed and used across Mulberry. You will define our data operating model, establish clear ownership and governance, build a cross-functional data community and create the foundations for trusted, accessible and valuable data across the business.

Working closely with senior business leaders and Technology, you will act as the single point of accountability for Data Enablement across Mulberry, ensuring our approach is driven by business priorities and delivers measurable value.

Alongside establishing the organisational capability, you will help shape Mulberry’s future technology data capability. This could involve evolving our existing Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery environment or moving towards an alternative solution. The role will ensure that our business needs, operating model and long-term ambitions inform those choices.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Define and implement Mulberry’s enterprise Data strategy and operating model, including ownership, governance, stewardship and decision rights.
  • Establish a pragmatic Data Governance framework, covering definitions, quality, lineage, metadata, standards and accountability.
  • Create and lead a cross-functional Data Community, establishing Data Owners and Data Stewards across key business areas and equipping them with the guidance, training and practical tools needed to fulfil their responsibilities.
  • Act as the enterprise point of accountability for Data Enablement, bringing together business and Technology priorities.
  • Lead the business direction of our Data Foundations programme and help transition it into a sustainable, long-term capability.
  • Establish common definitions, authoritative data sources and trusted enterprise measures, reducing multiple versions of the truth and manual reconciliation.
  • Work with Technology to define the business requirements and guiding principles for our future data architecture and platform.
  • Develop a prioritised Data roadmap focused on delivering tangible commercial and operational value.
  • Build data literacy and enable greater, appropriately governed self-service across the organisation.
  • Create the foundations required for future analytics, automation and AI opportunities.
  • Work with relevant Legal and Technology stakeholders to embed appropriate data classification, access, retention and lifecycle controls, with clear ownership of data risks and remediation.

About you

You’ll combine strong Data expertise with commercial judgement and the ability to lead enterprise-wide change.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Significant experience in Data leadership, Data Governance, Data Management or enterprise Data transformation.
  • Experience building or materially evolving a Data operating model, rather than simply managing an established function.
  • Strong knowledge of Data Governance, ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage and metadata.
  • Experience establishing accountability across multiple business functions and building the internal and external capabilities needed to deliver data outcomes.
  • A strong commercial mindset, with the ability to translate business challenges into clear Data priorities and outcomes.
  • The confidence to influence senior leaders and constructively challenge both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Sufficient understanding of modern cloud Data platforms to help shape technology decisions without needing to be the technical architect.
  • Experience developing Data strategies and investment roadmaps.
  • Clear, engaging communication skills and the ability to make Data understandable to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of GCP, BigQuery or comparable cloud data platforms.

Experience within retail, luxury, consumer goods or manufacturing would be advantageous.

What success looks like

Within your first year, you will have established:

  • A clear and functioning enterprise Data operating model.
  • Active Data Owners and Data Stewards across priority areas.
  • A strong cross-functional Data Community.
  • Common definitions and governance for critical enterprise data and KPIs.
  • Improved visibility of Data quality, lineage, ownership and risk.
  • A prioritised Data roadmap linked to measurable business outcomes.
  • A clear future technology Data capability and supporting organisational model.
  • Greater trust in and use of Data for decision-making across Mulberry.

Why this role matters

This is not a traditional reporting, BI or technical Data role. It is an opportunity to build an enterprise capability from the ground up.

Data is increasingly critical to how Mulberry makes commercial and operational decisions, and to how we develop our future technology and AI capabilities. The Head of Data will play a central role in creating the ownership, governance, capability and culture needed to unlock that opportunity.

What You'll Do

As Head of Engineering, you will lead Radiant's engineering organisation and be accountable for its execution, technical quality, reliability, and scalability.

You'll lead software engineering, platform security engineering, and architecture: an organisation of 30-35 engineers today, growing to 150 to 200+ as Radiant expands internationally. title: Head of GTM & Revenue Operations
descriptionHtml:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing, whether you are looking to buy, sell or lease. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 600 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!


THE ROLE

Carwow has just brought its Sell My Car and Get Your Car commercial teams together into one team serving one dealer network. Those dealers buy cars from drivers through Sell My Car and sell cars to drivers through Get Your Car. As Head of GTM & Revenue Operations, you'll design how that team runs: the process, the tooling, the analytics and forecast the business trades on, and the automation that takes the admin away from the day-to-day. The commercial number here depends on how dealers behave on our marketplace each day as much as on the sales pipeline, so this is RevOps with more moving parts than most, and a rare chance to build it from close to the ground up.

The commercial team is around 60 people today, working alongside around 100 in operations, and we plan to scale our commercial operation significantly next year. You'll start with a small team and a clear mandate to build the function the business needs, making the case for investment with the VP's support. There's real room to grow, for the team and for you.

You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations, and you're accountable for the commercial forecast, the sales process and the Salesforce roadmap. The commercial teams own the selling and the relationships and the tech org builds and runs the platform; you work closely with all of them. After a year, success looks like a forecast the business trusts and trades on, one Salesforce and one process across both products, and a clear read of where deals are lost so enablement aims at the right things.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Working with the commercial organisation, sales leadership, workforce management, the trading leads and the central analytics and data teams, you will:

  • Design the operating model: one go-to-market process, pipeline and dealer view across Sell My Car and Get Your Car, with the capacity and headcount plan to match, built with Workforce Management.

  • Shape targets, comp and territories: design them with commercial leadership so each person's number ties to the business outcome.

  • Own the forecast: build a forward-looking commercial forecast on marketplace and pipeline drivers that feeds trading, reconciles to Finance, and gives leadership a clear weekly view of where the number is heading.

  • Own the Salesforce roadmap: one platform for the whole commercial team, with the workflows, sales-engagement tooling and dashboards people actually use, delivered with the tech org.

  • Build in AI and automation from the start: take manual work out of forecasting, reporting and the commercial teams' day, so they spend their time with dealers.

  • Find where performance is lost: use the data to diagnose where reps and teams fall short, from ramp time to call quality to lost deals, agree with sales leadership where training should focus, and measure whether it worked.

  • Build the team and run change: hire and shape the function, and run the commercial PMO so cross-functional programmes land on time with clear owners.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be a perfect match for everything here, so please apply if you're close to the brief. If you meet most of the essentials, we'd like to hear from you.

The essentials:

  • You've led a revenue-operations, commercial-operations or GTM-operations team in a marketplace, growth or B2B sales business

  • You've built a forecast that leadership relied on, and you can explain what drove it when it missed

  • You know Salesforce well as a system of record: you can shape the data model and process, and work with a platform team to deliver it

  • You've designed targets, comp, territories and capacity plans that tie to business outcomes

  • You've grown a team from a small base, hired well and set a clear bar

How you'll work (we'll explore these in interview):

  • Credible with senior people: you make a well-evidenced case, hold it under challenge, and raise the hard truth early

  • Fluent with AI: you use it to work faster and help a team adopt it

Nice to have:

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Phone screen with a member of the Talent Team

  • First round interview with the hiring manager focussed on prior experience

  • Second round made up of a case study presentation on a revenue-operations problem (we'll send the brief in advance and give you time to prepare)

  • Situational/company values interview with senior members of the leadership team

  • Final round interview with a member of the Exec team

We want everyone to do their best thinking, so if you'd like any adjustments to the process, just let us know.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.
  • AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.
  • Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission

Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains.

You will:

  • Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures.
  • Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements.
  • Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure: topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability.
  • Own our on-premise infrastructure operations: data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices.
  • Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems.
  • Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure, including GPU workloads and compute clusters.
  • Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms.
  • Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads.

Who we are looking for

We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

You might be:

  • a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;
  • an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;
  • a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;
  • a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have

  • Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as:
    • networking;
    • SRE/reliability;
    • database administration;
    • telecom/voice infrastructure;
    • hardware/on-premise infrastructure.
  • Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains.
  • Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering).
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you stay close to technology, understand technical details and lead through context and expertise.
  • Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work onsite in Paris.

Nice to Have

Experience with:

  • Telecom or carrier infrastructure.
  • Voice platforms or real-time communication systems.
  • PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis operational experience at scale.
  • Dark fiber, peering and advanced networking.
  • Kubernetes in production.
  • GPU infrastructure.
  • Incident command and post-mortem culture.

About You

You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles.

You solve problems before being asked.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems.

You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices.

Why join us

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact.

Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity.

Work on infrastructure that cannot simply be outsourced.

From telecom networks and hardware to distributed systems and AI workloads, you will solve problems where architecture and engineering decisions matter.

Build something from an early stage of maturity.

You will help establish the operational discipline, processes and team structure needed for the next phase of growth.

Work directly with technical leadership.

You will report directly to Sergey, our CTO, who is deeply involved in infrastructure and technical decisions while giving infrastructure leaders the ownership to drive changes.

Recruitment Process

  1. Intro call with Talent AcquisitionUp to 1h — alignment on experience, expectations and motivation.

  2. Two technical conversations with Sergey, CTOFocused on:

  • infrastructure strategy;
  • technical depth;
  • architecture decisions;
  • operational leadership approach.

  1. Meeting with the infrastructure teamOnsite or online session focused on collaboration, problem-solving and engineering culture.

  2. Final conversation with CEO

Logistics

📍 Paris, France
🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed
🏠 Relocation support available

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already done this exact role in this exact environment.

The strongest candidates are often engineers who grew into leadership by taking ownership, solving complex problems and going beyond their formal responsibilities.

If you have built and operated complex infrastructure, enjoy solving ambiguous technical challenges and want to shape a critical engineering domain — we would love to talk.

title: Head of Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Zoomo, our vision is to transition every commercial urban mile to light electric vehicles (LEVs) to build sustainable and more equitable cities. To that end, we are building the world’s most convenient, affordable, and safe e-bike platform.

In 4 years Zoomo has helped transition millions of urban miles to light electric vehicles, built a team of >200 world class engineers, operators, sales staff and vehicle repair technicians; developed and deployed the world's best last mile delivery electric bikes and fleet management software; and successfully deploys these solutions around the world. We operate across the USA, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Zoomo vehicles are used by major players in the food, grocery and parcel delivery segments with partners including UberEats, Doordash, JustEat Takeaway, Deliveroo, Domino’s, Pizza Hut, Amazon, FedEx, Getir, Ocado, GoPuff and many more.

The Role

We’re hiring the most senior leader in France, reporting to the COO, to own market performance end-to-end: operational excellence, growth, and P&L outcomes. You’ll shape and improve our physical operations (fleet, workshop, retail), lead a hands-on team on the ground, and drive pragmatic growth initiatives (pricing, channels, partnerships) to build demand. This role requires an entrepreneurial operator with strong ownership, comfortable both running day-to-day operations and identifying opportunities to improve and grow the business.

You can expect to:

  • Drive local growth strategy: identify demand constraints and run pragmatic tests (pricing, offers, channels, local partnerships) with clear measurement.
  • Stabilise and scale core operations (workshop + retail + fleet logistics). Expand capacity thoughtfully as demand grows, ensuring process discipline and cost control.
  • Deliver excellent B2B operations (SLA, onboarding, servicing, reporting) while maintaining focus on B2C growth (majority of the business).
  • Own P&L rhythm for France: budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and trade-offs that protect unit economics while enabling growth.
  • Hire, coach, and performance-manage a high-accountability frontline team; develop 1-2 strong leads to strengthen local leadership depth.
  • Lead safety initiatives and programs to ensure we continue to keep customers and employees safe at scale.
  • Own the weekly operating cadence and core KPIs for France. Ensure pragmatic processes that keep the operation in control are implemented and digested by the team.
  • Create a high-performance culture: clear ownership, measurable goals, fast problem-solving, and strong talent development.
  • Act as the senior leader in France, partnering with central functions (Ops, Growth, Finance, Revenue, Tech, People) to set priorities, ensure support and deliver results.
  • Handle local ‘GM admin’ with limited support: vendors, facilities topics, contracts coordination, and operational bureaucracy - solve problems end-to-end.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience managing frontline operations in a fast-paced, physical environment (last-mile, mobility, retail ops, field services, logistics).
  • Proven track record improving measurable outcomes (throughput, quality, cost, availability, customer metrics) via hands-on leadership and process discipline.
  • You have hired and led frontline teams; comfortable with performance management and raising the bar in junior teams.
  • You are an entrepreneurial operator with a high-ownership mindset who thrives in ambiguous, decentralised international environments, proactively building solutions and driving impact without the need for constant direction.
  • You have a bias for action and experimentation: identify levers, run tests (incl. pricing/channel changes), measure impact, iterate fast. Comfortable switching between floor-level detail (workshop/retail) and business planning (forecasting, stakeholder updates).
  • Basic P&L experience: has managed or strongly influenced revenue and cost lines; can budget/forecast and make trade-offs.
  • Comfortable handling administrative complexity and operational bureaucracy; can coordinate vendors/contracts/facilities issues end-to-end.
  • Experience in a scale-up or transformation environment with ambiguity and limited structure; can build order without heavy support.
  • Humility is something that comes naturally to you. You’re a born collaborator and you care about getting to the right answer more than who came up with it.

Benefits

We offer you the chance to be part of a team at the cutting edge of the world’s electrification journey, including:

  • Basic Salary of 70,000€ - 80000€ per annum (depending on experience)
  • Benefit from the company's success, through equity options - giving you ownership in and financial upside to the company’s long term success
  • Global and country-specific benefits packages
  • Flexible working that is focussed on the delivery of OKRs

  • Get to know our product by using one of our e-bikes

title: Head of People Operations
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

  • You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

  • You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

  • You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

  • AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and think in systems. You have the operational depth to manage complex multi-country employment realities, and the leadership to develop hub teams that genuinely own their work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

Lead the Hub Model

  • Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

  • Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

  • Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

  • Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

  • Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

  • Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

  • Own the OKR cascade: every hub has OKRs that roll up through the function; you're accountable for making that cascade real, not formal

  • Define what success looks like in each location — local service standards, local processes, local roadmap

Partner with Domain Leads

Clear interfaces are the model, not the exception:

  • Workplace & Experience — deploy global programs and standards locally; coordinate on facilities, office improvements, and events beyond the local scope

  • Payroll — ensure multi-country payroll accuracy and surface local issues early

  • People Tech — maintain HRIS data quality and drive system adoption across hubs

  • Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

  • Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.

Build the Team

  • Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

  • You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

  • Drive team development: upgrade skills, address underperformance, enable people with AI tools

  • Build hub teams that operate autonomously — no daily hand-holding required

Manage the Operational Realities

  • Visa and relocation support coordination across locations

  • Local compliance and employment framework adherence, in partnership with Compliance

  • Office and facilities baseline across hub locations — in coordination with Workplace & Experience on standards

Build AI-Native Operations

  • Default to automation for employee queries, document generation, onboarding workflows, and operational logistics

  • Build self-service so people don't need to contact us for anything a good system can answer

  • Treat AI adoption within the function as infrastructure and a performance metric

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • Hub teams operating autonomously across all locations — you're steering, not executing day-to-day

  • Every hub has OKRs, knows what winning looks like, and can tell if they hit it

  • Employee lifecycle is consistent and increasingly automated across all locations

  • Cross-functional interfaces with Payroll, Tech, Compliance, W&E are clean and frictionless

  • Knowledge base live and current in a single source of truth

  • AI and automation handle the majority of repeatable operational tasks inside the function

  • Every hub partner owns their roadmap — not just their to-do list

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

Experience & Background

  • 10+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or Operations leadership in multinational environments

  • Direct experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries and employment frameworks

  • Proven record building distributed operating models — not just inheriting and running existing ones

  • Experience standing up new processes and functions in fast-changing environments

  • Strong change management experience — organizational transitions handled with operational rigor and human care

  • Experience in fast-scaling tech environments — SaaS and start-up / scale-up required

Skills & Mindset

  • Systems thinker: you see how processes connect, where the friction is, and what the fix is

  • AI-native operating instinct: you treat every new process as a question of which system or agent should own it

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: non-linear situations with predictable outcomes

  • Stakeholder management: you go and solve, not email and wait

  • Cross-cultural judgment: you understand employment realities across NL, ES, BR, AM, US — or learn fast when you don't

  • Executive presence: you partner with senior leadership and personally own the hardest operational calls

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

Benefits at Manychat don't start with a spreadsheet — they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Everything below follows from that:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: instead of a fixed set of perks, you get a flexible benefits budget you can direct across the things that matter most — health, wellbeing, family, and your home office among them. Within these areas, the choice is yours.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota

  • 🌎 Work from where you need to — agreed with your team, not tied to a desk. Flexibility we built in on purpose, because location shouldn't get in the way of great work.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Tools like Claude and OpenAI are available by default, and we genuinely back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. It's a toolkit that's well ahead of the market, and you'll have it from day one.

Bis heute hat Midas Emissionen im Volumen von über 4 Mrd. USD ermöglicht und 45 Mio. USD an Erträgen ausgeschüttet.

Midas baut ein neues Geschäftsfeld auf: ein Cash-Management-Produkt für KMUs, die ihre überschüssige Liquidität auf unverzinsten Bankkonten parken. Über Midas legen Unternehmen ihr Betriebskapital mit wenigen Klicks in hochliquide, Ertrag bringende Investmentprodukte an – voll digital, tagesaktuell verfügbar und nahtlos in die tägliche Treasury-Praxis integriert. Das Produkt ist im Stealth-Modus und der Launch ist für Anfang 2027 geplant. Für den Launch stellen wir das kommerzielle Gründungsteam ein.

Die Rolle Als Head of Sales leiten Sie den Sales Desk von Midas in der DACH Region und verkaufen jeden Tag selbst. Sie tragen eine persönliche Quote und bauen ein Team aus Account Executives auf.

Ihre Kernaufgaben

  • Eigener Vertrieb & Pipeline-Generierung: Sie tragen vom ersten Tag an volle Eigenverantwortung für Ihren gesamten Sales-Cycle – von der eigenständigen Pipeline-Generierung und aktivitäts starken Outbound-Akquise über Bedarfsanalyse-, Demo- und Abschlussgespräche mit Geschäftsführern und CFOs bis hin zum Closing und der Neukundengewinnung.

  • Aufbau und Führung des Desks: Sie stellen Full-Cycle Account Executives ein, arbeiten sie ein und führen sie vorbildhaft in der eigenverantwortlichen Pipeline-Entwicklung. Sie schreiben das Sales Playbook für systematischen Outbound-Vertrieb, definieren Aktivitäts- und Conversion-Standards, führen Pipeline-Reviews durch und sorgen für strikte CRM-Disziplin. Zudem etablieren Sie ein regelmäßiges Forecasting, liefern klare Performance-Updates an das Management und unterstützen Ihr Team aktiv durch strukturiertes Field Coaching.

  • Conversion und Onboarding: Sie verantworten die Qualifizierung anhand unserer Ticket-Schwelle, die Demo, die Begleitung durch den KYC-Prozess und die Erstzeichnung. Gemeinsam mit Produkt bauen Sie Reibungspunkte im Onboarding ab.

  • Feedback-Schleife: Sie spiegeln die Rückmeldungen aus dem Markt an die Gründer und das Produktteam zurück: Einwände, Wettbewerber, Pricing, Reibungspunkte im Onboarding.

title: Senior Short Term Trader (m/w/d) Stromhandel & Batteriespeicher - SEtrade
descriptionHtml:
Wir bei SEtrade bauen das attraktivste virtuelle Kombikraftwerk Europas – eine KI-gesteuerte Handels- und Optimierungsplattform, die Photovoltaik, Wind, Batteriespeicher, Wasserstoffproduktion und Schnellladesysteme (HPCs) in Echtzeit steuert.

Bereits heute bewirtschaften wir über 350 MWp Solar, 100 MWp Wind, 100 MWh Speicher, 12 MW Wasserstoff und über 40 HPC-Ladestationen.

Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn …

Du schon immer Märkte analysiert hast, um aus Preissignalen profitable Handelsentscheidungen abzuleiten. Während andere nach Bauchgefühl handeln, verlässt du dich auf Daten, Statistik und getestete Strategien, um Chancen zu erkennen und Risiken zu steuern.

Du es liebst, wenn Intraday-Preise ausschlagen, sich Chancen zwischen Spot- und Regelenergiemärkten verschieben und der Ladezustand eines Batteriespeichers eine klare Entscheidung verlangt. Du denkst in Spreads, Liquidität, Fahrplänen und Flexibilität. Dein Ziel ist profitabler Handel innerhalb klarer technischer und wirtschaftlicher Grenzen.

Jetzt kannst du genau diese Fähigkeiten nutzen, um bei SEtrade Handelsstrategien zu entwickeln, selbst in Python umzusetzen und mit Claude Code schneller weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Arbeit wird sichtbar: in Nettoerträgen, zuverlässiger Handelsausführung und wirtschaftlicher BESS-Vermarktung.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission:

Als Senior Short Term Trader (m/w/d) bist du der Motor unseres datenbasierten Stromhandels. Dein Ziel: nachhaltige Nettoerträge aus Spot-, Intraday-, Regelenergie- und Terminhandel durch fundierte Entscheidungen und robuste Handelsalgorithmen.

Dein Team: Du verstärkst unser Team aus aktuell vier Tradern und berichtest an den Teamlead Trading.

Dein Fokus liegt auf:

  • Kurzfristhandel & Positionierung – Identifiziere Chancen in Spot- und Intraday-Märkten und setze sie innerhalb freigegebener Strategien und Limits um.
  • BESS & Regelenergie – Optimiere die Speichervermarktung zwischen Energie- und Regelenergiemärkten. Berücksichtige Ladezustand, Wirkungsgrad, Alterung und bestehende Verpflichtungen.
  • Python & Automatisierung – Entwickle Handels- und Analysetools selbst, nutze Claude Code und steuere komplexere Entwicklungen fachlich.
  • Terminhandel & Risikosteuerung – Bewerte Positionen, setze freigegebene Absicherungsstrategien um und steuere Preis-, Mengen- und Liquiditätsrisiken.
  • Performance & Strategieentwicklung – Analysiere Ergebnisse, teste Handelsansätze und überführe genehmigte Verbesserungen kontrolliert in den produktiven Handel.

Deine Erfolge werden so gemessen:

Nettohandelsertrag:

Dein Ergebnis zählt nach direkt zurechenbaren Handels- und Ausgleichsenergiekosten. Du übertriffst dein Jahresziel ab 110 %, erfüllst den Plan ab 100 % und erreichst das Mindestziel ab 95 %. Die Einhaltung der Risikolimits ist Voraussetzung.

Wirtschaftliche BESS-Nutzung:

Wir vergleichen den Nettovermarktungsbeitrag deiner Speicher mit einem vereinbarten, ausführbaren Referenzmodell unter gleichen technischen Bedingungen und mit denselben verfügbaren Informationen. Im Quartalsdurchschnitt sind mindestens 100 % des Referenzbeitrags herausragend, 95 % im Soll und 90 % der Mindeststandard. Handels-, Ausgleichsenergie- und vereinbarte Alterungskosten werden identisch berücksichtigt.

Qualität der Handelsausführung:

Gemessen werden dokumentierte, vermeidbare Fehler in deinem Verantwortungsbereich, etwa falsche Mengen, Lieferintervalle oder doppelte Orders. Pro Quartal sind 0 Fehler je 1.000 ausgeführte Orders exzellent, höchstens 1 im Plan und höchstens 3 der Mindeststandard.

Reaktion auf kritische Handelsereignisse:

Während deiner vereinbarten Handelsabdeckung zählt die Zeit vom kritischen Alarm bis zur ersten dokumentierten Maßnahme nach dem Eskalationsprozess. Bei 100 % der Fälle sind höchstens 5 Minuten exzellent, 10 Minuten im Soll und 15 Minuten der Mindeststandard.

Produktive Verbesserungen:

Du bringst getestete und genehmigte Strategie- oder Automatisierungsverbesserungen in den produktiven Einsatz. Mit dokumentiertem Ertrags-, Qualitäts- oder Zeitgewinn sind 6 Verbesserungen pro Jahr herausragend, 5 im Plan und 4 das Mindestziel.

Qualifikation

Deine Kompetenzen (Was du mitbringen solltest):

Du hast ein Studium beispielsweise in Mathematik, Statistik, Informatik, Volkswirtschaft oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften abgeschlossen, alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung im quantitativen Stromhandel und in der BESS-Optimierung. Entscheidend ist, dass du Marktverständnis, Programmierung und Risikosteuerung praktisch verbindest.

Fachlich:

  • Handelserfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Stromhandel, einschließlich BESS-Optimierung und Regelenergiemärkten.
  • Strategieverständnis: Du kennst die Marktbedingungen, unter denen deine Strategien funktionieren, und erkennst ihre Grenzen.
  • Programmierung: Du entwickelst selbst in Python, nutzt Claude Code und prüfst erzeugten Code und Handelslogik konsequent.
  • Statistik & Backtesting: Du beherrschst statistische Analysen, erkennst Überanpassung und Datenfehler und bewertest die tatsächliche Ausführbarkeit von Handelschancen.
  • Systeme & Risikosteuerung: Du bringst Erfahrung mit Volue, eine EPEX-Händlerzulassung sowie Kenntnisse in Terminhandel, Hedging und Positionssteuerung mit.

Persönlich:

  • Analytisch & entscheidungsstark: Du triffst begründete Entscheidungen auch bei unvollständigen Informationen.
  • Diszipliniert & verantwortungsbewusst: Du hältst Limits ein, auch wenn eine Handelschance besonders attraktiv erscheint.
  • Pragmatisch & umsetzungsstark: Du bringst Lösungen vom ersten Modell bis zur zuverlässigen Anwendung im Handel.
  • Klar & teamorientiert: Du teilst Erkenntnisse, dokumentierst Strategien und sprichst Fehler früh an.
  • Lernbereit & selbstkritisch: Du änderst deine Strategie, wenn Daten deine bisherigen Annahmen widerlegen.

Core Values:

  • Wetterfeste Problemlöser: Du bleibst bei Preissprüngen und technischen Störungen handlungsfähig und behebst Ursachen systematisch.
  • Bodenständig: Du bewertest Strategien nach ausführbaren Trades und realisierten Ergebnissen.
  • Ambitioniert: Du suchst nach besseren Handelsentscheidungen und skalierbaren Strategien innerhalb unserer Risikogrenzen.
  • Fair: Du legst Ergebnisse, Risiken und Fehler offen und arbeitest verlässlich mit anderen zusammen.
  • Wissbegierig: Du vertiefst dein Markt- und Methodenwissen und teilst deine Erkenntnisse.
  • Clever: Du nutzt Python, Automatisierung und KI, um Entscheidungen zu verbessern und wiederkehrende Arbeit zu reduzieren.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Du baust ein System. Und führst es fachlich.

Du verantwortest Handelsstrategien, die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Trading-Plattform und die fachliche Führung deiner Kollegen. Du verbindest Markt, Assets, Algorithmen und Risikosteuerung zu einem skalierbaren Wertschöpfungssystem mit messbaren Ergebnissen.

  • Du arbeitest mit realen Assets.

Zugriff auf ein stark wachsendes PV-, Wind- und BESS-Portfolio sowie HPC-Infrastruktur. Deine Entscheidungen wirken direkt auf Cashflow und Rendite.

  • Deine Leistung hat einen klaren Gegenwert.

Du erhältst ein Fixgehalt und eine erfolgsabhängige Vergütung. Dein Beitrag zum Handelsergebnis zählt.

  • Du partizipierst am Deckungsbeitrag.

Eine DB1-Beteiligung verbindet deinen Erfolg mit dem wirtschaftlichen Ergebnis. Berechnungsgrundlage und Konditionen vereinbaren wir im Vergütungsmodell.

  • Du bekommst Freiheit. Und Verantwortung.

Du triffst eigene Handelsentscheidungen innerhalb definierter Limits. Befugnisse, Freigaben und Eskalationen sind im Risikohandbuch geregelt.

  • Du handelst. Du programmierst. Du verbesserst.

Du setzt eigene Ideen in Python um und nutzt Claude Code für die Entwicklung. Bei komplexeren Tools steuerst du die Umsetzung fachlich.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in ein bestehendes Trading-Team.

Du arbeitest mit aktuell vier Tradern und berichtest direkt an den Teamlead Trading. Deine Marktkenntnis und Strategien fließen in die gemeinsame Weiterentwicklung ein.

  • München ist deine Basis. Ein mobiler Tag gehört dazu.

Vier Tage pro Woche arbeitest du im Office in München, einen Tag mobil.

  • Du bekommst Freiheit. Und Verantwortung.

Keine Scheinsicherheit, keine Konzernpolitik. Du entscheidest, was skaliert und was endet.

Deine Befugnisse:

  • Orders & Positionen: Entscheide über Trades innerhalb deiner zugewiesenen Limits und freigegebenen Strategien.
  • Assets & Vermarktung: Steuere zugeordnete BESS-Flexibilität innerhalb technischer Grenzen und vertraglicher Verpflichtungen.
  • Strategien & Modelle: Entwickle und teste Handelsansätze. Produktive Änderungen durchlaufen den Freigabeprozess des Risikohandbuchs.
  • Tools & Entwicklung: Setze Python-Lösungen eigenständig um und steuere komplexere Entwicklungen innerhalb vereinbarter Prioritäten und Budgets fachlich.
  • Risiken & Eskalation: Überwache Positionen, leite Maßnahmen innerhalb deiner Befugnisse ein und eskaliere kritische Abweichungen.
  • Märkte & Freigaben: Erarbeite Vorschläge für neue Märkte, Strategien und Algorithmen. Team und Geschäftsführung genehmigen diese gemäß Risikohandbuch.

Du partizipierst unternehmerisch:

Neben einer performance-orientierten Vergütung erhältst du die Möglichkeit, dich direkt an ausgewählten Projekten und Assets zu beteiligen:

  • Beteiligung an realen PV-, BESS- und HPC-Projekten
  • Attraktive, überdurchschnittliche Renditen
  • Du spielst auf Champions-League-Niveau.
  • Du beschleunigst die Energietransformation – messbar.

Nicht über Statements, sondern über wirtschaftlich tragfähige Modelle, die skalieren.

  • Für wen diese Rolle ist

Für Menschen, die:

  • in Ergebnissen denken
  • Entscheidungen treffen, wenn andere zögern
  • Systeme bauen, die ohne sie funktionieren
  • Verantwortung und Upside wollen

Für wen nicht:

  • Bauchgefühl-Trader ohne belastbare Analyse
  • Einzelkämpfer ohne Transparenz über Positionen und Fehler
  • Strategietheoretiker ohne Bereitschaft zur operativen Umsetzung

title: HR Leitung mit Fokus Recruiting (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer sind wir

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 30 High-Performern ist innerhalb von 2 Jahren von 0 auf 1 Mio. € Monatsumsatz gewachsen. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System. Dabei steht und fällt unser Wachstum mit einer Frage: Holen wir die richtigen Menschen ins Team – und erkennen wir früh genug, wenn nicht?

Was für dich drin ist

  • Du führst die gesamte Recruiting-Abteilung und baust die People-Funktion eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit auf
  • Du gibst das System vor, andere setzen es um: Dein Recruiting-Team führt aus, unser Sales & HR Analyst liefert die Zahlen
  • Du bist strategischer Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Wenn eine Abteilung nicht läuft, sitzt du mit am Tisch und sagst, welche Rolle und welcher Mensch fehlt
  • Echte Perspektive: Du besetzt zunehmend Führungskräfte und Schlüsselpositionen in allen Abteilungen und prägst langfristig, wie wir Führungskräfte entwickeln
  • Verdienst ab 75.000 € p. a. plus leistungsbasiertem Bonus
  • Remote möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office in Hockenheim
  • Investition in dein Skill-Development und 4 Team Events pro Jahr

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung und führst das bestehende Team. Du gibst das System vor, also Funnel, Prozesse, SOPs und Kanäle, und entscheidest, wo und wie wir suchen. Für jede Rolle baust du ein Auswahlsystem aus Anforderungsprofilen, Scorecards, strukturierten Interviews, Arbeitsproben, Probetagen, digitalen Assessments und Referenzchecks.

Du besetzt unsere Key-Rollen in Sales und Account Management in hohem Volumen. Dazu kommen zunehmend Führungskräfte, Schlüsselpositionen und Rollen, die es so vorher nicht gab. Diese gewinnst du auch über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur: Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs und Landingpages.

Du kalibrierst alle, die bei uns Interviews führen. Du machst Fehlurteile sichtbar und bringst Gespür und Evidenz zusammen. Die Recruiting-Gespräche deines Teams reviewst du selbst und schlägst Alarm, sobald die Kandidatenqualität sinkt. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst verknüpfst du Probezeit und 90-Tage-Performance mit den Auswahldaten. Scheitern Probezeiten oder bleiben Hires hinter den Erwartungen, passt du die Kriterien an. Du sorgst außerdem dafür, dass Bewerber gut über uns sprechen, auch nach einer Absage. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht daran, wie viele Menschen du einstellst, sondern daran, wie gut sie sind:

  • Probezeit-Bestehensquote und 90-Tage-Performance deiner Hires
  • Trefferquote deiner Auswahlbewertungen
  • Time-to-Hire und Conversion im Funnel
  • Erfolgreich besetzte Führungs- und Schlüsselrollen
  • Performance deines Teams

Nach 90 Tagen stehen ein dokumentierter Auswahlstandard für unsere Key-Rollen und ein Dashboard zur Qualität der Einstellungen, dem die Geschäftsführung vertraut. Und die ersten Key-Hires sind an Bord.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehr als 4 Jahre Erfahrung im internen Recruiting oder in HR mit klarem Recruiting-Schwerpunkt, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer führenden Rolle, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, performance-orientierten Unternehmen
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-Team aufgebaut, geführt und auf Performance gebracht
  • Echtes Gespür für Menschen: Du erkennst den Unterschied zwischen jemandem, der sich gut verkauft, und jemandem, der wirklich liefert
  • Dein Gespür sicherst du mit Struktur ab: Du weißt, welches Werkzeug wann hilft, und kannst jede Entscheidung begründen
  • Sales-Verständnis: Du hast Vertriebsrollen erfolgreich besetzt und kannst präzise erklären, was einen Top-Closer von einem guten Selbstdarsteller unterscheidet
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Besetzung von Teamleads, Heads of und Stabsstellen, auch bei Rollen, die es vorher nicht gab
  • Du baust Systeme, statt nur in ihnen zu arbeiten. Ineffizienzen fallen dir sofort auf, und die Lösung bringst du gleich mit
  • Du gewinnst auch A-Player, die gar nicht suchen, und hältst das Tempo eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens
  • Wenn ein Hire nicht funktioniert, spornt dich das an, statt dass du es erklärst
  • Du gibst der Geschäftsführung eindeutige Empfehlungen, auch wenn sie unbequem sind
  • Recruiting ist für dich Markenarbeit: Jeder Kandidat verlässt den Prozess mit einem guten Gefühl
  • Pluspunkte:
    • Du hast schon eine HR-Abteilung inklusive Mitarbeiterbetreuung und Führungskräfteentwicklung geleitet
    • Du hast eigene Vertriebserfahrung
    • Du kennst High-Volume-Hiring
    • Du hast dich in Eignungsdiagnostik weitergebildet, z. B. mit einem Studium der Wirtschaftspsychologie

title: Ingénieur ou post-doctorant pour l'analyse des données acquises par un radar HF océanographique couvrant le Raz Blanchard
descriptionHtml:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’UFR S2I sur le Campus de Brest.

Projet FLOWATT

Le projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie.

Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin.

Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvellement enregistrées dans le cadre du projet TidalRace. Le système, de technologie WERA, est réparti sur deux sites distants d’environ 5 km au Cap de la Hague et fonctionne à deux fréquences, 13,5 MHz et 24,5 MHz. Les acquisitions sont réalisées en continu, à raison de quatre mesures par heure, 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, sur une emprise couvrant l’ensemble du Raz Blanchard. Cette couverture temporelle et spatiale offre ainsi une opportunité unique de suivre l’évolution des états de mer dans des conditions hydrodynamiques particulièrement contraintes.

L’exploitation de ces données nécessite toutefois d’adapter les méthodes de traitement aux conditions de forts courants. L’objectif des travaux est donc d’améliorer les algorithmes existants et, si nécessaire, d’en développer de nouveaux afin de restituer de manière fiable les spectres d’énergie des vagues en fréquence et en direction, ainsi que les paramètres moyens associés. Une première étape consistera à comprendre les limites des méthodes actuelles, qui ne permettent plus de restituer un état de mer cohérent avec les références disponibles lorsque la vitesse du courant dépasse 1 m/s, comme montré par Lopez et al. (2018). Les méthodes développées seront ensuite évaluées à partir des mesures in situ et des modélisations numériques. Le radar HF constitue ainsi un élément central de ce travail, dont l’amélioration doit permettre de mieux caractériser les états de mer dans les forts courants du Raz Blanchard.

Missions / Activités principales :

Le (la) titulaire du poste sera affecté à l’équipe M3 de l’UMR Lab-STICC et sera en charge des missions principales suivantes :

  • Réaliser une étude bibliographique sur les modèles permettant de décrire l’effet des vagues sur le spectre Doppler mesuré par un radar HF

  • Implémenter un code de simulation intégrant l’effet des vagues à partir d’une description de l’état de mer dans le spectre Doppler

  • Analyser les simulations en les comparant aux mesures réelles pour comprendre l’influence du courant et plus particulièrement des forts courants sur la mesure d’états de mer

  • Proposer et implémenter des évolutions des algorithmes permettant de s’adapter aux forts courants présents sur la zone du Raz Blanchard

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole

Niveau de diplôme et formations

Les candidats doivent être titulaires d’un doctorat et/ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur avec expérience dans un domaine pertinent (océanographie physique côtière, traitement du signal, etc…)

Présentation de l’Ecole

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. title: Ingénieur Sécurité des Procédés - Process Safety Engineer (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
📜 Contexte

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés, vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.

📌 Votre rôle

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés, vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance, ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.

Vos missions

🎯 Responsabilités

🔹 Analyse des risques procédés
• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA.
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1.
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC).
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques.
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA), aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Formation & sensibilisation
• Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.
• Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site.
• Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés.

Vos compétences

💼 Votre profil

• Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent.
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique.
• Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés.
• Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX.
• Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO.
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements.
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes.
• Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques.
• Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie.
• Français courant et bon anglais technique, notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux.

Avantages

• 🕒 Taux d'activité : 100 %

descriptionHtml:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns, empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future
🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance
🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

We believe in the everyday hero.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate
