title: IT Director
descriptionHtml:
IT Director / CIO (m/w/d)

Standort: Frankfurt am Main, Deutschland

Stellenbeschreibung

Über die Position

Als IT Director / CIO sind Sie für die Leitung, Weiterentwicklung und Steuerung sämtlicher lokaler IT-Aktivitäten verantwortlich. Dabei stellen Sie sicher, dass die IT-Strategie und der operative IT-Betrieb sowohl auf die Geschäftsziele als auch auf die globalen IT-Standards des Unternehmens abgestimmt sind.

Ihr Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die IT-Strategie, den IT-Betrieb, die IT-Infrastruktur, Unternehmensanwendungen, Cybersicherheit, Budgetplanung, Dienstleistersteuerung sowie die organisatorische Weiterentwicklung des IT-Bereichs. Ziel ist es, eine effiziente, sichere und regelkonforme Bereitstellung sämtlicher IT-Dienstleistungen sicherzustellen.

In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die zentrale Verantwortung für die lokale IT-Organisation und arbeiten eng mit den globalen IT-Teams und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen, um technologische Initiativen voranzutreiben, die Qualität der IT-Services kontinuierlich zu verbessern und das Unternehmenswachstum zu unterstützen.

Ihre Aufgaben

1. Strategische Planung und Umsetzung

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von IT-Strategien, Initiativen und Maßnahmenplänen im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen.

  • Sicherstellung der erfolgreichen Umsetzung, Überwachung und kontinuierlichen Optimierung genehmigter IT-Maßnahmen.

  • Mitgestaltung der lokalen IT-Roadmap in Abstimmung mit der globalen IT-Strategie und IT-Architektur.

2. IT-Führung und Personalmanagement

  • Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung einer effizienten und skalierbaren IT-Organisationsstruktur.

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung des lokalen IT-Teams.

  • Unterstützung bei Recruiting, Onboarding, Leistungsbeurteilungen, Nachfolgeplanung und Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen.

  • Förderung einer Unternehmenskultur, die durch Eigenverantwortung, Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung geprägt ist.

3. Budgetplanung und Finanzmanagement

  • Erstellung und Steuerung des jährlichen IT-Budgets.

  • Sicherstellung eines wirtschaftlichen und effizienten Einsatzes von IT-Ressourcen und Investitionen.

  • Überwachung der IT-Ausgaben, Kostenkontrolle und Sicherstellung finanzieller Transparenz.

  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung und Kostenoptimierung.

4. IT-Governance, Compliance und Prozessmanagement

  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Unternehmensrichtlinien, Kontrollmechanismen und IT-Prozesse.

  • Aufbau, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung effektiver IT-Governance-Strukturen und operativer Prozesse.

  • Gewährleistung der Einhaltung unternehmensweiter Standards, Sicherheitsanforderungen und regulatorischer Vorgaben.

5. IT-Sicherheit, Recht und Risikomanagement

  • Proaktive Identifikation, Bewertung und Minimierung IT-bezogener Risiken.

  • Sicherstellung angemessener Cybersicherheitsmaßnahmen, Datenschutzstandards und IT-Asset-Management-Prozesse.

  • Unterstützung bei der Einhaltung geltender gesetzlicher, regulatorischer und unternehmensinterner Anforderungen.

  • Berichterstattung über wesentliche IT-Risiken und entsprechende Gegenmaßnahmen an die Geschäftsleitung.

6. IT-Strategie, Architektur und Technologielösungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den globalen IT-Teams bei der Definition von IT-Architekturen, Standards und technologischen Roadmaps.

  • Bewertung, Empfehlung und Implementierung geeigneter IT-Lösungen zur Unterstützung der Geschäftsziele.

  • Sicherstellung, dass lokale IT-Systeme und Dienstleistungen den globalen IT-Frameworks und technischen Vorgaben entsprechen.

7. IT-Projektmanagement, Beschaffung und Dienstleistersteuerung

  • Leitung und Umsetzung lokaler IT-Projekte sowie Initiativen zur Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systeme.

  • Unterstützung bei IT-Beschaffungsprozessen, Dienstleisterbewertungen und der Auswahl geeigneter Lieferanten in Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen IT-Organisation.

  • Steuerung und Überwachung externer IT-Dienstleister hinsichtlich Leistung, Servicequalität und Erfüllung geschäftlicher Anforderungen.

8. IT-Betrieb und Service Management

  • Gesamtverantwortung für den täglichen IT-Betrieb, die IT-Infrastruktur, Unternehmensanwendungen und den Endanwendersupport.

  • Sicherstellung einer effektiven Systemüberwachung, Wartung, Kapazitätsplanung, Modernisierung und Leistungsoptimierung.

  • Weiterentwicklung von Incident- und Problem-Management-Prozessen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der IT-Servicequalität.

  • Gewährleistung einer hohen Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Nutzerzufriedenheit aller IT-Dienstleistungen.

9. Weitere Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Übernahme zusätzlicher Aufgaben und strategischer Initiativen gemäß den Anforderungen der Geschäftsleitung.

Ihr Profil

Fachliche Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

  • Mindestens 8–10 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im IT-Bereich mit zunehmender Verantwortung, einschließlich mehrjähriger Führungserfahrung.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von IT-Betrieb, IT-Infrastruktur, Cybersicherheit und Unternehmensanwendungen in der Automobilindustrie bzw. im Automobilbau.

  • Erfahrung in internationalen Unternehmen sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit globalen IT-Organisationen.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in IT-Governance, Risikomanagement, Compliance und Cybersicherheit.

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in IT-Budgetplanung, Finanzmanagement und Steuerung externer Dienstleister.

  • Ausgeprägte Führungskompetenz sowie hervorragende Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Management- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1-Niveau).

Wünschenswerte Qualifikationen

  • Masterabschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.

  • Relevante Zertifizierungen wie ITIL, PMP, PRINCE2, CISSP, CISM oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen.

  • Erfahrung in der Betreuung von IT-Umgebungen in der Fertigungsindustrie, Automobilindustrie, Technologiebranche oder in multinationalen Unternehmen.

Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen

  • Bruttojahresgehalt: bis zu 140.000 EUR

  • Leistungsabhängiger KPI-Bonus: 15–30 % des Bruttojahresgehalts

  • Weitere Zusatzleistungen gemäß den Unternehmensrichtlinien.

Du arbeitest in einem regulierten Umfeld, in dem Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit zum Produkt gehören. Bei infrastrukturnahen Themen unterstützt Dich unser DevOps-Team.

title: KVGM Medewerker
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij op zoek naar een centrale rol binnen KOERS waarbij kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu bovenaan staan? Dat komt dan mooi uit! Wij zijn op zoek naar een KVGM Medewerker die onze organisatie komt versterken. Solliciteer snel op deze vacature, want jij maakt voor ons het verschil!

Welke uitdagingen krijg jij als KVGM Medewerker?

Als KVGM Medewerker ondersteun je onze organisatie bij het ontwikkelen, uitvoeren en verbeteren van het beleid op gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu. Jij zorgt ervoor dat al onze collega’s hun werk veilig kunnen uitvoeren en draagt bij aan een gezonde werkomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en het management om de kwaliteit, arbeidsomstandigheden en het milieu te optimaliseren.

Welke uitdagingen horen onder andere bij deze functie?

  • Uitvoeren en ondersteunen van werkplekinspecties en veiligheidsrondes. Je bent regelmatig te vinden op onze verschillende bouwlocaties;

  • Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en verbetermogelijkheden en bespreekt dit met de KVGM-coördinator;

  • Deelnemen aan en ondersteunen bij verschillende interne en externe audits;

  • Registeren en onderzoeken van incidenten, ongevallen en bijna-ongevallen;

  • Onderhouden en verbeteren van het KVGM-managementsysteem;

  • Het opstellen van een veiligheidsplan;

  • Het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving zowel op kantoor als op onze diverse bouwplaatsen;

  • Zorgdragen voor draagvlak binnen KOERS van veiligheidsbewustzijn;

  • Het uitvoeren en up to date houden van de RI&E;

  • Het verzorgen van veiligheidsinstructies, toolboxen en voorlichting;

  • Het regelen van keuringen van gereedschap en materieel.

Je standplaats is Barendrecht (Rotterdam), maar bent ook regelmatig op onze diverse projectlocaties (omgeving Randstand) te vinden. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en draagt bij aan periodieke rapportage aan onze Directeur Bouw.

Wat verwachten wij van jou als KVGM Medewerker?

Betrokkenheid, zelfstandigheid, een scherp oog voor veiligheid & kwaliteit en daarnaast plezier in je vak! Maak je werk uitdagender door op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe ideeën en werk daarin samen met je collega’s binnen KOERS. Is dit wat je zoekt? Dan hopen wij dat je over de volgende eigenschappen beschikt:

  • Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau, een opleiding in het vakgebied MVK genoten en ervaring binnen de bouwsector;

  • Kennis van de relevante wet- en regelgeving;

  • Kennis en ervaring omtrent ISO 9001, ISO 14001, VCA en SCL is een pré;

  • Je hebt oog voor risico’s en uitdagingen;

  • Je bent energiek, sociaal, ondernemend en daadkrachtig;

  • Je bent flexibel en bezit het vermogen om snel te kunnen schakelen;

  • Je staat sterk in je (werk)schoenen en hebt oog voor detail.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een verantwoordelijke functie waar je als KAM Medewerker bijdraagt aan het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving. Daarnaast bieden we jou:

  • Een dienstverband van 32-40 uur per week;

  • Een goed salaris dat boven de normen van de cao Bouw en Infra ligt. We gaan hier graag over in gesprek met jouw achtergrond en ervaring als uitgangspunt;

  • Een auto van de zaak met tankpas volgens onze leaseregeling;

  • Een informele werksfeer en gezellige collega’s;

  • Goed geregelde vrije dagen, 30 vakantiedagen, 10 dagen in het tijdspaarfonds en nog 3 dagen kort verzuim. In totaal dus 43 vakantiedagen. Deze zaken zijn uiteraard conform de cao Bouw en Infra;

  • Een goed ingerichte werkplek;

  • Pensioenopbouw conform de richtlijnen van de CAO Bouw en Infra, dit bouwen wij samen op;

  • Een periodieke bijdrage aan je duurzame inzetbaarheid, zodat je gezond kunt blijven werken;

  • De mogelijkheid voor het volgen van opleidingen en/of cursussen, want jouw groei/ontwikkeling vinden wij belangrijk. Wij kijken graag samen met jou naar de mogelijkheden binnen ons opleidingsbudget.

Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst van KOERS?

Wacht dan niet langer en reageer gelijk op deze vacature!

The team

The Telematics team turns raw phone sensor data into meaningful signals about how people drive. The role

Few teams use phone sensor data to price commercial motor insurance at scale. As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll shape how millions of trips are turned into risk signals. You'll own behavioural features and algorithms from hypothesis to production, working at the intersection of data science and engineering on GPS, inertial, and other sensor data.

You'll move between quick heuristics and full ML models depending on what the problem calls for. You ship code to production, not just notebooks!

What you will be doing

  • Design and build the behavioural features and factors that drive Zego's understanding of driving quality, context and risk

  • Turn raw, high-frequency GPS, accelerometer and gyroscope data into usable signal at a scale of more than 250,000 trips a day

  • Research new behavioural features and detection algorithms, reading the literature, testing ideas and killing the ones that do not survive contact with real data

  • Take work from hypothesis to production, prototyping in notebooks then writing the production-grade Python and SQL that scales

  • Choose the simplest solution that holds, rule-based when that is enough and machine learning when it is warranted

  • Lead experiments, validate impact with data, and automate insight generation

  • Get features into the pricing path alongside engineers, product managers and actuaries, and translate what the sensor data shows into findings non-technical colleagues can act on

What you will need to be successful

  • Quantitative foundations. An MSc, or integrated MEng or MSc, in engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics or a similar field. This is a core role and it needs strong engineering foundations

  • Signal processing instinct. Working knowledge of digital signal processing or sensor physics. You can reason about noise, sampling, filtering and the physical meaning behind a signal, not just its numbers

  • Production-grade delivery. A proven track record taking data science or data engineering projects into production, with strong Python and SQL (we use Snowflake) and the scientific Python stack: Polars, Pandas, NumPy, SciPy and scikit-learn. You have designed, built and maintained reliable, observable pipelines from scratch

  • Machine learning judgement. Experience developing and evaluating ML models on tabular data, classification or regression, where the evaluation matters as much as the model choice

  • Clear communication. You turn ambiguous problems into structured, testable ideas and share insights clearly with technical and non-technical audiences

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable

Nice to haves

  • Experience applying signal processing to noisy, high-frequency sensor/time-series data (GPS, accelerometer, IMU) in production

  • Exposure to insurance, mobile data, or behaviour modelling

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), or data orchestration frameworks

  • Familiarity with our ML and tooling stack: MLflow for experiment tracking, DVC for data versioning, Streamlit for internal apps and demos

What it's like to work at Zego

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.

Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards: moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.

This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

The Role:

As a Lead Solutions Architect specializing in containerized solutions, you will play a crucial, pioneering role in this new initiative. Your primary focus will be leading the deployment of these solutions within our customer environments.

Solutions Architects are vital members of our project teams, often serving as the initial technical point of contact for our customers and key technical stakeholders for a successful deployment of Celonis. To ensure our customers achieve value, you will drive the technical setup required to leverage the full range of Celonis features and functionalities, including process mining, execution management, process automation, Action Flow, and task mining.

Given the unique nature of every customer environment, you will be the key liaison for translating the customer's technical requirements to ensure successful deployment on the clients infrastructure and successful integrations with their source systems. Furthermore, you will lead discussions on user management and authentication, acting as a technical partner to remove any technical barriers to user adoption.

The work you’ll do:

  • On Celonis side you are the key technical stakeholder for a successful technical delivery and onboarding of Celonis for enterprise clients.
  • Lead technical discussions to analyze customer architecture, recommend optimal solutions, and facilitate deployment, managing expectations amidst technical constraints.
  • Remove technical obstacles to maximize Celonis user adoption, clarifying technical risks and necessary tradeoffs.
  • Promote reusability by choosing between dedicated customer solutions and broader platform enhancements in collaboration with Celonis product development.
  • Establish real-time data integrations between customer systems and Celonis via APIs and internal tools.
  • Guide customers on authentication, user/group management, and provisioning best practices. Thus, removing all technical barriers to drive user adoption of Celonis.

The qualifications you need:

  • Proven experience of 7+ years, with at least 3 years in deploying and managing containerized applications on Kubernetes.
  • Advanced knowledge with at least one specific Kubernetes distribution (Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, RedHat OpenShift, etc.).

title: LNG Commodity Owner
descriptionHtml:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

LNG Commodity Owner, Sparta Commodities

Singapore, Geneva or London

 

LNG moves on netbacks, shipping and a handful of hubs that rarely agree with each other. Plenty of people write about that. We want the person who builds the system that connects all the pieces of the puzzle, and then puts it in front of traders and makes it sell.

Sparta is building the data platform that energy traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex. LNG is our next vertical, and we want an exceptional builder to lead it.

 

The role

 

This is a builder's seat. It isn't just an analyst position, a sales role or a thought-leadership seat. You will be leading the development of Sparta's LNG offering, from the first netback model to the AI analyst that puts together a forward view on LNG markets autonomously, working with our engineering, product, data and commercial teams. You will set the direction and stay hands-on: prototyping, testing and shipping with the team, not handing over a spec and waiting. Building on its own is not enough. The job is to build a product LNG desks will pay for, which means time with clients is as much a part of the role as time in the code.

 

We are looking for someone who knows LNG deeply: JKM, TTF and Henry Hub relationships, netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures. Your job is to turn that knowledge into products. Expect a good part of your week to be hands-on with AI coding tools: prototyping a pricing model in Python, standing up a data pipeline, creating market-leading knowledge graphs that an AI agent follows and testing its answers against desk judgement. The rest goes on working with engineers to harden, scale and ship what the team builds.

 

The role reports to our Head of Commodities.

 

What you'll do

 

Building products, data pipelines and AI agents (~55% of role)

  • Lead the design and build of Sparta's LNG product set: netbacks, arbitrage routes, delivered price curves and the analytical tools that sit on top of them

  • Build the LNG expert inside Leonidas with our AI engineers: the tools it calls, the domain rules it follows and the knowledge base behind them

  • Build automated products with the team: a daily LNG brief autonomously written by AI analyst, alerts on the curves and spreads that matter, and the quality checks that catch errors before clients see them

  • Build evaluation sets that test the AI against desk judgement, and keep them passing as the product changes

  • Build the data pipelines behind the vertical with data and engineering colleagues: price inputs, freight and regas assumptions, vessel and terminal data, route onboarding and automated data quality checks

  • Ship to production with engineering through our normal process (pull requests, code review, tests, CI), and hold the bar on scale, security and reliability

 

Owning the LNG vertical (~25% of role)

  • Own the LNG vertical end to end: what we build, how well it works and how it performs commercially

  • Set and sequence the LNG roadmap with product and technology, so clients get something useful early and more every few weeks

  • Write the rules: the LNG conventions, definitions and desk judgement that every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Lead the people working on LNG across product, engineering and data: set priorities, unblock them and raise the bar on quality

  • Be the person the business comes to for any LNG decision

 

Building a product clients pay for (~20% of role)

  • Lead discovery conversations and technical demos with LNG trading desks, analysts and commercial teams, and use what they tell you to decide what to build next

  • Work with sales and account management on the first LNG deals and on adding LNG to existing oil and freight accounts: you bring the market credibility and the product, sales runs the commercial process

  • Give sales a clear account of what the product does and why a desk would pay for it, so they can sell it without you in the room

  • Represent Sparta at industry events, conferences and client visits as the LNG expert

 

What we're looking for

 

Required

  • Deep LNG market expertise: strong working knowledge of global LNG pricing (JKM, TTF, Henry Hub and the relationships between them), netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures

  • A track record of building, not just specifying: tools, models, pipelines or products you built hands-on and that other people rely on

  • Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with the rest of a modern stack: APIs, databases, cloud services and version control

  • Heavy, daily use of AI coding tools to prototype and ship far faster than a traditional build cycle, and the judgement to spot where an LLM gets the market wrong

  • Ownership and drive: you scope the problem, pull in the right people, get it built and shipped, and fix it when it breaks, without waiting for a detailed spec

  • Credible in front of trading desks: able to run a discovery call and a technical demo, and to hear what a client will pay for and what they won't

  • Experience leading or working closely with engineers, and the technical credibility to set direction with them

  • Experience in a commodity-facing role within energy trading, data/analytics, financial services or a closely related field

  • Ability to turn market complexity into rules, tests and code that make an AI agent answer like a good desk analyst

 

Desirable

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM applications: tool calling, prompt design, retrieval and evaluation

  • Experience shipping work to production alongside an engineering team (code review, testing, CI/CD)

  • Familiarity with LNG data sources: price assessments, vessel tracking and shipping data, terminal and regasification data

  • Experience with pricing, data or analytics platforms in the energy space, or with building one from scratch

  • An existing network within the LNG trading community

 

What success looks like

 

In your first six months, you will have:

  • Led the build and launch of the first version of Sparta's LNG offering: netbacks, arbitrage routes and delivered price curves in clients' hands

  • Built, with the AI team, an LNG expert in Leonidas that answers the way a good desk analyst would, with an evaluation set that proves it

  • Launched at least one automated product, such as a daily brief or a set of alerts, that runs every day

  • Written the LNG rules every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Set up, with data and engineering, pipelines that run and check themselves, so the vertical scales without manual work

  • Put the product in front of LNG desks, helped sales land the first LNG clients, and fed what the market told you back into the roadmap

 

Is this you?

 

This role is for you if you'd rather build the tool than write the note about it, you like being hands-on, you make the people around you build faster too, and you measure what you've built by whether a desk will pay for it. It probably isn't for you if the part of the job you enjoy most is publishing your market view, or you'd rather hand over a spec than help build what's in it.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

title: M&A Associate (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

You'll be paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world ML projects we actually need done. Many classes and activities are shared with our Software Engineering interns, while others focus specifically on machine learning applications and techniques.

Machine learning is a critical pillar of Jane Street's global business. Our ever-changing trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. If you’d like to learn more, you can have a look at our Machine Learning page.

During the programme, you'll work on projects mentored closely by the full-time employees who designed them. Some projects consider big-picture questions that we're still trying to figure out, while others involve building something new. You will get access to our growing GPU cluster containing thousands of H100/H200/B200s and gain an understanding of the differences between textbook machine learning and its application to noisy financial data.

The interview process follows the same structure as our Software Engineering Intern interviews, with one key addition: after your initial technical coding interview over Zoom, you'll have an on-site interview with 2-4 technical rounds, including one dedicated to assessing ML engineering skills.

Learn more about Jane Street's internship programme here.

About You

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • An undergraduate, postgraduate or PhD student with practical experience training an ML model, working on an ML library, or optimising an ML workflow
  • A top-notch programmer with a love for technology
  • Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn
  • Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes
  • Fluent in English

title: Manager Customer Data Engineering – Change & IT Customer Services
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de datafundering van de Customer Services-organisatie van morgen?

Als Manager Customer Data Engineering ontwikkel je een ervaren engineeringteam door naar een strategisch Data Product Team.

Je brengt data, technologie en business samen en zorgt voor betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten.

Zo maak je met jouw leiderschap direct impact op besluitvorming, klantbediening én de verdere digitale ontwikkeling van Athora.

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

De Manager Data Customer Engineering rapporteert aan de Director Change & IT Customer Services en geeft leiding aan een team van 10 data engineers en DevOps engineers. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor betrouwbare, herleidbare en bruikbare data voor interne
bedrijfsvoering en sturing, operationele besluitvorming, externe verantwoordingsrapportages en toekomstige AI-toepassingen binnen het Customer Services en Commerce domein. De Manager Data Engineering is verantwoordelijk voor de doorontwikkeling van het huidige
uitvoerende data- en rapportageteam naar een strategisch Data Product Team. De rol versterkt de data engineering capability binnen Customer Services door betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten te realiseren voor operationele sturing, besluitvorming, externe verantwoording en toekomstige data en AI-toepassingen. De manager borgt dat data een betrouwbare weergave vormt van businessprocessen en portalen, dat API's een robuuste en betrouwbare brug vormen tussen applicaties, en dat data-delivery plaatsvindt via Agile werkwijzen, schaalbare data engineering, gecontroleerde DevOps-processen en structurele datakwaliteitsborging.


Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Ontwikkelen van het Data Engineering team naar een strategisch Data Product Team met end-to-end eigenaarschap voor betrouwbare en waardevolle dataproducten;

  • Het doorvertalen van de Athora datastrategie binnen Customer Services, inclusief het verhogen van datamanagement maturity en het borgen van data lineage en traceerbaarheid. Hiertoe behoort ook de functionele sturing op de DQ processen, de functionele sturing richting de data stewards om de meting van en verbeteringen in de datakwaliteit vorm te geven;

  • Leveren van betrouwbare, herleidbare, bruikbare en AI-ready data voor interne sturing, operationele besluitvorming, externe verantwoording en toekomstige AI-toepassingen;

  • Borgen van datakwaliteit en een consistente datarepresentatie van businessprocessen, portalen, klantinteracties en operationele ketens binnen Customer Services.


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in informatica, data engineering, data science, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • 10-15 jaar ervaring met data engineering, IT delivery, DevOps, applicatieontwikkeling, dataplatformen of digitale transformatie, bij voorkeur in financiele dienstverlening;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen van data engineers, DevOps engineers, IT engineering professionals en/of multidisciplinaire data delivery teams;

  • Ervaring met het realiseren van dataproducten, rapportageketens, data-integraties, operationele stuurinformatie en externe verantwoordingsrapportages;

  • Sterke kennis van data engineering, datamodellering, datavisualisatie, data pipelines, metadata, lineage, datakwaliteit, DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring, cloud, API's, APIM, security-bydesign en beheerbaarheid;

  • Ervaring met .NET-applicaties, integratiemodernisering, ESB-services, API-management, berichtenverkeer, datafundamenten en persoons- of klantadministraties;

  • Ervaring met het vertalen van datastrategie, target architecture en businessprioriteiten naar concrete data roadmaps, technische keuzes en implementatieplannen;

  • Kennis van AI-ready data, verantwoord datagebruik, datagovernance, automatisering en de toepassing van datafundamenten voor toekomstige AI-toepassingen;

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement richting business, reporting, IT, architectuur, data & AI, security, risk, compliance, leveranciers en senior management;

  • Kennis van wet- en regelgeving, IT risk, privacy, security, datakwaliteit, DORA, EU AI Act en compliance-eisen binnen een gereguleerde omgeving;

  • Ervaring met SAFe Agile standaarden en Agile data-delivery;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wij geloven dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Door de kennis en ervaring die zij meebrengen, maar ook door wie zij zijn. Naast de vier Athora kerncompetenties (moed, klantgerichtheid, samenwerken en resultaten leveren) zijn dit de vier belangrijkste competenties voor de Manager:

  • Data Engineering: Data product leiderschap: ontwikkelt visie op betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten die waarde creëren voor business, reporting, compliance en toekomstige AI-toepassingen.

  • Executiekracht: vertaalt datastrategie, architectuur en businessbehoeften naar roadmaps, dataproducten en voorspelbare Agile delivery.

  • Engineering mindset: stimuleert vakmanschap, kwaliteit, ownership, DevOps, automatisering, beheerbaarheid en continue verbetering binnen data engineering.

  • Datakwaliteit en control mindset: borgt dat data aantoonbaar betrouwbaar, traceerbaar, gecontroleerd en geschikt is voor besluitvorming, rapportage en verantwoording. Samenwerken met business, pensioenexperts, architectuur, data & AI, security, platformteams en leveranciers, inclusief contracteigenaarschap, contract- en leverancierssturing voor de leveranciers van relevante applicaties en oplossingen.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 18 HAY is de range € 7.060,37 tot € 9.413,82 op basis van 36 uur.

title: Marketingmanager:in
descriptionHtml:
Wie sieht Dein Traum-Arbeitsumfeld aus? Spannende Projekte, coole Kunden, nette Kollegen, faire Bezahlung und flexible Arbeitszeiten?

Na logisch! Eine Aufgabe in einer Branche im Wandel und ein echter Trendsetter als Arbeitgeber?

Super, wir sollten uns kennenlernen!

Darum geht‘s:

Marketing ist für uns kein Selbstzweck.

Wir schalten keine Anzeigen, um Reichweite zu erzeugen.

Wir schalten Anzeigen, um qualifizierte Interessenten zu gewinnen, die später zu erfolgreichen Kunden werden.

Genau dafür suchen wir Verstärkung.

Deine wichtigste Aufgabe besteht darin, unsere Leadgenerierung kontinuierlich auszubauen und zu verbessern.

Dazu planst, steuerst und optimierst Du Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta und Google und sorgst dafür, dass aus Werbebudget messbare Ergebnisse entstehen.

Du analysierst Zahlen, erkennst Muster und findest heraus, welche Kampagnen, Zielgruppen und Botschaften wirklich funktionieren.

Dabei betrachtest Du nicht nur einzelne Anzeigen, sondern den gesamten Weg des Interessenten:

Von der ersten Anzeige über die Landingpage bis hin zum qualifizierten Lead.

Aufgaben

Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

  • Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung unserer Meta- und Google-Kampagnen
  • Kontinuierliche Skalierung unserer Leadgenerierung
  • Analyse von Landingpages, Formularstrecken und Conversion-Prozessen
  • Entwicklung und Durchführung von A/B-Tests
  • Auswertung relevanter KPIs wie CPL, CTR, CPC, Conversion Rate und ROI
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Vertrieb zur Verbesserung der Leadqualität
  • Identifikation neuer Wachstumschancen entlang der Customer Journey
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung unserer Marketing- und Wachstumsstrategie

Kurz gesagt:

Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Marketing messbares Wachstum wird.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Ergebnisse erzielen will.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn Du:

  • Zahlen liebst und Entscheidungen lieber auf Basis von Daten als auf Basis von Bauchgefühl triffst.
  • Spaß daran hast, Kampagnen zu analysieren, zu optimieren und immer wieder neue Ideen zu testen.

  • Marketing nicht als Kreativspielplatz, sondern als Wachstumsmotor verstehst.
  • Strukturiert arbeitest und auch bei vielen Daten den Überblick behältst.
  • Neugierig bist und ständig dazulernen möchtest.

Idealerweise bringst Du bereits Erfahrung mit:

  • Google Ads
  • Meta Ads
  • Leadgenerierung
  • Conversion-Optimierung
  • Tracking und Analytics
  • digitalen Sales-Funnels

Wichtiger als Zertifikate oder Abschlüsse ist für uns jedoch Deine Einstellung.

Wir suchen niemanden, der Kampagnen verwaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Wachstum erzeugt. Wir suchen einen Macher.

Jemanden, der Dinge ausprobiert, Verantwortung übernimmt und Freude daran hat, gemeinsam mit einem ambitionierten Team messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Wenn Du nach einem Umfeld suchst, in dem gute Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden und Erfolge sichtbar sind, dann macht unser morgiger Termin Sinn.

Benefits

Das bieten wir:

Wir verbringen einen großen Teil unseres Lebens bei der Arbeit.

Deshalb finden wir, dass Arbeit mehr sein sollte als das bloße Abarbeiten von Aufgaben.

Bei MediKom arbeitest Du jeden Tag daran, Arztpraxen erfolgreicher, wirtschaftlicher und zukunftssicherer zu machen.

Du hilfst Unternehmern dabei, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen, ihre Praxen weiterzuentwickeln und mehr Lebensqualität zu gewinnen.

Das ist nicht nur spannend – sondern auch sinnvoll.

Darüber hinaus erwartet Dich:

  • Direkter Einfluss auf den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine attraktive, leistungsorientierte Vergütung
  • Ein motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel gegenseitiger Unterstützung
  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel und ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld
  • Eine sehr gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

Kurz gesagt:

Wenn Du Lust hast, nicht nur einen Job zu machen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Das sind wir:

Die MediKom Consulting GmbH ist eine auf Mediziner spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung. Mit einem Team aus 12 festen und freien Mitarbeitern entwickeln wir passgenaue, wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Lösungen, die Arztpraxen und Health-Care-Providern dabei helfen, Abläufe zu verbessern, Prozesse zu optimieren und ihre Ziele zu erreichen.

Unser junges, motiviertes Team arbeitet eng mit einem erfahrenen Management zusammen. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist von Offenheit, einem kollegialen Miteinander und Innovation geprägt.

Mit über 350 begleiteten Praxen bringen wir fundierte Erfahrung mit und sind die erste Anlaufstelle für Praxisinhaber, wenn es um die Optimierung der Wirtschaftlichkeit und die Zukunftssicherung von Arztpraxen geht. Wir liefern messbare Ergebnisse und setzen auf eine transparente Vergütungsstruktur – abgerundet durch eine Erfolgsgarantie, die unseren Kunden Sicherheit bietet.

Klingt das interessant?

Dann her mit deiner Bewerbung. Dein neues Team ist schon gespannt auf dich!

In unserem kleinen Team ist es wichtig, dass wir zusammen anpacken. Das bedeutet, dass jeder auch bereichsübergreifend arbeitet. Unser Team möchte viel bewegen. Deswegen arbeiten wir mit viel Liebe zum Detail und gleichzeitig sehr fokussiert sowie mit viel Ehrgeiz, um unsere ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen. title: Member of Technical Staff, Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
LOCATION: King’s Cross, London · PATTERN: Hybrid, with regular time in the lab

The opportunity

We’re a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You’d help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role builds our analysis from the start. Every result leaves an instrument as a trace or a vendor file, and it has to become a value someone can rely on, linked back to the sequence and sample it came from. That means fitting it properly, checking it against controls, catching the plate or reagent lot that drifted, and showing the evidence. Someone has to own that work. That is this role.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. We’ll share more about what we’re building once you’ve spoken with the team.

The role

You will join the intelligence team and own the analysis of our assay data, and the data and ML infrastructure it runs on, from the point the data has been captured to the result that gets delivered. You will work most closely with the protein characterisation scientists who run the assays, and with the software team, who get data out of the instruments and own the platform it lives on. You build on top of that platform, and you own the quality of the analysis that runs on it.

The role is part data engineer and part biostatistician, and all of the data is biological. Much of it is building the analysis and ML pipelines that run on our captured data, and the statistics inside them. The rest is presenting those results clearly, with the statistics that matter, such as uncertainty and QC, shown in a form they can understand. The value is in doing that carefully, in code that behaves the same way on every run.

What you will own

● Analysis and ML pipelines that turn captured assay and sequence data into consistent, versioned datasets, linked to the sequence, sample, plate and well each result came from, built with the software team who own data capture.

● Data validation before any analysis runs, catching a mislabelled plate, a swapped sample or a missing well.

● Sequence-level bioinformatics, such as computing the properties of each protein sequence and checking constructs for problems before the DNA is ordered.

● Biostatistics for experimental data: experimental design, replicates and controls, error propagation, outlier handling, and assay acceptance criteria, such as CV across replicates, Z′ for plate assays, and reference standards staying within range.

● Curve fitting, including dose-response (EC50 and IC50) with sound normalisation and fits to SPR, BLI, HPLC and nanoDSF traces, with a measure of confidence on each fitted parameter and automated QC that sends doubtful fits to a person.

● Detection of plate, lot and batch effects across a dataset before it is delivered, and control charting of reference standards so drift shows up over weeks as well as within a run.

● The data visualisation that accompanies each delivered result, showing it with its uncertainty, QC and batch structure, so anyone can understand and check it without asking us.

Who you are

You have worked with messy experimental data and built things other people relied on. That might have been in a biotech or pharma team, an academic lab, a core facility, or a data-heavy field outside biology where you have since picked up the biology. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

You are happy to get your hands dirty on the data. Much of the job is careful, repeated work on real instrument output, and we want someone who takes pride in doing that well. You write code other people can run, and you care how a result reads to the person receiving it.

Seniority is not what we are screening for. We are open to someone early in their career and to someone with many years behind them. What we look for is depth and judgement on experimental data.

We do not hire people into boxes. This role will stretch past its description, sometimes into the lab and sometimes into conversations beyond the team. Early hires here are expected to pick up what is in front of them.

Must have

● Building and running production data and ML pipelines, ideally on scientific or lab data, including data modelling, validation and reproducible, versioned workflows.

● Handling the specifics of biological data: plate layouts, sample and reagent lot lineage, and protein and DNA construct sequences with the standard tools for working with them.

● Biostatistics for experimental data, including experimental design, replicates and controls, curve fitting, and separating batch effects from biology.

● Statistical process control and anomaly detection, so assay drift and instrument variability are caught early.

● Data visualisation for people outside your team, presenting results with their uncertainty and QC so they can understand and check them themselves.

● Fluency in Python and its scientific stack, including pandas, NumPy and SciPy, and in working with coding agents.

● SQL and relational schema design for samples, plates and results.

● Turning scientists’ questions into requirements, and writing down the assumptions behind them.

Nice to have

● Hands-on analysis of instrument output from a lab, especially trace-based data such as SPR or HPLC.

● R for statistical modelling, such as dose-response fitting or mixed models for plate and batch effects.

● Containers and cloud infrastructure, such as Docker, Kubernetes and AWS.

● Working with data from LIMS, electronic lab notebooks or lab data standards.

● Current protein language models and structure prediction, such as ESM C, Boltz-2, Chai, OpenFold3 or AlphaFold 3.

Why this is unusual

Most assay data analysis happens far from the lab, on files someone exported weeks earlier, with little record of how the experiment ran. Here you sit next to the lab, the conditions of every run are recorded, and your analysis is delivered alongside the data.

The work also changes under you. The lab starts with people running the instruments and becomes automated over time, and the analysis you first build by hand becomes the checks that run on every result.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. It’s worth knowing in advance which one you are.

How we work

The role is based in London, at our lab and office in King’s Cross. Time in person with the scientists matters for this work. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building.

We work in the open. Decisions are written down and work happens in Slack. The whole company meets once a week at the start of the week, and there is a regular offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late.

UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows.

The team you will join

You will report to the intelligence lead. You will also work closely with the founders and with the protein characterisation scientists whose data you will analyse.

We are a small, elite team, weighted towards science and software. You will be the first person on the intelligence team whose focus is the analysis and ML infrastructure behind our results.

Our process

Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work and what you value, run from the same template for every candidate. A technical stage built on a real analysis problem from our lab, not a puzzle. You spend a few hours writing up how you would approach it, using the tools you would use on the job, coding agents included, with a short note on the decisions you made. We care about judgement more than hours, so a focused answer beats an exhaustive one. We then go through it with you in person. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand.

If you are not sure whether you are a fit, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

title: ML Data & Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an ML Data & Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure that powers our speech AI models: the pipelines that source and prepare training data, and the platform that trains, evaluates, and serves them in production. Speech AI has a data problem most ML teams don't, and you'll be at the centre of solving it, working as part of our ML team to remove friction across the entire lifecycle and get better models into production faster.

This is a broad, cross-functional role suited to someone who enjoys working across the full stack: data infrastructure, distributed systems, and production ML, and who takes ownership of problems end to end rather than waiting to be told what to fix.

What you'll do

  • Designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating, and storing large datasets used to train our models
  • Developing and maintaining web scraping and data acquisition solutions to keep training datasets fresh, high-quality, and available at scale
  • Building and operating the infrastructure that lets the ML team deploy and evaluate new models quickly, and that serves models efficiently and reliably in production
  • Optimising infrastructure for both iteration speed and production reliability, including GPU utilisation, job scheduling, and training efficiency
  • Implementing observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) across data pipelines and ML systems to catch issues early and keep things running smoothly
  • Troubleshooting complex issues across distributed systems, spanning data infrastructure, training, and inference
  • Continuously improving our data and MLOps practices, and helping shape the roadmap for how our platform evolves as we scale

What you'll need

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with a solid backend or data engineering foundation
  • Hands-on experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and working with a major cloud provider
  • Experience building data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes at scale, including web scraping or automated data collection
  • A solid understanding of the ML lifecycle, from data through to model training, evaluation, and serving
  • Experience with data quality practices (validation, cleaning, normalisation) and/or production-grade observability
  • Ability to design resilient, scalable architectures, and comfort operating and troubleshooting distributed systems
  • MLOps experience, for example model serving, experiment tracking, GPU/distributed training optimisation, or reproducible ML workflows
  • A self-starter mentality: comfortable identifying problems and driving fixes without needing detailed direction

We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who we are:

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

What we can offer you:

While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
descriptionHtml:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, or atmospheric sciences.

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

Apply with the button on this page. Links to papers or code are welcome.

title: ML Ops Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our ML teams build and optimize the models at the core of our autonomy stack. As a team scales, the workflow the models run on needs to move from a manual, organically grown setup onto a controlled, automated, and reproducible footing.

As an MLOps Engineer, operating out of Paris, Lausanne, or Zurich, you will own that machinery, across training and evaluation pipelines, CI, experiment tracking, and reproducibility, so that models are trained, benchmarked, and compared in a controlled and repeatable way. You free the modelers to focus on models rather than infrastructure, and you set the standard the team builds on.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Training & Evaluation Pipelines: Build and maintain the reproducible training and evaluation pipelines the modelers run on, along with the pipeline templates and tooling they build on. The verdict on model quality stays with the modelers.

  • CI & Reproducibility: Bring CI to ML work and make runs genuinely comparable across code, config, and models.

  • Model Registry: Maintain a model lifecycle registry, from sandbox to production.

  • Experiment Tracking & Logging: Keep results comparable and traceable across the team.

  • Test Automation: Help wire on-device and hardware-in-the-loop test runs into automation and collect the results.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: A degree in a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical pipeline, CI, and reproducibility experience matters more than the specific degree.

  • MLOps Experience: Built and maintained ML pipelines, CI, and experiment tracking in a real production or research setting, ideally taking a manual flow and making it controlled and reproducible.

  • Engineering: Strong in Python and software engineering for infrastructure.

  • Bonus: Experience wiring pipelines to on-device or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

  • Attributes: Systematic, reliability-minded, and service-oriented so the team is enabled, pragmatic, and good at reducing friction.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
