title: Principal Applied AI Scientist, Commerce Foundation Models
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the team

Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, ecommerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced applied scientist to help set LCM’s research direction and work directly on its most demanding scientific problems. This is a hands-on individual contributor role in a flat team of around 30 engineers, with no direct reports. You will mentor colleagues and contribute to hiring, but you will not manage people.

We define how a capability will be evaluated before developing it, and use that evidence to guide training and deployment decisions. You will help decide which research questions deserve investment, design and run experiments, and develop training methods that can be used across applications.

The role requires deep expertise in a core area of model training and the judgment to connect that work with decisions about data, evaluation and deployment. Scientists and engineers work together from the first experiment through to production evaluation, and you will take scientific responsibility for agreed research projects.

A central research goal is to learn from a continuous stream of billions of user sessions across the portfolio and turn useful signals into regular updates to model weights.

What the role involves

  • Develop the research agenda with the team, identifying questions that affect model quality, training efficiency or downstream results. Use experiments to decide which approaches warrant larger training runs and which should be revised or stopped.

  • Lead selected research projects through implementation, training and evaluation, staying directly involved in writing code, inspecting data, debugging runs and analysing failures.

  • Establish evaluation methods that separate real improvements from leakage, noise and benchmark overfitting, and work with portfolio teams to test whether offline gains hold in controlled online experiments.

  • Mentor scientists and engineers through joint research, experiment reviews and technical discussion, and advise on work that crosses project boundaries.

  • Contribute to hiring, publish research and support the release of models, benchmarks and training methods where the work and data can be shared.

Research areas

The initial focus will depend on your expertise and the team’s priorities. We expect substantial depth in one of the two areas below, with the ability to contribute to decisions across the other.

Pre-training and representations

We continue pre-training open-weight models on commerce data. Research questions include how to represent users and catalogues, how to combine data from different businesses, and how to allocate compute effectively. Work may include:

  • Studying data mixtures, scaling behaviour and training schedules to guide the next run.

  • Designing sequences from user histories, merchant catalogues and market data, including alignment between text and semantic IDs for users, items and merchants.

  • Developing mid-training methods for capability acquisition, context extension and retention of general capabilities.

  • Evaluating synthetic data and distillation methods through controlled experiments, including the trade-offs between quality, inference cost and latency.

  • Studying transfer across languages, markets and commerce categories, with evaluations for new users and items and for performance on future data.

  • Tabular foundation models are a possible specialisation, including pre-training and in-context learning on structured commerce data.

Post-training and continual learning

We train LCM for commerce tasks and a range of agent applications, including customer-facing assistants and agents that carry out business operations. We also develop continual learning methods that turn new interactions into regular updates to model weights. Work may include:

  • Developing supervised fine-tuning, preference optimisation and reinforcement learning methods, using verifiable outcomes or learned reward models.

  • Turning session histories, searches, clicks, purchases, repeat orders and operator feedback into training examples and rewards, accounting for exposure bias, delayed feedback and the difference between observed engagement and incremental business value.

  • Studying data selection, replay and update frequency so models learn from new interactions without losing established capabilities.

  • Training and evaluating decision models that choose rankings, offers and promotions, using offline learning and off-policy evaluation to estimate policy value and uncertainty and inform controlled online experiments.

  • Training models for multi-turn conversations and multi-step agent workflows, including understanding user intent, planning, tool use, maintaining context, recovering from errors and verifying outcomes. This includes building RL environments with simulated users and catalogues, and testing whether gains transfer to real interactions within defined permissions and business rules.

  • Calibrating reward models and LLM-based graders against expert judgments and observed outcomes, and investigating reward hacking and other unintended effects.

  • Developing automated experimentation methods that propose and test changes to training recipes, prompts, tools or agent control flow, with held-out evaluations and regression checks.

How we evaluate the work

Research should produce evidence that supports a training or deployment decision. We use strong baselines, including existing production systems, and weigh model quality against compute requirements, inference cost and latency.

Experiments should be reproducible, with ablations, uncertainty estimates and failure analysis. They must account for temporal leakage, changes in the data distribution and differences between companies and markets. Negative results are valuable when they explain a limitation or stop further investment in an approach that does not work.

The work also involves data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories, together with our data and engineering teams.

In the first three months, we expect you to establish a focused research programme, resolve an important training or evaluation question, and work with the relevant teams to test the resulting method in a downstream application.

Minimum qualifications

  • A PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field.

  • At least eight years of research or applied science experience in machine learning, including doctoral research, with at least four years leading research directions that were published or reached production.

  • Substantial experience developing and training models, with deep expertise in pre-training, post-training or reinforcement learning relevant to the areas above.

  • A record of original contributions, shown through research papers, released models, benchmarks, open-source projects or significant advances in deployed systems.

  • Scientific leadership: choosing research directions, resolving difficult technical questions and helping experienced colleagues make better decisions.

  • Sound experimental and statistical judgment, including examples where the evidence changed your approach and the ability to recognise when the evidence does not support a conclusion.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills and the ability to work independently in a shared research codebase. Research on large language models requires hands-on experience with distributed training.

  • Clear communication and a collaborative approach to disagreement, review and mentoring.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with recommender systems, generative retrieval, semantic IDs, continual learning, synthetic data, distillation or tabular foundation models.

  • Familiarity with commerce data and online experimentation.

  • We do not expect expertise in every area.

What we offer

  • Influence over LCM’s research agenda and which questions the team invests in.

  • Proprietary commerce data, B300 and H200 GPUs for large-scale training, and external models for evaluation and benchmarking.

  • The opportunity to take research from early experiments through publication and deployment, working directly with portfolio teams on products used by millions of people.

  • Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems.

  • An uncapped budget to recruit and mentor research interns for your projects, with access to candidates through our connections with leading universities.

  • Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants.

  • A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role.

  • Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro.

How to apply

Please include examples of research or deployed work that show your contribution, the decisions involved and the evidence used to evaluate the results, and indicate which research area best matches your depth.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: Principal Transformation Consultant
descriptionHtml:

As a Principal Transformation Consultant, you will be responsible for managing key client relationships, ensuring the successful delivery of consulting engagements, and driving business growth. You will act as a strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, helping them navigate complex transformation initiatives, including large-scale cloud migrations and technology modernisation programmes, while expanding the firm’s footprint within the accounts you manage.

A core aspect of the role is consultative-led selling: identifying client needs through deep discovery, shaping compelling value propositions, and converting those into tangible engagements. title: Product Engineer (Growth) // AI Music Video Platform
descriptionHtml:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $6M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize their content and promote it online. The next target is a $15M run rate.

We're hiring our first product engineer focused on growth. You'll own our marketing pages and the surfaces that turn attention into revenue: free tools, landing pages, signup, onboarding, paywalls, and pricing. You'll also ship on the core product itself. Wherever the biggest lever is, that's where you build.

This is a builder role. You'll ship production code daily, look at the results, decide what to test next, and be one of the people most directly responsible for taking us from $6M to $15M and ultimately to $100M.

As a profitable company, there is no VC drama. We are a small, ambitious group of people striving to build something creators love.

Tasks

  • Own our marketing pages: build, maintain, and continuously improve the landing pages and site experiences that bring people into Neural Frames, and keep them fast, high-converting, and visible in traditional search, Google AI Overviews, and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

  • Turn our free tools into real product entry points, where users get immediate value and then continue into Neural Frames without losing their song, lyrics, artwork, or progress

  • Run conversion experiments across the whole funnel: landing pages, calls to action, signup, onboarding, paywalls, packaging, and pricing

  • Ship on the core product when that's where the growth lever is, especially product-native loops: shareable creations, templates, embeds, referrals, and public pages that give creators a reason to spread Neural Frames for us

  • Run programmatic SEO experiments without creating low-quality pages, index bloat, or content that exists only for search engines

  • Build lifecycle experiments tied to real product behavior: activation, abandoned projects, paywall recovery, feature discovery, re-engagement

  • Make sure our Conversion Tracking is set up correctly

  • Own growth measurement and data quality across PostHog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and our backend payment data: build funnels and dashboards you can trust, investigate unexpected movements, and turn them into decisions

Requirements

  • You're a product engineer who can independently ship production experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and you sweat the details that make pages convert: speed, layout, copy, polish

  • You're comfortable moving into backend and data work when necessary. Our backend is written in Python, and you can work with APIs, SQL, event data, and attribution logic

  • You think like a marketer as much as an engineer: you have real opinions about headlines, page structure, and pricing pages, and you'd rather be measured on signups and revenue than on tickets closed

  • You think through the complete funnel. A page that ranks is not a win if visitors don't activate, pay, and stick around

  • You understand experimentation: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, and a decision threshold defined before the test goes live

  • You have strong product and editorial judgment. You build useful experiences for humans rather than filling the internet with generic AI-generated pages

  • You use AI tools as a genuine extension of how you work, with a high bar for accuracy, originality, and brand quality

  • You have high agency: you identify the bottleneck, gather the evidence, ship a solution, and communicate results without waiting for a perfectly specified ticket

  • You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • You've personally built something that produced meaningful organic or product-led growth: a startup, a free tool, a programmatic SEO engine, or growth ownership at a product company. We care more about attributable revenue than impressive traffic screenshots

  • You know technical SEO well: crawling, indexing, structured data, internal linking, canonicalization, and safe migrations

Benefits

VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

title: Product Engineer, Shop
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets.

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.

descriptionHtml:
Job title: Product Manager

Location: Paris — Hybrid - 3 days in office

Team: Product Management - Customer Care Value Stream

Reporting to: Head of Product

This role is based in France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to France.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship


Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. Please submit your profile in English.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working

You will be specifically working with the team building out our contact centre solution and the Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE). Our Customer Care platform powers AI-driven, cost-efficient service operations for global energy retailers, enabling personalised customer experiences across contact centres, digital channels, and case management.

This role is mission-critical to Kaluza’s vision. You will lead the product strategy, delivery, and client outcomes for Kaluza’s Customer Care solutions for ENGIE France, while contributing to the evolution of our Global Core capabilities.

What will I be doing?

As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.

You will:

  • Lead Product Strategy: Own the Customer Care product strategy and roadmap for Kaluza clients in France, balancing Global Core reuse with specific French localisation requirements.

  • Build High-Value Solutions: Develop our suite of tools for the Contact Centre Solution, including CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) and Case Management, to enable efficient, high-value conversations.

  • Drive AI Innovation: Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.

  • Foster Client Partnerships: Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.

  • Execute & Optimise: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.

  • Deliver Operational Excellence: Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.

Is this the job for me?

You are the right person for us if you:

  • Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

  • Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

  • Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

  • Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level, with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

  • Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

  • Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

  • Are excited by AI-driven automation, including voice bots and agent assist technology.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

 

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.

We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

We’re looking for a mission-driven Product Manager to join our Product function and help scale the value of Sylvera’s live products. You’ll take products that have found market fit and make them great - taking them from 1 to 2, rather than 0 to 1.

This is a high-impact role. You’ll be trusted to own your areas and expected to execute autonomously, and we’ll invest in you to set you up for success. You’ll join our product guild, and learn from passionate and experienced colleagues who are enthusiastic about sharing knowledge.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Focus on one or more product areas at a time within a defined problem space, across the Sylvera B2B SaaS platform, iterating on existing products to unlock their full value

  • Talking to customers regularly and running discovery to understand their workflow deeply, from finding the problem through to launching the solution, and monitoring its impact

  • Using product data and customer insight to find what holds users back, and proposing the improvements that matter most in high impact areas

  • Working closely with engineering, design and data teams to build, and marketing and sales to launch improvements at pace.

  • Engaging and partnering with stakeholders across the business - the changes you’ll make will have a high impact, so you’ll bring people’s ideas and input together to build better product experiences

  • Partnering with commercial colleagues to grow revenue and usage by helping users get more value from Sylvera’s data

  • Supporting larger strategic initiatives alongside the wider product team

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Has experience as a Product Manager, ideally on a B2B SaaS product

  • Has worked closely with customers and run their own discovery through to delivery

  • Is data-driven, using analytics and customer insight to make decisions, with a track record of iterating on live products

  • Is naturally curious and loves learning new domains - no carbon market experience needed, but we’d expect you to proactively learn about the world our customers operate in

  • Is comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and can adapt quickly as the picture becomes clearer.

  • Enjoys working with people across a business, listening to different views and turning them into clear product decisions, rather than taking pre-defined requirements

  • Ideally has worked on data products, or has a strong appreciation of how value is derived from data and how to build SaaS experiences that maximise it

  • Is a self-starter who thrives in constantly evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience

  • Cares deeply about the climate

We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Benefits 💰

  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup

  • Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

  • Unlimited annual leave

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Local bar tab at the end of the month

  • Weekly drinks in the office

  • Catered lunch once a month in office

  • Monthly Deliveroo/equivalent allowance once a month

Location 🌍
London. We work flexibly whilst encouraging people to come in regularly to our great office in Old St

Our Values 🙌

Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

Stay curious: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run.

Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed our customer expectations. If we’re serving our customers to the fullest, we can help direct more investment into real climate impact.

What if you’re a partial fit? 🌱

We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Equal employment opportunity 🌈

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

AI note-takers 🤖

We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

title: Product Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About us
At Legora, we’re changing how lawyers work. Our AI-native platform helps legal teams research, review, draft, and collaborate. We build closely with our clients and ship quickly across a growing number of markets.

The role

We’re hiring a Product Operations Manager to join our team and be part of the machine that facilitates product release management for the whole company and our clients.

You’ll own the operating system around releases for a specific product area: what is shipping, when it is ready, who needs to act, and what happens after launch. You’ll also improve how customer feedback and product data reach Product teams, so decisions are based on useful evidence rather than scattered requests.

You’ll need to be exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and bring a practical, problem-solving mindset. You’ll jump into unfamiliar challenges, learn fast, and turn unclear problems into concrete next steps without waiting for a perfect brief or a ready-made playbook.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role reporting to the Head of Product Operations. You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Support, Product Marketing, Engagement, and customer-facing teams in the US and Europe.

What you’ll do

  • Run release planning and readiness for major launches. Keep scope, owners, dependencies, risks, documentation, communications, and rollout decisions clear.

  • Maintain the company-facing view of the product roadmap and releases, and make sure partner teams have accurate information as plans change.

  • Build and maintain a reliable product-feedback process. Turn requests, support issues, and customer observations into evidence Product teams can prioritise and act on.

  • Track product and release health after launch. Use adoption data, operational metrics, and qualitative feedback to flag problems and recommend next steps.

  • Maintain the product knowledge layer across Notion, documentation as code, and other internal sources of truth. Improve the workflows and automation that keep it current.

  • Use agentic tooling and lightweight code to remove operational friction. Build scripts, ship small fixes, and support analysis without waiting for a dedicated Engineering cycle.

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience in product operations, program management, business operations, consulting, technical program management, or a related role.

  • You have run complex launches or programs across Product, Engineering, or go-to-market teams.

  • You bring structure to unclear problems, make ownership explicit, and keep work moving when priorities change.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams and can influence without formal authority.

  • You are conversant in how software ships: you can work in a codebase, understand pull requests, and use agents to ship small fixes or analysis. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working in code either directly or via agents.

  • Experience with enterprise software, release management, support operations, or product analytics is helpful. Legal experience is not required.

What’s in it for you

  • Broad ownership of how Legora launches and operates its product.

  • Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and go-to-market leaders across regions.

  • The chance to build systems that will shape how the company works as it scales.

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and participation in Legora’s option program.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Stockbroking
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About the Role

We're looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in London to join our team and help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You'll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you're equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We're building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you'll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What You'll Do

  • Make content — Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

  • Build demos and tutorials — Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

  • Represent Supabase — Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

  • Support and grow the community — Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

  • Collaborate across the company — Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You Might Be a Good Fit If

  • You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

  • You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

  • You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

  • You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

  • You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in London to support regular in-person DevRel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the London tech ecosystem.

  • Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

  • Experience creating technical content (written or video)

Bonus Points If You Have

  • A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

  • Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Quelques chiffres

  • 230 collaborateurs, dont 50 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

title: Principal Storage Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Principal Storage Software Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As a Principal Storage Software Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on technical leader, driving the design and development of our storage services across object, block, and file, built to deliver the performance, durability, and scale that AI training, inference, and data-intensive workloads demand.

You’ll set the standard for storage engineering excellence, working closely with other principal engineers to align on strategy and drive technical leadership. You’ll partner with Engineering and Product teams to build storage that integrates seamlessly across the stack, and mentor engineers across multiple squads. You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping storage direction, design decisions, and cross-team collaboration.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Radiant's storage services, and lead their design and implementation.

  • Design and build storage systems across object, block, and file, including the control plane, the data plane, and integration with existing Radiant services.

  • Translate product requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with the Storage Product Manager.

  • Own the performance, durability, availability, and consistency characteristics of the storage platform, and define the service levels it can credibly meet.

  • Profile, benchmark, and tune storage throughput, latency, and IOPS for AI training, inference, and other data-intensive workloads.

  • Lead integration of storage with compute, Kubernetes (CSI), networking, IAM, observability, and developer tooling.

  • Design for failure through replication, snapshots, data protection, failure recovery, and safe upgrades at scale.

  • Drive operational excellence with SRE and Infra Ops, including capacity planning, observability, incident response, and post-incident improvements.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, design and code review, and technical standards.

Your Profile

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed storage systems or storage-heavy cloud infrastructure.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Storage: object, block, and file storage, snapshots, replication, erasure coding, caching, tiering, data lifecycle

  • Protocols & interfaces: S3, NFS, SMB, CSI, NVMe/NVMe-oF, RDMA, POSIX semantics, storage APIs

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, high-performance networking, GPU clusters, cloud platforms

  • Reliability: durability, availability, consistency models, consensus, failure recovery, data integrity

  • Observability & security: metrics, logging, tracing, IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, auditability

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as WEKA, VAST, DDN, Lustre, Ceph, MinIO, Pure Storage, or similar.

  • Understanding of AI and HPC storage patterns, such as large-scale training data pipelines, checkpointing, and high-throughput parallel file systems.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What You Bring

  • Storage domain expertise: Understand how storage architecture affects application and workload performance, down to the hardware.

  • Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems where data loss is not an option.

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how storage interacts with compute, networking, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive storage capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Exercise → Final.

descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

  • Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
  • One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

At Yubico, we offer:

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).

Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here.

The Role

Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products  from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.

Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.

This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.
  • Customer focus: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products
  • Requirements Definition: Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.
  • Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution: Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.
  • Data-driven Insights: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.
  • Full life cycle management: Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes
  • Security & Compliance Management: Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware & manufacturing solutions.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.
  • Leadership & Acumen: Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cryptographic Systems: Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams.

U.S. benefits designed for your overall well-being:

Health coverage. We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.

Retirement plan. Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.

Wellness reimbursement. We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.

Learning and development. We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program. 

Time off. We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.

Paid parental leave. We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total). 

Commuter Benefits. If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits. 

Strong mission & company values. We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.

title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.


What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

  • Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories.

  • Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany).

  • Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

  • Together: team meetups and company-wide events.

Location

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.

title: Technical Quality Assurance Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Technical QA Manager is responsible for the technical direction, governance and continual improvement of quality engineering across the organisation’s delivery areas.

The role defines and maintains the overarching test strategy and ensures that quality engineering practices are practical, risk-based and integrated throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

The Technical QA Manager provides direct technical leadership and support to QA Champions and Test Automation Engineers. The role ensures that team testing strategies, automation approaches, quality standards and release evidence are aligned, measurable and consistently applied.

The purpose of the Technical QA Manager role is to:

· Define, communicate and maintain the organisational test strategy and supporting quality engineering standards.

· Enable QA Champions to define and operate effective team and product-area testing strategies.

· Provide technical direction to Test Automation Engineers on automation strategy, framework design, coding standards, CI/CD integration, reusable components, maintainability, diagnostics, test data and execution reliability.

· Ensure automated test execution is embedded into delivery pipelines and provides fast, reliable and actionable feedback.

· Align functional, integration, regression, non-functional and release validation with product, technical and delivery risk.

· Strengthen developer ownership of testing while providing appropriate governance, coaching and assurance.

· Ensure AI-generated testing assets and automation code are reviewed critically before use.

· Defining expectations for pipeline triggers, test execution, quality controls, test-result publication, diagnostic information and failure feedback.

· Ensuring pipeline automation is reliable, maintainable and proportionate to product and release risk.

· Improve release confidence through clear, evidence-based quality and automation reporting.

· Reduce avoidable rework, escaped defects, flaky tests and dependency on manual regression testing.

The Technical QA Manager should be able to:

· Define and implement comprehensive, risk-based test strategies across multiple delivery areas.

· Translate organisational quality objectives into practical engineering standards.

· Demonstrate practical integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

· Define effective pipeline execution, result visibility and failure-feedback approaches.

· Provide credible technical leadership on modern test automation frameworks.

· Work effectively with Playwright or equivalent test automation technology.

· Review and guide maintainable automation code.

· Understand automation developed using C#, Java or an equivalent object-oriented language.

· Understand functional, integration, regression, API, user-interface and relevant non-functional testing approaches.

· Assess the suitability of automation at different levels of a system.

· Review automation framework design, test architecture and reusable components.

· Evaluate automation maintainability, test data, environment dependencies and execution reliability.

· Identify flaky, duplicated, low-value or overly expensive automated tests.

· Analyse quality and automation evidence to identify systemic risks and improvement priorities.

· Understand risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.

· Coach and influence QA Champions, Test Automation Engineers, developers and delivery stakeholders.

· Communicate technical quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

· Challenge weak requirements, ineffective controls and poor automation practices constructively.

· Use AI-assisted testing capabilities critically, with appropriate review, traceability and governance.

The successful candidate should have:

· Strong experience in software quality assurance, test automation and quality engineering.

· Experience providing technical leadership across complex software delivery environments using kaban methodology.

· Demonstrable experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.

· Demonstrable experience improving the reliability and feedback value of pipeline-based automated testing.

· Proven ability to define, implement and govern testing strategies.

· Experience supporting other quality roles in applying testing strategies within delivery teams.

· Practical experience with a modern automation framework.

· Preferable experience with Playwright and Selenium.

· Practical coding capability in an object-oriented programming language.

· Experience designing, building or significantly improving maintainable test automation frameworks.

· Experience reviewing automation architecture and test-code quality.

· A good understanding of functional, integration, regression and release testing.

· A good understanding of software delivery lifecycle and release governance.

· A good understanding of risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.

· A proactive and improvement-focused approach.

· The confidence to challenge poor quality or automation practices constructively.

Desirable experience includes:

· Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines.

· Experience configuring automated test execution within build and deployment pipelines.

· Experience publishing and interpreting automated test results within CI/CD tooling.

· Experience implementing pipeline quality controls.

The Technical QA Manager should be measured on:

· Adoption and effectiveness of organisational testing strategy.

· Quality and consistency of team and product-area testing strategies.

· Effectiveness of support provided to QA Champions.

· Effectiveness of technical direction provided to Test Automation Engineers.

· Reliable automated test execution within CI/CD pipelines.

· Faster, clearer and more actionable quality feedback to delivery teams.

· Increased useful automated coverage in areas of meaningful product risk.

· Reduced flaky, duplicated and low-value automated tests.
