title: Senior adviseur ecologie (Den Bosch)
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Met jouw ecologische expertise geef je richting aan de bescherming en versterking van natuur binnen uiteenlopende projecten. Je borgt kwaliteit, brengt ecologie strategisch in en zorgt dat natuur volwaardig wordt meegenomen in ontwerp- en besluitvorming.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • je werkt aan complexe adviestrajecten op het gebied van natuurwetgeving, ecologisch onderzoek en vergunningverlening. Je schakelt intensief met verschillende stakeholders en bent van begin tot eind betrokken bij projecten. Je adviseert over vraagstukken rondom beschermde gebieden (waaronder stikstof), houtopstanden en (zeldzame) beschermde soorten, zoals zandhagedis, rugstreeppad, vuursalamander, das en bever;

  • een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het begeleiden van junioren en medioren. Je ondersteunt hen in projecten, bespreekt resultaten, bewaakt de kwaliteit van rapportages en stimuleert hun inhoudelijke groei. Je draagt bij aan de verdere opbouw van kennis in het team en helpt om ecologie stevig te verankeren binnen integrale projectteams;

  • de projecten waar je aan werkt zijn divers: van damwandvervanging in stedelijke parken tot spoorvernieuwingen door het hele land en de renovatie van bruggen in grote steden. Jij brengt ecologie op een natuurlijke manier in als volwaardig onderdeel van het ontwerp- en besluitvormingsproces. Daarnaast kijk je altijd verder dan de wettelijke eisen en onderzoek je hoe projecten extra natuurwaarde kunnen creëren. Dat vertaal je naar concrete maatregelen, zoals faunapassages, wadi’s of groene gevels;

  • rapportages, ecologische beoordelingen en stikstofonderbouwingen behoren tot je vaste werkzaamheden. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteitsborging binnen het team en binnen de projecten waarin je meedraait;

  • in het zuiden van het land liggen voor de ecologen van Movares volop kansen. Daarom breiden we het team uit. Jij vervult daarin een trekkersrol. Naast je inhoudelijke adviseurschap geef je leiding aan een klein team van ecologen. Je stimuleert hun ontwikkeling en bewaakt planning en kwaliteit. Ook bouw je actief aan relaties met klanten en partners in de regio.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Als senior adviseur breng je visie, ervaring en vakinhoudelijke kracht mee. Je bent gewend om zelfstandig te opereren in complexe projecten en weet wat nodig is om tot goed onderbouwde, uitvoerbare adviezen te komen. Je vindt het vanzelfsprekend om collega’s te helpen in hun ontwikkeling en hebt oog voor de kwaliteit van het totale ecologische product dat we als team leveren.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in (toegepaste) Biologie, Bos- en Natuurbeheer, Ecologie of vergelijkbaar;

  • vanaf 8 jaar ervaring als ecologisch adviseur of ecoloog;

  • uitstekende kennis van natuurwetgeving en natuurbeleid.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

• een salaris tussen € 5.500 en € 7.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

• een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

• een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

• een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

• flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

• de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

• 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

• met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

• € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

• € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

• ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

• leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

• de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

• je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

• een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

• en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je maakt deel uit van het team Ecologie binnen de marktunit Planvorming & Conditionering. Dit team verbindt omgeving, natuur en projectbelangen op een zorgvuldige en inhoudelijk sterke manier. Je werkt samen met collega’s met expertise in onder meer ecologie, waterkwaliteit, klimaatadaptatie, GIS, vergunningen, omgevingsmanagement, bodem en milieu.

Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat projecten uitvoerbaar zijn én meerwaarde creëren voor natuur. Door disciplines te verbinden ontstaan integrale, realistische en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Binnen het team is veel samenwerking en kennisdeling, met ruimte voor hybride werken en aandacht voor een prettige balans tussen werk en collegiaal contact.

About the Team

When a Fortune 500 C-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real.

Your counterpart is the C-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision-making models that make a top-down transformation feel safe to bet on. The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent.

These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role.

You own the outcome end to end, on the highest-stakes accounts in the market, with all of Decagon's cross-functional teams behind you.

  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality

  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.

Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 

  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR

title: (Senior) AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest das Produkt auf beiden Ebenen: das bestehende ESG-Produkt weiterentwickeln und die nächste Evolutionsstufe mitgestalten, den AI-Analysten für Asset Manager, Credit Officers und Transaction Manager. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Kunden und unserem Gründer- und Führungsteam zusammen. Du bist verantwortlich für Kundennutzen und Umsatz, nicht für Features. Du gehst zum Kunden mit, verstehst ihre Welt, und übersetzt das in validierte Prototypen und klare Build-Entscheidungen.

Was du konkret tust

  1. Own strategic product development: Du gehst raus zu unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Prozesse sowie pain points, die sie selbst ohne dein Zutun nicht erwähnen. Du baust eigenverantwortlich Produkte, die die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien fördern und einen messbaren finanziellen Impact auf unsere Kunden und unser Produkt haben.
  2. Collaborate closely: Du arbeitest eng mit Gründern / Geschäftsleitung und einem starken Engineering-Team zusammen und erhältst jegliche Unterstützung, um die richtigen Produkte schnell an den Kunden zu bringen.
  3. Iterate fast, finish fully: Du erstellst Prototypen mit AI-Tools und hast die Freiheit, selbständig und schnell zu iterieren, um Ideen in Stunden zu testen statt in Wochen. Speed und Urteilsvermögen sind dein Kompass. „Shipped" bedeutet für dich: der Kunde nutzt es, und es liefert Wert.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

Du hast in den ersten 6 Monaten zu 2-3 vielversprechenden Product Bets durch echte Iteration mit Kundenfeedback beigetragen. Du bist in mindestens einem Kernbereich so tief drin, dass Engineers und Kunden dir vertrauen, wichtige Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Was du mitbringst

  1. Du hast bereits digitale B2B-Produkte end-to-end entwickelt und erfolgreich iteriert. Du verstehst Kundenprobleme, denkst wirtschaftlich und hast nachweislich Mehrwert für Kunden und das Business geschaffen.
  2. Du gehst souverän mit Unsicherheit um. Du definierst Hypothesen, testest schnell, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis unvollständiger Informationen und übernimmst Verantwortung, statt auf perfekte Anforderungen zu warten.
  3. AI ist fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeitsweise. Du nutzt LLMs, Agents und moderne AI-Tools wie Cursor oder Claude produktiv und hast bereits AI-Features oder AI-Workflows entwickelt – inklusive der typischen Herausforderungen wie Evals, Latenz, Halluzinationen oder Human-in-the-Loop.
  4. Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Design, Engineering und Go-to-Market zusammen und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln.
  5. Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  6. Du glaubst daran, dass außergewöhnliche Produkte durch enge Zusammenarbeit entstehen. Deshalb bist du vier Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Münchner Büro.

Bonus Punkte

  1. Du hast selbst ein Unternehmen gegründet oder kommerzielle AI Lösungen gebaut.
  2. Erfahrung mit Immobilien-, ESG- oder Finanzdaten.

Dealbreakers

  1. Du willst primär selbst Production-Code besitzen. Diese Rolle entscheidet, was gebaut wird und warum, und misst sich am Kundennutzen, nicht an gemergten PRs.
  2. Du brauchst klare Spezifikationen und abgestimmte Roadmaps, bevor du anfängst. Ambiguität verlangsamt dich, statt dich neugierig zu machen.
  3. AI-Tools sind für dich noch kein Teil deines täglichen Workflows, nicht als Lernbereitschaft, sondern als aktuelle Realität.
  4. Du arbeitest lieber im Stillen als im engen Austausch mit Kunden, CS und Product. Bei Predium gibt es keine Rolle, die hinter Prozessen verschwindet.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 3,5 Tage/Woche.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.
  • Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.
  • Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.
  • Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.
  • Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.
  • Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.
  • Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.
  • Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

  • A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.
  • A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.
  • Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.
  • Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

  • First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.
  • Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.
  • Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.
  • Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.
  • Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.
  • Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3401 - Senior Associate, Clients, GCS

ABOUT WPP & OPENDOOR

At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.

Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.

OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.

The OpenDoor partnership model is designed to deliver next-level productivity through an industry-leading approach to people, platforms and processes. OpenDoor brings together WPP agencies and disciplines including media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, technology and commerce, public relations and production.

OpenDoor’s values draw on Amazon’s 16 Leadership Principles and WPP’s values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, WPP’s creative transformation and Amazon’s customer focus empower our people to challenge today’s conventions and build a better future.

By joining OpenDoor, you will become part of a cross-functional team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients. You will work in new ways on ambitious opportunities across marketing, technology, media, business and creativity.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Client Senior Executive. This full-time, London-based role reports to the Regional Client Associate Director and supports XCM, Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division. The position sits within a regional team that works remotely across the UK and Germany, with the line manager based in DE and regular collaboration with colleagues and local market teams across Europe. The Client Senior Executive coordinates campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, helping to ensure consistent client service, robust operations and high-quality execution.

XCM is Amazon’s Cross-Channel Marketing division, delivering communications for Amazon.com, including major campaigns such as Black Friday and Prime Day. OpenDoor is XCM’s media partner worldwide, excluding North America and Latin America. As Europe is the largest region supported by the WPP team, the Regional XCM Client Senior Executive plays an important role in coordinating consistent delivery across markets.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Collaboration across OpenDoor and the wider WPP network is central to the role, with a strong focus on best practice, operational consistency and on-time delivery.

  • Campaign delivery and coordination: Coordinate regional XCM campaigns and workstreams from briefing to delivery, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions across client, internal and local market teams.
  • Client service and communication: Act as a professional point of contact for client enquiries and requests, providing clear updates on campaign progress, deliverables and performance.
  • Regional planning and reporting: Coordinate the accurate and timely delivery of regional plans and reports, including weekly spend trackers, performance reports and campaign status updates.
  • Operational setup and governance: Set up and maintain reporting templates, trackers, campaign documentation and ways of working; coordinate inputs, complete quality checks and support consistent data and processes across markets.
  • Finance and billing: Support finance processes by collating purchase orders, maintaining budget trackers, monitoring client billing, and escalating discrepancies or missing information.
  • Meetings and follow-up: Participate in and facilitate regular client, internal and creative agency meetings, preparing agendas and materials and documenting actions, owners and deadlines.
  • Communicate Global Campaign guidelines to local market teams, clarify requirements and support consistent implementation across markets.
  • Build strong relationships with regional departments, local OpenDoor teams and wider WPP partners, working effectively across locations and time zones.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Amazon’s ways of working and the OpenDoor operating model to improve organisation, quality and consistency.
  • Identify and share best-in-class work from across the network, helping regional clients and local markets adopt effective approaches.
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and work with the line manager to set objectives aligned with the role and agency vision.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 2–3 years’ experience in media planning, client management or account coordination, preferably within a network agency.
  • Excellent organisational and project planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset, with close attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and collaborate effectively.
  • Awareness of the media and marketing industry, including key channels, emerging trends and planning principles.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic and geographically distributed working environment.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Ability to manage defined tasks independently and present outputs directly to clients or package them clearly for the wider team.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience supporting multi-market or regional accounts.
  • Experience with campaign reporting, budget tracking, operational governance or workflow tools.
  • Familiarity with Amazon’s ecosystem, ways of working and Leadership Principles.
  • Understanding of cross-channel media planning and how individual channels contribute to an integrated plan.

BENEFITS OF OPENDOOR

  • Unparalleled Access: Gain direct experience working with one of the world’s most innovative and influential companies.
  • Mentoring and Training: Receive guidance from experienced professionals at both WPP and Amazon.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Utilise industry-leading tools and platforms, including WPP Open.
  • Data-Driven Environment: Develop your analytical skills and contribute to data-driven decision-making.
  • Global Impact: Be part of a team shaping the future of marketing globally.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice) - m/f/d
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

Position Overview

The Senior Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a PhD in Economics and limited work experience. The Senior Associate position is also open to applicants with a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority. Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, working closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practical input to projects. A Senior Associate would typically:

  •  Conduct analyses and collect evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring the use of cloud computing
  •  Build economic models tailored to the issues at hand and supporting our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Contribute to the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers
  •  Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner
  •  Manage and mentor junior staff
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions
  • Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.)

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialisation in industrial economics and/or econometrics; non-PhD applicants should have a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority
  • Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset
  • High degree of numeracy, ability to analyse data, familiarity with econometric techniques
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in economic consulting through coursework, work experience, or activities

To Apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Germany and how this role matches your goals;
  • Writing Sample (optional) – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or job market paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics;
  • Transcripts (optional) - from the most recent academic training (may be unofficial copies).

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

title: Senior B2B Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. 

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

Make Zattoo the TV platform partner of choice for operators and broadcasters in Eastern and Northern Europe. This role turns new markets into lasting revenue and shapes Zattoo’s next stage of growth. You will join a close-knit team working across Germany and Switzerland that values trust, collaboration and hands-on ownership over hierarchy and heavy process.

THE TEAM

The Zattoo Business Sales Team is responsible for all sales activities related to Zattoo’s TV-as-a-Service and streaming technology offerings, including the End-to-End TV platform as well as Modular products such as Streaming, Ingest and Orchestration solutions. We work closely with Product, Portfolio Management, Marketing, Client Success and Project Management to bring complex solutions to market and build long-term customer relationships across different regions and customer segments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build a new business pipeline across Eastern and Northern Europe and win telcos, ISPs, broadcasters and OTT platforms as long-term customers
  • Own complex, high-value deals end-to-end, from first conversation to signed contract

  • Build lasting relationships with senior decision makers up to C-level
  • Shape tailored offers from our modular platform (INGEST, STREAM, ORCHESTRATE, E2E)
  • Be Zattoo’s face in your markets, at customer meetings, trade shows and partner events, and bring market insights back to Product

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Experience required (Must-have)

Nice to have

  • Long-term Thinking: Builds relationships for the long run instead of chasing quick wins.


WHY JOIN US? 

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays

Plus:

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. title: Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)

Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10

Het mooie van werken bij Univé

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?

Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.

Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.

Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met zowel Synergy als Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar functionele requirements.

  • Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig uit te werken en anderen daarin mee te nemen.

  • Ervaring met het inhoudelijk begeleiden en coachen van collega-analisten.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en IT.

  • Kennis van Agile/Scrum en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams.

Ervaring met systeemmigraties, juridische dienstverlening of de verzekeringsbranche is een pré.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Business Analist werk je binnen het Rechtshulp Synergy-team aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap voor onze juridische dienstverlening.

De migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden.

Je brengt bestaande processen en informatievoorziening in kaart, onderzoekt welke verbeteringen mogelijk zijn en vertaalt deze naar heldere requirements voor de nieuwe omgeving.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt welke impact veranderingen hebben op medewerkers, processen en uiteindelijk onze leden.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe business- en procesanalyses.

  • Het analyseren van bestaande Synergy-processen en het vertalen hiervan naar de gewenste inrichting binnen Dynamics.

  • Het ophalen, uitwerken en valideren van businessrequirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken van afhankelijkheden tussen processen, applicaties en andere IT-teams.

  • Het adviseren van de Product Owner en businessstakeholders over oplossingsrichtingen en verbeterkansen.

  • Het inhoudelijk begeleiden van andere businessanalisten en bewaken van de kwaliteit van analyses.

  • Het ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en acceptatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en de verdere professionalisering van businessanalyse.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Binnen de eerste zes maanden heb je de belangrijkste Rechtshulp-processen geanalyseerd en vertaald naar bruikbare requirements voor Dynamics.

Daarnaast heb je inhoudelijk richting gegeven aan de migratie en een zichtbare bijdrage geleverd aan de kwaliteit en zelfstandigheid van de andere analisten.

Je team

Je komt terecht in het Rechtshulp Synergy-team binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies.

Het team maakt onderdeel uit van IT Distributie, waar we nauw samenwerken met onze businesscollega's om de dienstverlening van Univé continu te verbeteren.

Je werkt in een team waarin medewerkers veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgen. We verwachten dat je zelfstandig kunt werken, initiatief toont en actief de samenwerking opzoekt.

Als senior krijg je een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol, zonder dat je formeel leidinggevende bent.

Je bent iemand bij wie collega's terechtkunnen voor complexe vraagstukken, maar die ook zelf graag de inhoud induikt.

Je standplaats is Assen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Univé krijg je een uitdagende functie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening.

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je vakinhoudelijke kennis in te zetten en collega's verder te helpen.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10.

Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

Daarnaast bieden we onder andere:

  • Een variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris.

  • Een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd.

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek.

  • Een goede studiekostenregeling en mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een goede pensioenvoorziening.

  • Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

  • Korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatie zonder winstoogmerk. We helpen onze leden risico's te voorkomen, gevolgen te beperken en problemen op te lossen.

Binnen Juridisch Advies ondersteunen we leden bij juridische vragen en problemen. Goede digitale ondersteuning helpt onze collega's om deze dienstverlening persoonlijk, toegankelijk en efficiënt te houden.

IT Distributie speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. We ontwikkelen en verbeteren de IT-oplossingen waarmee onze collega's hun werk kunnen doen en onze leden goed geholpen worden.

Daarbij geloven we in eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de ruimte om zelf verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met Synergy en Microsoft Dynamics inzetten om onze juridische dienstverlening toekomstbestendig te maken?

En krijg je energie van een rol waarin je complexe analyses combineert met het begeleiden van collega's?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteer op de functie van Senior Business Analist Rechtshulp bij Univé.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

title: Senior Campaign Operations Manager – Casino
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

About the Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

Role Overview

The Senior Campaign Operations Manager is a pivotal role responsible for taking operational delivery across CRM, Promotional Operations and Front-End Content & Merchandising to a new standard, giving the business and senior leadership genuine confidence in what's being built, executed and delivered across every owned channel and touchpoint.

You're hands on enough to troubleshoot live platforms and lead incident response the moment a campaign or promotion needs it, with an eagle-eyed view across everything live and everything coming next. You lead people the same way you lead delivery: coaching the team to raise their own standards, not just directing their work, and setting benchmarks the wider function can build on.

Operating at the intersection of CRM, Operations and Product, this role is central to Fanatics' ambition to become the #1 Online US Casino by 2030. 

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Accountability & Operational Control

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for the operational running of campaign, promotion and front end content delivery across the team, ensuring all requirements from Commercial, Analytics, Product and Engineering are in place from approved brief through build, QA, deployment, monitoring and post-launch review. 
  • Maintain a complete, eagle-eyed view of delivery status, live risk and upcoming critical moments, keeping the campaign calendar, dependencies and escalation paths accurate.
  • Hold the team accountable for quality and timeliness, stepping in directly when delivery or player experience is at risk, and surfacing systemic risk that needs action beyond a single workstream.

Incident Management & Operational Resilience

  • Own on-call coverage and incident response for live campaigns, promotions and content, acting as the senior operational escalation point when delivery or execution risk surfaces.
  • Troubleshoot platform and execution issues hands on, coordinating containment, stakeholder communications, recovery and post incident follow up.
  • Own root-cause resolution, escalating platform-level causes to the CRM & Promotions Enablement Lead where needed and driving corrective action on recurring or high-severity incidents.
  • Establish the severity levels, playbooks and launch monitoring checklists that keep incident response consistent and repeatable.

Standards, Governance & Compliance

  • Set standards for campaign and content setup, audience selection, offer eligibility, testing, deployment and monitoring across owned channels.
  • Own the operational QA and release readiness gate that live activity must clear before launch, in partnership with Commercial, Legal, Compliance and Product, ensuring responsible gaming, privacy and jurisdictional requirements are met with clear audit trails.
  • Maintain the change controls, access permissions and documentation required for consistent, compliant and continuously improving execution.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach and develop the team, setting clear objectives, decision rights, performance expectations, and a benchmark for operational excellence that others are equipped to meet.
  • Build capability and confidence across the function through hands-on coaching, playbooks and structured knowledge sharing, rather than direction alone.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement, where risks and mistakes are surfaced early and addressed constructively, and close capability or resourcing gaps as they emerge.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with CRM Planning on the campaign roadmap, upcoming plans and capacity signals so operational readiness is built in early.
  • Serve as the critical interface into Customer Support and VIP, briefing them on upcoming activity, equipping them to resolve player escalations, and feeding recurring friction points back into delivery standards.
  • Represent operational readiness and delivery risk in cross functional planning for new campaigns, promotions, content and platform capabilities, connecting operational performance to player experience and business outcomes.

Skills & Experience

Essential: 

  • 6+ years in CRM, campaign or promotional operations, delivery management or lifecycle marketing, including proven experience leading and developing a team.
  • Accountability for high-volume, time-sensitive operational delivery across multiple channels or workstreams in a complex digital consumer business.
  • Hands-on working knowledge of CRM or promotional bonusing platforms (e.g. XtremePush, Braze, Optimove or similar) strong enough to troubleshoot live issues directly and assess technical risk.
  • Proven experience leading incident response, on-call governance or escalation frameworks for live activity, with sound operational judgement under pressure.
  • A track record of designing or improving operational processes, controls, service levels and performance reporting, drawing on workflow management tools (e.g., Airtable, Jira). 
  • Excellent 360° stakeholder management and people leadership, able to influence senior stakeholders across CRM, Product, Compliance, Commercial, Legal, Customer Support and VIP while raising team capability.

Preferred: 

  • Experience in iGaming, sports betting or another regulated, compliance-heavy environment.
  • Knowledge of online casino mechanics, bonusing platforms and player journeys.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or BI tools for operational diagnosis, reporting and performance analysis.
  • Experience operating in Agile or product-led delivery environments, and scaling operational governance or automation in a high-growth organization.

Global Ways of Working & Flexibility

  • Canada or UK based, hybrid role operating within Fanatics' flexible working framework.
  • Close partnership with both UK and US based teams, requiring effective collaboration across time zones.
  • Occasional evening or weekend work during peak promotional periods and major campaign moments.
  • Participation in a planned on-call rota is required, with on-call expectations and compensatory time managed in line with applicable local policy.
  • Fanatics support a culture of trust and autonomy, enabling sustainable global collaboration.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

title: Senior C++(MFC)/.NET Developer
descriptionHtml:
Senior C++(MFC)/.NET Developer

Ben jij een ervaren Developer die energie krijgt van complexe softwarevraagstukken én het leuk vindt om te werken op het snijvlak van legacy en moderne technologie? Binnen deze rol werk je aan een grote en technisch uitdagende C++/MFC codebase, terwijl je tegelijkertijd meebouwt aan de modernisering richting moderne .NET technologieën zoals C# en WPF. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar technische diepgang, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan.

Als Senior C++(MFC)/.NET Developer werk je aan het onderhouden, verbeteren en moderniseren van Exquise Classic. Je beweegt moeiteloos tussen bestaande legacy architecturen en moderne ontwikkelvraagstukken en bent een belangrijke kennisdrager binnen het team.

Je bent een developer die niet schrikt van complexe systemen en juist energie krijgt van technische diepgang. Je vindt het interessant om bestaande software écht te begrijpen en tegelijkertijd mee te bouwen aan modernisering en innovatie.

• Leergierig

• Communicatief vaardig

• In staat om complexe materie begrijpelijk uit te leggen

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een technisch uitdagende rol binnen een stabiele organisatie

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris, passend bij jouw ervaring, expertise en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie.

Vertimart ontwikkelt al ruim 40 jaar softwareoplossingen voor de tandheelkundige sector. descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Du berätst unsere Kunden dabei, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und verantwortest, dass es dort ankommt. Als (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager arbeitest du an Projekten und Produkten in Commerce, Daten und KI, vom ersten Workshop bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson des Kunden, führst die Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung und Partnern und übernimmst Product Ownership.

Deine Aufgaben

Beraten

  • Du klärst mit dem Kunden, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und übersetzt seine Geschäftsziele in Produktentscheidungen.
  • Du leitest Discovery-Workshops mit Fachbereichen und empfiehlst, was gebaut wird und was nicht.
  • Nach dem Go-live prüfst du mit dem Kunden, ob das Projekt die Kennzahlen bewegt, für die es gestartet wurde.

Steuern

  • Du planst und steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel und verantwortest Zeit, Budget und Qualität.
  • Du übernimmst Product Ownership: Du priorisierst das Backlog und triffst Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Kunden.
  • Du sprichst Zielkonflikte früh an und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, UX und Daten-Teams zusammen und begleitest Releases, Go-lives und die Weiterentwicklung danach.
  • Du nutzt KI in deiner eigenen Arbeit und entwickelst unsere Methoden weiter.
  • Als Senior berätst du Kunden bis auf Führungsebene, führst größere oder strategische Projekte, bist fest in Angebote und Pitches eingebunden und unterstützt andere Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit deiner Erfahrung.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung, Projektmanagement oder Product Ownership bei technischen Digitalprojekten, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung.
  • Erfahrung mit Projekten in Commerce, Daten oder KI. Erfahrung mit agentischen Lösungen ist ein Plus.
  • Du denkst in Kennzahlen des Kunden und kannst Fachbereichen erklären, was eine technische Entscheidung für ihr Geschäft bedeutet.
  • Du steuerst Budget und Scope sicher, auch wenn mehrere Projekte parallel laufen.
  • Du arbeitest agil oder klassisch, je nachdem, was das Projekt braucht.
  • Du sprichst mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe und sprichst Konflikte an, bevor sie teuer werden.
  • Erfahrung mit Workshops auf Fachbereichs- oder Führungsebene ist ein Plus.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch.

Was dich erwartet

  • Projekte mit Händlern und Herstellern auf einem modernen Composable-Stack, mit Partnern wie commercetools, Snowflake und weiteren.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Austausch mit anderen Consultants, Project Managern und Product Ownern im Team.
  • Ein klarer Weg vom Project Manager zum Senior, mit der Möglichkeit, dich in Discovery, Pitches und Beratung einzubringen.
  • Weiterbildung ist bei uns fest vorgesehen: Du schlägst Konferenzen, Kurse oder Zertifizierungen vor, und wir planen sie gemeinsam ein.
  • KI-Werkzeuge und moderne Hardware als selbstverständlicher Teil der Arbeit.

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
descriptionHtml:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  • Project Delivery: Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
  • Work Experience: Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. 
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.
  • Technical Depth: You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI (EU/UK)
descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI (EU/UK) to join our dynamic and collaborative Legal team. In this pivotal role, you will provide practical and strategic legal guidance for our UK and European businesses on matters related to privacy, AI, and data protection. You will be instrumental in developing and scaling our privacy and AI programs across the region as we continue to innovate at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and consumer products. Reporting to our Head Counsel, Privacy & AI, you will lead a small team and work closely with our Data Protection Officer and our global Privacy & AI Legal team.

You’ll work cross-functionally with teams in product, marketing, engineering, security, and compliance, as well as clinical teams, to ensure our data practices and digital health offerings align with evolving UK and EU legal frameworks and privacy expectations. This is a fantastic opportunity for a lawyer who thrives in a mission-driven, fast-paced environment and is excited to help shape the future of consumer healthcare. This is a remote role open to candidates based in the UK or EU.

You Will:

  • Serve as the lead legal advisor and subject matter expert on UK and EU privacy and AI law and apply your expertise across all business functions in the region.

  • Lead and develop a small team, including a privacy compliance lead and a legal programs manager.

  • Lead AI and privacy-related legal reviews of products and features under the UK GDPR, EU GDPR, PECR and EU ePrivacy rules, the EU AI Act, and other applicable laws, ensuring privacy-by-design principles are integrated early in the development process.

  • Provide actionable business guidance on complex data use cases, including AI initiatives.

  • Structure cross-border and intragroup data flows across our global data platforms, including transfer mechanisms (such as the IDTA and SCCs), transfer risk assessments, and data sharing agreements between group entities.

  • Work closely with the Product, AI, Marketing, and Engineering teams to align legal requirements with operational controls and business processes.

  • Develop, localize, and maintain internal policies and playbooks to provide teams clear legal frameworks, risk considerations, and best practices for responsible AI use.

  • Collaborate with the Legislative and Public Policy teams to evaluate proposed UK and EU AI and privacy laws and support the company’s advocacy efforts.

  • Support and scale our privacy and AI programs by leading impact assessments (e.g., DPIAs, AI risk assessments) and maintaining records of processing activities.

  • Monitor UK and EU legal and regulatory developments in privacy and AI matters and translate them into clear, business-friendly guidance.

  • Lead incident response for privacy and AI-related matters in the region, collaborating with cross-functional partners and our Data Protection Officer from the detection stage to mitigation.

  • Lead engagement with the ICO and EU supervisory authorities, and handle complex data subject requests and third-party and law enforcement disclosure requests.

  • Negotiate DPAs, data sharing agreements, and AI terms with vendors and partners, and manage outside counsel in the region.

You Have:

  • Qualified lawyer in a UK jurisdiction, Ireland, or an EU member state.

  • 7+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE), advising on privacy and data protection at a top law firm or in-house legal department

  • Deep expertise in the UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and PECR and EU ePrivacy rules, including for special category health data, and working knowledge of consumer protection regulations, the EU AI Act, and healthcare privacy frameworks

  • A strong track record of building cross-functional relationships across AI, Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to provide strategic and practical counsel.

  • Experience negotiating UK and EU privacy and AI contracts, including DPAs, international data transfer agreements, and data sharing agreements.

  • Experience engaging with data protection supervisory authorities, including on breach notifications and inquiries.

  • Direct people management experience, with a track record of developing team members.

  • Sharp legal judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex legal concepts to cross-functional teams.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities, and with colleagues across US and European time zones.

Preferred Skills:

  • Prior experience in a healthcare, telehealth, or consumer-facing company is highly desirable.

  • Working knowledge of privacy and/or AI tools for managing data inventories, risk assessments, consumer consent, and data subject requests.

  • Experience managing large, cross-functional projects.

  • Experience building or integrating privacy programs across multiple entities or following acquisitions.

  • CIPP/E or CIPM certification is a plus.

  • Working proficiency in French, German, or Spanish.

  • Experience in regulated healthcare or pharmacy services in the UK or EU.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

title: Senior Creative Technologist
