Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
About the Role As a Senior Data Visualisation Engineer, you will sit at the dynamic intersection of data engineering, product design, and editorial storytelling to unlock actionable insights from complex global trade, commodity, and maritime datasets. Operating with high autonomy, you will push the boundaries of visual communication, transforming intricate data streams into intuitive, beautiful interactive experiences and visual narratives. In this role, your work will directly empower market participants worldwide to extract immediate, strategic value from Kpler’s industry-leading intelligence.

  • Proven ability to independently query, interrogate, and validate complex datasets (using SQL, Python, or similar tools) and defend published insights confidently.
  • Strong spatial analysis skills and proficiency with GIS technologies to analyse location-based data and spatial relationships.
  • Technical proficiency with modern web technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript and contemporary front-end frameworks) alongside an enthusiasm for AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Exceptional visual communication skills and a strong portfolio demonstrating clear editorial judgement and narrative structure across data-driven projects.

  • Existing interest in or familiarity with global commodities, energy markets, trading, or maritime transportation.

title: Senior CRO & Funnel Marketing Manager (m/w/d) · Remote
descriptionHtml:
Du hast schon Onlineshops zum Wachsen gebracht und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du auf höchstem Niveau arbeiten kannst? Dann übernimm bei EVOLVE die Conversionrate-Optimierung und Funnelentwicklung von E-Commerce-Brands, von der ersten Analyse bis zum messbaren Ergebnis.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Jedes Jahr verwalten wir über 60 Millionen € Adspend und denken jedes Projekt von der Ad über den Funnel bis zur Marge. Unser Name ist Programm: Wir entwickeln uns, unsere Dienstleistung und unsere Kunden ständig weiter. Das spiegelt sich auch in unserer Mitarbeiterbewertung auf kununu mit 4,8 von 5 Sternen wider.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schau dir an, was dich bei uns erwartet.

Das wirst du tun

Du bist verantwortlich für verkaufsstarke Shopseiten und Funnels, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kunden den Markt outperformen.

  • Analyse: Du analysierst Shops, Landingpages und Funnels ganzheitlich und leitest daraus priorisierte Hypothesen und Maßnahmen ab

  • Positionierung: Du deckst die entscheidenden Hebel in der Customer Journey auf und entwickelst Positionierungen, die Marken klar vom Wettbewerb abheben

  • Konzeption: Du erstellst conversionstarke Shop- und Landingpage-Konzepte und steuerst die Umsetzung mit UX-Design und Copywriting

  • Kunden und Projekte: Du führst Kunden eigenständig durch den Optimierungsprozess und verantwortest Projekte bis zum messbaren Ergebnis

  • Trends: Du verfolgst die aktuellsten Trends im Brand- und Direct-Response-Marketing und bringst sie in unsere Methodik und Standards ein

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für deine eigenen Projekte, stehst damit aber nicht allein: Unsere Experten für UX-Design, Copywriting und Performance Marketing setzen deine Konzepte mit dir um. Dich erwartet ein Team, das für Ergebnisse, Verlässlichkeit und kreative Exzellenz steht, mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Feedbackkultur.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, E-Commerce oder UX, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem Shop mit relevantem Traffic

  • Sicherer Umgang mit GA4, Hotjar/Clarity und A/B-Tests

  • Fundiertes Verständnis für Positionierung, Customer Journey und Conversion-Psychologie

  • Klare Kommunikation, schriftlich wie im Kundengespräch

  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit: Du priorisierst konsequent und gibst klare Empfehlungen

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • Vollzeit mit einer 38-Stunden-Woche

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, JobRad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

Vielleicht fragst du dich gerade …

„Wie viele Projekte betreue ich parallel?“ Wenige, dafür aber in der Tiefe. So kannst du dich wirklich in jede Marke reindenken. Du arbeitest nicht am Fließband, sondern begleitest deine Kunden langfristig und siehst, was aus deinen Konzepten wird.

„Welche Rolle spielt AI bei euch?“ Eine große. ChatGPT und Claude werden deine besten Freunde, denn mit den modernsten AI-Workflows optimierst du deine Arbeit und das Ergebnis für deine Kunden. Dafür hast du vollen Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack. So bleibt mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt: die richtigen Ideen für deine Kunden.

„100 % Remote, verliere ich da den Austausch?“ Nein. Wir sind eine Remote-Agentur, aber Persönlichkeit und Teamspirit bleiben erhalten. Du hast das Gefühl eines Office-Teams, nur ohne Lärm und ohne Fahrt ins Büro. Dafür sorgen regelmäßige Projektabstimmungen, unsere wöchentlichen Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR-Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Customer Communication Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Als Senior Customer Communication Strategist word je onderdeel van het Channel Experience team binnen Customer Experience & Marketing. Je rapporteert aan de Head of Customer Experience & Marketing en maakt deel uit van het kernteam. Samen werken we aan een herkenbare, relevante en consistente klantbeleving van Zwitserleven, over alle kanalen en customer journeys.

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Vanuit het Channel Experience team werken we nauw samen met Sales, UX, IT, Products, Legal, Compliance en Corporate Communicatie.

Als Senior Customer Communication Strategist vertaal je onze CX & Marketing-visie naar communicatie die herkenbaar Zwitserleven is. Je verbindt merk, klant, pensioen en communicatie en zorgt dat het gevoel van Zwitserleven terugkomt in onze Tone of Voice, customer journeys en commerciële verhalen.

Je kent de pensioenwereld en weet complexe inhoud terug te brengen tot heldere, menselijke en relevante communicatie. Je vertegenwoordigt daarbij het klant- en merkperspectief richting Legal, Compliance en Products en zorgt samen voor een passende vertaling waarin klantbelang, merk en wettelijke vereisten samenkomen.


Ook commercieel breng je ons verhaal tot leven. Je kunt onze customer journeys overtuigend uitleggen, ontwikkelt sterke pitchdecks en presentaties en ondersteunt Sales bij belangrijke pitches. Waar relevant presenteer je zelf het CX-, merk- en journeyverhaal van Zwitserleven.

Daarnaast kijk je vooruit. Je benut AI, GenAI en personalisatie om communicatie slimmer, relevanter en persoonlijker te maken, zonder het menselijke karakter en de herkenbare Tone of Voice van Zwitserleven uit het oog te verliezen.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

- Je vertaalt de CX & Marketing-strategie naar sterke communicatieconcepten en klantverhalen.
- Je bent een sparringpartner voor ons nieuwe Business Strategie team omtrent proposities.
- Je bewaakt en ontwikkelt de Tone of Voice van Zwitserleven en vertaalt het merkgevoel naar communicatie en klantinteracties,
- Je zorgt er samen met Products, Legal en Compliance voor dat onze klantcommunicatie voldoet aan geldende wet- en regelgeving en compliancekaders, en borgt dit binnen de customer journeys.
- Je borgt de vertaling van onze duurzaamheidsambities naar marketingactiviteiten en -uitingen en zorgt dat duurzaamheidscommunicatie actueel, consistent en passend blijft.

- Je maakt complexe pensioenmaterie begrijpelijk, menselijk en relevant voor de klant.
- Je versterkt customer journeys vanuit communicatie en kunt het verhaal en de keuzes erachter overtuigend uitleggen.
- Je ontwikkelt pitchdecks en presentaties waarin merk, proposities, journeys en klantbeleving samenkomen en ondersteunt Sales bij belangrijke pitches.
- Je stemt met Corporate Communicatie af over Athora-brede communicatie, pers en reputatie.
- Je benut AI en GenAI, waaronder LLM's, voor onder andere content, personalisatie en Tone of Voice en vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete toepassingen.

#LI-DNI


Wat vragen we van jou?

Je bent een senior communicatieprofessional die strategisch sterk, taalgevoelig en merkgedreven is. Je denkt vanuit de klant, doorgrondt complexe inhoud snel en weet verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt:

- Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen communicatie, content, marketing of Customer Experience.
- aantoonbare kennis van pensioen
- WO werk- en denkniveau
- Aantoonbare ervaring met strategische klantcommunicatie, merk en Tone of Voice
- Je kunt complexe pensioeninhoud snel doorgronden en begrijpelijk maken voor verschillende doelgroepen
- Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement binnen een complexe organisatie
- Ervaring met of sterke affiniteit voor AI en generatieve AI
- Je bent sterk in storytelling en kunt een verhaal zowel inhoudelijk ontwikkelen als overtuigend presenteren
- Je hebt uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 17 HAY is de range € 5.991,23 tot € 7.988,31 op basis van 36 uur.

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Gemeinsam mit uns gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung – digital, zugänglich und besser für alle. Als Senior Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) bist Du fachliche Expertin oder Experte in Deinem Team und trägst mit Deinem Wissen maßgeblich zum Erfolg Deines Kundenportfolios bei. Du entwickelst überzeugende Geschäftsargumente, unterstützt Dein Team in anspruchsvollen Situationen und optimierst kontinuierlich Prozesse und Methoden – für noch bessere Ergebnisse und zufriedenere Kunden.

Mit Deinem Engagement hilfst Du dabei, Gesundheitsfachkräften den Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern – damit sie mehr Zeit für das haben, was wirklich zählt: die bestmögliche Versorgung ihrer Patientinnen und Patienten.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du verantwortest Umsatzthemen und entwickelst überzeugende Geschäftsargumente: Du führst Vertragserweiterungen durch, erarbeitest den Kundennutzen und unterstützt bei der kaufmännischen Umsetzung

  • Du erkennst Wachstumschancen und setzt sie um: Du identifizierst Möglichkeiten für Vertragserweiterungen, Verlängerungen und Kundenrückgewinnung und verantwortest diese wichtigen Kundenkontaktpunkte in enger Abstimmung mit Deinem Team

  • Du gibst Kundenfeedback strukturiert weiter: Du leitest wichtige Rückmeldungen und systemische Themen an die relevanten internen Bereiche weiter und trägst so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kundenerlebnisse bei

  • Du entwickelst Arbeitsweisen und Prozesse weiter: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale, setzt diese um und steigerst so die Wirksamkeit und Skalierbarkeit der Kundenbetreuung

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend an Lösungen: Du arbeitest mit relevanten Ansprechpersonen zusammen, um wiederkehrende Themen zu lösen und die gesamte Kundenbetreuung kontinuierlich zu verbessern

Dein Profil

Vorab der kurze Hinweis: Falls Du dem unten beschriebenen Profil nicht exakt entsprichst, aber trotzdem der Meinung bist, dass die Stellenausschreibung zu Deinen Fähigkeiten passt: Bewirb Dich gerne trotzdem!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du folgendes mit:

  • 2-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle – idealerweise im B2B SaaS-Umfeld

  • Portfoliomanagement-Skills: Du behältst auch bei vielen Kunden den Überblick, priorisierst intelligent und arbeitest datengetrieben

  • Beziehungsstärke: Du baust echte Partnerschaften auf, nicht nur Geschäftsbeziehungen – authentisch, empathisch und auf Augenhöhe

  • Kommerzielle Denkweise: Du verstehst Business-Logiken, erkennst Verkaufschancen und trägst gerne Umsatzverantwortung

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst an, koordinierst eigenständig und bringst Dinge zum Abschluss – kein "das ist nicht mein Job"

  • Kommunikation: Sehr gutes Deutsch (mind. C1) und gutes Englisch (mind. B2)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem

  • Healthcare-Erfahrung: Kenntnisse im Gesundheitswesen, idealerweise aus dem Praxis- oder Klinikumfeld

  • Technisches Verständnis: Affinität für Software-Produkte und die Fähigkeit, auch komplexere Features verständlich zu erklären

  • Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest gerne mit CRM-Systemen (z.B. Salesforce), Dashboards und nutzt Daten zur Entscheidungsfindung

 

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 

  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

 

Der Interview-Prozess

  • Erstes Vorstellungsgespräch mit Talent

Job Details

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers. The kind of people who not only created composable commerce but also shaped the culture of experimentation that idea unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.

Über unser Customer Success Team

Hallo! Ich bin Enrico, Customer Success Team Lead bei commercetools. Mein Team konzentriert sich auf den Aufbau langfristiger, beratungsorientierter Partnerschaften mit unseren Enterprise-Kunden.

Unser Customer Success Team gestaltet und skaliert mit Leidenschaft eine außergewöhnliche Upmarket Customer Experience im gesamten Enterprise-Segment. Im Zuge unseres weiteren Wachstums freuen wir uns darauf, unser Team in EMEA um eine:n Senior Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) zu erweitern.

In dieser Rolle bilden Sie das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und den modernsten Commerce-Produkten auf dem Markt. Sie betreuen unsere größten und komplexesten Enterprise-Kunden – von schnell wachsenden Marken bis hin zu börsennotierten Unternehmen. Dabei konzentrieren Sie sich auf Account Health, die Post-Sales-Adoption und die Positionierung von commercetools als vertrauenswürdigen strategischen Partner.

Sie arbeiten eng mit unseren internen Support-, Produkt- und Vertriebsteams zusammen, um optimale Voraussetzungen für den Erfolg unserer Kunden zu schaffen. Da commercetools leistungsstark, modern und hochgradig flexibel ist, setzen Sie Ihr tiefes technisches Verständnis, Ihre Vertriebsaffinität und Ihre erstklassigen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten ein, um große Marken bei der Gestaltung außergewöhnlicher Commerce-Workflows zu unterstützen und langfristigen Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Über das Account Management hinaus tragen Sie aktiv dazu bei, unsere Customer-Success-Praxis sowohl regional als auch global mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Wenn Sie bereit sind, innovative Lösungen für bekannte Marken voranzutreiben, die Kundenkommunikation über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg zu steuern und in einer einflussreichen Rolle aufzublühen, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

Der Interviewprozess für diese Position findet auf Englisch statt. Wir suchen daher eine Person, die sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch sicher mit unseren Kunden kommunizieren kann.

Ihre Mission

  • Sie begleiten Enterprise-Kunden dabei, den Mehrwert unserer Agentic-Commerce-Architektur – einschließlich Composable Commerce, Frontend und Connect – zu maximieren und flexible, zukunftssichere Tech-Stacks aufzubauen.
  • Sie übersetzen neue Produktfeatures und -funktionen in klare Geschäftsergebnisse und stimmen diese direkt auf die strategischen Ziele und zentralen ROI-Kennzahlen des jeweiligen Kunden ab.
  • Sie treiben Kundenbeziehungen proaktiv voran und leiten wirkungsvolle Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs), um die Kundenbindung zu stärken, die Plattformnutzung zu steigern und langfristiges Wachstum zu beschleunigen.
  • Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Produktmanagement zusammen, vertreten die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und liefern entscheidendes Feedback, das die Roadmap unserer neuesten Produktinnovationen mitgestaltet.
  • Sie arbeiten nahtlos und teamübergreifend mit Sales, Product und Support zusammen, bringen tiefgehendes technisches und kaufmännisches Know-how ein und sichern so langfristig den Erfolg unserer Enterprise-Kunden.
  • Sie repräsentieren commercetools in Webinaren, Kundenfallstudien und Beratungsgremien, um Kundenerfolge sichtbar zu machen und das Engagement innerhalb der Community zu fördern.
  • Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung globaler Customer-Success-Frameworks, treiben interne Prozessverbesserungen voran und gestalten die langfristige operative Strategie der Abteilung mit.
  • Sie agieren intern und extern als anerkannte:r Fachexpert:in, unterstützen Teammitglieder als Mentor:in, fördern die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und tragen dazu bei, die gemeinsamen Standards unserer Customer-Success-Praxis weiter anzuheben.
  • Sie fungieren als Eskalationsinstanz und arbeiten mit dem Product-Support-Team zusammen, um Probleme schnell zu lösen. Auch in anspruchsvollen Eskalationssituationen bleiben Sie ruhig, professionell und besonnen.

Was Sie mitbringen – Ihr Profil

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einem High-Touch-Tech-Umfeld mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen im Bereich Customer Success, Pre-Sales oder Technical Consulting – idealerweise in den Branchen E-Commerce oder Retail
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse
  • Ein tiefes technisches Verständnis moderner API-first- und Headless-Technologien, gepaart mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Denken und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Technologien in messbaren ROI zu übersetzen
  • Die Fähigkeit, als überzeugende:r und vertrauenswürdige:r Berater:in aufzutreten, Gespräche auf C-Level-Ebene zu führen, Kundenstrategien mitzugestalten und Expansionspotenziale sicher zu identifizieren und zu erschließen
  • Eine strukturierte und agile Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Accounts über globale, funktionsübergreifende Teams hinweg eigenverantwortlich zu betreuen
  • Eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit, die in einer dynamischen, internationalen Tech-Kultur aufblüht, sowie eine Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 50 %, um wertvolle Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen

Von Vorteil: 

  • Weitere Sprachkenntnisse (Französisch oder Spanisch)

Our Benefits

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition

For more information on our benefits, visit this page.

Come as you are. Build with us.

Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.

We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community.

title: Senior Customer Support Advisor
descriptionHtml:
Location: Stoke-on-Trent ST1
Training Period: Will be conducted Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm for the first four weeks
Working hours: 40 hours per week, 5 days out of any 7 (8 hours a day, between 7:50am - 2am)

Remuneration Package

  • Up to 20% annual company bonus and unsociable hours allowance, when applicable
  • Office-based for the first 4 months (probation and training period) - this will allow you to get to know the team, soak up crucial knowledge and benefit from face to face support whilst learning the role!
  • Hybrid working (2 days in the office) available after successful completion of probation period

The Role

Providing the best in class service to our players needs lots of work. Your energy and passion will be put to good use, and the more you give, the more you’ll get in return.

LiveScore Group is home to LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet, three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming industries today. We are passionate and excited about what we do in the Sports Media, Gaming and Betting sector and are proud of the high ratings we have achieved. We live our values, aiming to enhance and increase the enjoyment of sport through innovative products and immersive experiences. Trust is important in how we work, ensuring we are a collaborative unit who holds each other accountable. Relentlessly ambitious in everything we do, we embrace change and understand that failure is part of success.

We use our platform for positive social change and work to build a company our employees are proud to work for. We have a long-term commitment to diversity and inclusion. Our I.D.E.A (Inclusion, Diversity, Equality, Awareness) Forum is critical to our business and is embedded in our organisational structure to support a sense of belonging for everyone and to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive.

We know a job description can often deter an applicant who does not believe they match 100% of our requirements. If you are interested in this position and have relevant experience, then we would still love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  •  Act as a first point of contact for our players providing them with a resolution to their sporting or gaming query. Sports betting happens quickly; in this role we will expect you to think fast and react even faster.
  • Try to resolve everything, first time, every time. With complex issues, you should ascertain urgency and follow the appropriate next steps in line with the department guidelines, escalating issues to the right department or Service Lead where appropriate.
  • Time is of the essence. You’d need to manage all tasks in an efficient and timely manner. If you follow the escalation procedure, keep track and see it through resolution, too.
  • Numbers are important. We need tip-top mathematicians to provide our players with transactional advice on banking, deposits, withdrawals, pricing and calculation of bet settlements.
  • The art of conversation. You’d need to communicate effectively and efficiently with players, colleagues, Service Leads and the Management Team to ensure delivery of business objectives.
  • Hit the spot. Our department KPIs need to be met (or exceeded) and so we ask that you’re fast, efficient and that you get it right first time to thrill our players and reduce duplicate contacts.
  • Knowledge is power - Keep on top of sports, as well as our other products and tools, to ensure you’re keeping up with our players, and with the business and department’s strategy.
  • Collaborate with other departments, take part in projects, and attend meetings at other locations as required.
  • Have fun, making fun – Contribute to, and promote, a positive working environment.
  • Become a constant, positive role model and drive to inspire others to have fun whilst working.
  • Be proactive and demonstrate Real Time Resource Management awareness maintaining service levels and efficiencies.
  • Deflect Operator Complaints by handling 2nd line escalations and finding positive solutions.
  • Have a flexible attitude towards shift patterns.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • A key understanding of the business and department OKRs with a determination to achieve and exceed targets.
  • A technical problem solver with a focus on helping develop internal functions.
  • An ability to bring outstanding issues to a resolution, building key relationships across the business.
  • Liaise with key stakeholders raising critical issues and reduce the customer propensity to contact.
  • To escalate and help guide company decisions through sharing voice of the player feedback.
  • A problem solver whilst showing commercial awareness for each player.
  • An expert in the group marketing initiatives and internal functions and processes.
  • To be able to resolve complex queries and show a commitment in helping guide the CS Advisor group. 
  • Maintain & exceed the internal QA score going above and beyond for each customer contact.
  • An expert in handling multiple Live Chat, email & social media
  • Outstanding customer handling skills, as well as oral and written communication skills
  • An investigative approach whilst fact-finding to guarantee first contact resolution
  • Excellent PC skills, who is an expert with Excel and the web.
  • Fast and accurate typing skills
  • Sports knowledge & a passion for sports is essential

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance bonus
  • Hybrid working for all staff with flexible working opportunities
  • Private Healthcare scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised gym membership
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Daily snacks, quality coffee, soft drinks and regular socials

title: Senior Customs & Trade Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Internationale handel wordt steeds complexer. Veranderende douanewetgeving, geopolitieke ontwikkelingen, strengere compliance-eisen en digitalisering stellen organisaties voor nieuwe uitdagingen. Tegelijkertijd ontstaan kansen om handelsstromen slimmer, efficiënter en kosten-effectiever in te richten.

Als Senior Customs & Trade Consultant bij Customs Support Group help jij organisaties om die uitdagingen om te zetten in concrete oplossingen. Je combineert diepgaande kennis van douane en internationale handel met strategisch inzicht, commercieel gevoel en de ambitie om daadwerkelijk impact te maken. Je adviseert nationale en internationale ondernemingen, leidt uitdagende consultancyprojecten en ontwikkelt samen met klanten innovatieve oplossingen. Geen traditionele adviesrol, maar een positie waarin inhoudelijke expertise, ondernemerschap en daadwerkelijke implementatie samenkomen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent een vertrouwd adviseur voor klanten, variërend van ambitieuze mkb-organisaties tot internationale multinationals. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen complexe douanevraagstukken, strategische besluitvorming en operationele verbeteringen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Strategisch douaneadvies: adviseren over internationale handelsstructuren, douaneregelingen, tariefindeling, oorsprong, douanewaarde en optimalisatie van douanekosten.

  • Customs & Trade Compliance: begeleiden van organisaties bij AEO, vergunningen, interne beheersing, risicomanagement en naleving van internationale handelswetgeving.

  • Business Transformation: analyseren en verbeteren van douaneprocessen, governance en internationale supplychains, waarbij je regelgeving vertaalt naar praktische oplossingen.

  • Digitalisering & Innovatie: adviseren over de inzet van technologie, data, automatisering en AI binnen douane- en handelsprocessen.

  • Projectmanagement: zelfstandig leiden van complexe adviestrajecten, van analyse en advies tot implementatie en resultaat.

  • Business Development: herkennen van commerciële kansen, ontwikkelen van klantproposities en ondersteunen bij het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties.

  • Thought Leadership: delen van expertise via trainingen, workshops, presentaties en kennissessies voor klanten en collega's.


Je bent een ervaren douaneprofessional die inhoudelijke diepgang combineert met strategisch en commercieel inzicht. Je hebt een stevige professionele basis en bent toe aan een rol met meer verantwoordelijkheid, zelfstandigheid en invloed.

Wat breng je mee?

  • HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in fiscaal recht, fiscale economie, bedrijfskunde, logistiek of internationale handel.

  • Ruime ervaring binnen customs consultancy, internationale handel, de Douane, het bedrijfsleven of een vergelijkbare adviesomgeving.

  • Diepgaande kennis van Europese douanewetgeving en relevante ontwikkelingen binnen internationale handel.

  • Ervaring met het zelfstandig adviseren van klanten en het leiden van complexe projecten.

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om juridische en operationele vraagstukken te vertalen naar strategische adviezen.

  • Een ondernemende instelling en gevoel voor commerciële kansen.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met business development, digitalisering van douaneprocessen of internationale transformatieprojecten is een duidelijke meerwaarde.

Belangrijker dan een specifiek carrièrepad vinden wij jouw expertise, professionele volwassenheid en vermogen om klanten verder te helpen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wij bieden een seniorpositie met veel zelfstandigheid, inhoudelijke uitdaging en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Salaris van € 5.500 tot € 8.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Aantrekkelijke variabele bonusregeling gekoppeld aan prestaties en resultaten.

  • Leaseauto volgens onze uitgebreide autoregeling.

  • 25 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheden om aanvullende dagen op te bouwen.

  • 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • Uitstekende pensioenregeling, met slechts 4,5% eigen bijdrage.

  • € 50 netto per maand well-being budget.

  • Hybride werken.

  • Moderne IT- en thuiswerkvoorzieningen.

  • Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden en toegang tot onze Customs Support Academy.

  • Nationale en internationale ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden.

descriptionHtml:

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.
About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill.

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.


    • Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Personalisation
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Every courier who works with Relay chooses their day. A day is a set of routes that have to fit together, and every courier's ideal day competes with everyone else's. Work is finite and every route still has to be covered, so matching thousands of couriers to the work they want is a recommendation problem with few precedents.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. There's no existing recommender to iterate on. You'll build it.

Recommender Systems Highlights

  • Combinatorial, constrained and competitive: every recommendation has to be feasible for the whole network, not just right for one courier.

  • Your models power large-scale optimisation that balances thousands of couriers' preferences against the constraints of a physical network.

  • Price is part of the recommendation, so economics, personalisation and optimisation have to work as one.

  • Our apps collect millions of data points every day.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Data Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Set the standard for recommender systems at Relay.

  • Lead the evolution of Relay's recommender from research to production.

  • Design and build the recommender systems that power Relay's key decisions.

  • Partner with Operational Research to unite recommender models and optimisation.

  • Contribute to Relay's research culture, and develop our voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have built recommender systems at scale, owned them in production, and led their direction.

  • Bring deep expertise in recommender systems, reinforcement learning and LLMs, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Think in experiments, and let evidence guide decisions.

  • Are energised by open-ended problems, and know how to make them tractable.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Engineer - IAM and Workplace Technology
descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll join Tech as a Senior Engineer. Tech owns identity and access, IT and workplace technology for the whole company. Today it's a Workplace Tech engineer and an IAM engineer, and you'll be the most senior engineer on the team.

This is a hands-on role. You'll work the access and IT queue with the team, and you'll lead the technical work that shrinks it: the automation, the identity platform and the roadmap. As Primer grows and the team grows with it, there's room for the role to grow too, including into leading the team for the right person.

Tech is an enablement team. It sits alongside Security Engineering, not inside it, and owns the request queue and the tools that keep everyone at Primer productive. Primer is growing fast, and access requests are growing even faster. Our job is to make getting the right access quick, safe and mostly automatic, so people can get on with their work and our security engineers can get back to security.

What you'll be doing

  • Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality.

  • Lead the technical roadmap for Tech and deliver it, starting with SCIM day-1 provisioning, Okta, automated access reviews and device enrolment.

  • Automate the routine. Use identity tooling, scripting, workflow automation and AI to take repetitive access requests off people's plates.

  • Run joiner, mover and leaver processes so new starters have what they need on day one and access is removed promptly when it should be.

  • Keep access controls audit-ready. Work with Security and GRC on access reviews, least privilege and evidence for PCI DSS and SOC 2.

  • Partner with Security Engineering on the calls that need them, such as privileged access and policy exceptions, and handle the rest within Tech.

  • Mentor the other engineers on the team, review their work and share what you know.

  • Track and report on how the queue is doing: volume, turnaround, and how much automation is taking off it.

What we're looking for

  • Senior-level experience in IT, IAM or corporate engineering at a fast-growing tech company

  • Hands-on with an identity provider (Okta preferred; Entra ID, Google Workspace or similar also welcome), including SSO, SCIM and lifecycle management

  • A track record of automating manual IT and access work, with scripting, workflow tools or APIs

  • Experience with SaaS administration and endpoint management (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Intune)

  • Good judgement about access: you understand least privilege and know when something needs a security review

  • Experience owning projects end to end and helping others on the team level up

  • Clear, friendly written communication. Much of the job is helping colleagues across the business

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

  • Experience running access reviews and providing audit evidence

  • Using AI tools to speed up support and operations work

  • Experience scaling an IT function through a period of fast headcount growth

You may not like it here if...

  • You're looking for a management role. This is a hands-on senior engineering role.

  • You'd rather follow an established playbook. A lot of this is being set up for the first time, and you'll be the one defining how it works.

  • You prefer to fix requests one at a time rather than remove the reasons they come in. We measure success by how much of the queue disappears.

  • Shifting priorities frustrate you. We're a growing company and the team's focus will change as we scale.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Flexible holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to manage repairs, maintenance, compliance, and contractor operations at scale.Our platform combines marketplace infrastructure, workflow software, automation, and operational analytics.

It is designed for the complexity, volume, and regulatory demands of social housing, public sector property portfolios, and large residential operations. We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany.

We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you want to work on hard, real-world problems in the world's largest asset class, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Plentific's product engineering organisation. You will manage the team leads of multiple engineering teams covering the core domains of our platform, with full accountability for the engineers across every discipline frontend, backend, mobile, and quality. You will report to the VP of Engineering.


You bring deep technical knowledge and a strong appetite for learning especially around agentic AI and how it is reshaping the way software is built. Your hands-on coding focuses on the engineering organisation itself: improving the agentic tooling, the SDD framework, and the developer experience that makes every engineer faster and better. You stay close to the codebase, contribute code where it unblocks progress or moves the agentic SDLC forward, and review pull requests in enough depth to assess code quality, the maturity of our agentic practice, and individual engineer performance. You are equally comfortable in a 1:1 with a struggling engineer, in a roadmap conversation with a product manager, and in a design review with a staff engineer.


Plentific's agentic software development transformation is already under way and producing results. We need a leader who can keep the momentum, expand it across every team, and partner with our engineering guild to refine the spec-driven development (SDD) framework, the agentic tooling, and the practices that have got us this far. You will help roll out SDD across the engineering organisation, drive adoption, and track the outcomes.


Success looks like a team that is continuously getting stronger: accelerating delivery cadence against business commitments, rising engineering standards, and an agentic development practice that compounds month on month.

Key Responsibilities

descriptionHtml:

De nachtdiensten zijn meestal van dinsdag t/m zaterdagochtend. De middagdiensten werk je voornamelijk van maandag t/m vrijdag. Werktijden kunnen soms iets afwijken door de drukte in de operatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker combineer je uitvoerende werkzaamheden met een coördinerende rol. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer, bewaakt de voortgang van het proces en ondersteunt de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse aansturing van het team.

  • Laden, lossen, scannen en sorteren van pakketten.

  • Collega's begeleiden en ondersteunen.

  • De voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid bewaken.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Een hands-on, zelfstandige werkhouding.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Bereidheid om middag- en nachtdiensten te werken.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  3. Tweede gesprek: we bespreken de resultaten en gaan verder in op de functie.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Our humble expectations

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Manager, Financial Crime Compliance, Suspicious Activity Reporting
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the role

Reporting to the FCC Transaction Monitoring Lead and sitting within the Financial Crime Compliance function, this role will lead and oversee a team of analysts and conduct independent, risk-based reviews of complex cases escalated from first- and second-line operations, covering KYC, name screening and transaction monitoring. The role will apply sound judgement and provide clear, well-supported outcomes in line with established procedures

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee, mentor and train a team of FCC L3 analysts, ensuring high-quality case resolution, adherence to SLAs and process governance.

  • Review and resolve assigned KYC, enhanced due diligence, name-screening and transaction-monitoring cases, including alerts escalated from operational teams, in line with established procedures and applicable timelines.

  • Assess customer profiles, ownership and control structures, business activities, transaction patterns, counterparties and relevant supporting information.

  • Conduct appropriate internal and external research and critically assess information provided by customers or internal stakeholders.

  • Reach clear, evidence-based conclusions or recommendations, documenting the rationale, supporting evidence and any required follow-up actions.

  • Identify financial-crime risks, recurring themes and opportunities to improve processes or controls, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases, potential sanctions matches and suspicious activity concerns in line with established procedures.

  • Apply relevant local and global Financial Crime Compliance policies and procedures, maintain complete and accurate case records, and collaborate effectively with Operations and Compliance stakeholders.

  • Stay up-to-date with relevant financial-crime risks and regulatory developments, and support related Financial Crime Compliance Activities as needed.

  • Perform any ad-hoc tasks required by the line manager.

What you will bring:

  • Degree qualified or at least 8 years of working experience in the FCC space.

  • Proven track record of working in an AML/CTF or fraud investigations role.

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess complex information and reach well-reasoned conclusions.

  • Understanding of financial-crime risks, typologies and risk-based review practices.

  • Sound judgement, ownership and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail.

  • Experience in FinTech or start-up experience is strongly preferred.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have...

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

You'll get…

If based in New York or Toronto:

  • Competitive salary & retirement savings plan with company match
  • Generous parental leave & PTO policy, plus paid holidays
  • Flexible health, dental, and vision plans
  • Up to 75% discount on HelloFresh subscription
  • Emergency child and adult care services
  • Snacks & monthly catered lunches

If based in Berlin or Warsaw:

  • Competitive salary and attractive local benefits package
  • Flexible working arrangements and generous vacation and parental leave in line with local market practice
  • Discounts of up to 75% on HelloFresh, Green Chef, and Factor boxes
  • Annual learning & development budget
  • Health & wellbeing program

If based in London:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package in line with UK market practice
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
  • Generous annual leave and parental leave policy
  • Up to 75% discount on HelloFresh subscription
  • Annual learning & development budget

If based in Amsterdam:

  • Competitive salary and attractive local benefits package
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements, with travel allowance in line with Dutch market practice
  • Generous annual leave and parental leave in line with local law
  • Discounts on HelloFresh, Green Chef, and Factor boxes
  • Annual learning & development budget
  • Health & wellbeing program

Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Die Rolle bietet dir die Möglichkeit, strategische Partnerschaften mit den führenden CTV-Vermarktern aktiv zu gestalten und auf Augenhöhe mit den wichtigsten Marktakteuren der Digitalbranche zu verhandeln. Dabei profitierst du von einem starken Netzwerk, einem hochprofessionellen Umfeld mit hervorragenden Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einem erfahrenen Team, das echte Zusammenarbeit und Wissenstransfer lebt. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Associate Director treibst du Innovationen voran und entwickelst dich zum Spezialisten für Partner Investment auf höchstem Niveau.  

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

  • Partnerschaften eigenverantwortlich steuern: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für ausgewählte Top-Marktpartner, baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und bist deren zentraler Ansprechpartner.
  • Verhandlungsführung: Du bereitest Jahresverhandlungen aktiv vor und führst diese selbstständig, um marktführende Einkaufskonditionen und exzellente Rahmenverträge zu sichern.
  • Schnittstellen orchestrieren: Du übersetzt strategische Investmentziele in die Praxis und moderierst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen.
  • Marktanalysen & Controlling: Du behältst die Performance deiner Partner fest im Blick, analysierst Marktentwicklungen und leitest daraus klare, kommerzielle Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Vertrags-Compliance:‎ Die sorgfältige Prüfung von Rahmenvereinbarungen und die Sicherstellung der korrekten vertraglichen Hinterlegung liegen in deiner Hand.
  • Finanzielle Steuerung:‎ Die Erstellung präziser Prognosen, das Tracking von Umsätzen und die Durchführung von quartalsweisen Abgleichen mit Vermarktern.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Erfahrung im Digitalmarkt: Du bringst mindestens 4 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Digital- oder Medienumfeld mit (z. B. in Media-Agenturen oder der Vermarktung).
  • Verhandlungsstärke: Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung von Verhandlungen und besitzt ein ausgeprägtes kommerzielles und analytisches Gespür.
  • Tiefes Branchenwissen: Die digitale Medialandschaft (von Streaming, CTV, ATV und Programmatic) ist dein Zuhause.
  • Souveräner Gestalter: Du denkst unternehmerisch, handelst proaktiv und übernimmst mit Begeisterung die volle Ownership für deine Themen.
  • Kommunikationsprofi: Du überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten, sowie exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und fließendem Englisch.
  • Analysevermögen: Du hast eine ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität und bist sicher in der Analyse von Zahlen, Daten, Fakten und Ableitungen daraus inkl. der Darstellung dieser in Excel.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #innovativ #neugierig #kommunikativ

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
