descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defence capability.

About the Job

Senior Software Engineering Managers independently lead groups of teams to deliver a variety of software integrated in to our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control or decision support. We expect Senior Software Engineering Managers to demonstrate independent end-to-end outcome ownership of software for an integrated product family, and the teams responsible for building and maintaining it. Senior Software Engineering Managers contribute as a group lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with your Technical Lead and other managers to design and deliver on a multi-year, multi-stakeholder software roadmap that spans across multiple groups of teams and products
  • Leverage internal product and program-specific engineering teams, and external third-parties, to rapidly deliver capability beyond the scope of current platforms, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time
  • Manage architecture selection and design for robotic systems, including hardware selection, compute, storage and network architecture, service orchestration and other software platform concerns that balance constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment
  • Influence the design and development of a company wide roadmap for software inputs to autonomous systems, ensuring it meets the needs of your group
  • Manage a group of teams that develop software that runs on- and off- platform, using a variety of technologies
  • Influence peers and executives within your broader cross-functional engineering organization, ensuring that software engineers who are employed in cross-functional engineering teams reporting to your peers are appropriately employed and managed
  • Act as a subject matter expert for software engineering, representing software equities in a multi-stakeholder environment including engineering, business and sales leadership
  • Drive the design and implementation of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of software, including full lifecycle testing
  • Build and manage a 12 - 36 month roadmap for your group, nested within broader organisational and company roadmap
  • Manage an allocated budget for your group
  • Manage programmatic risk for your group, and collaborate with your Technical Lead to manage technical risk, including sound and timely decision making
  • Lead by example as a technically competent, trustworthy, and accountable leader
  • Contribute to the development of organizational vision and strategy, then communicate it effectively to your group
  • Define, document, gain consensus for, and communicate appropriate goals and plans for your group, derived from broader organizational vision, strategy, and priorities
  • Build your subordinate teams and managers through mentoring, professional development, career management, and collaboration with Anduril’s recruiting and people functions
  • Work as a leader of a multi-disciplinary engineering group of 10 - 24 members, including as a mentor and manager for engineers and managers from differing backgrounds, and with “dotted line” responsibility for an additional 10 - 24 software engineers that report to your peers
  • Report to a manager who typically will not have a background in software engineering
  • Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in a senior management position within a high performing technology organization
  • Extensive professional experience working as a Software Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise
  • Capacity to lead a group that works holistically on software enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment
  • Capacity to act as the owner for a software platform spanning multiple integrated products, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation management, sustainment and evolution
  • Capacity learn and grow individually, while mentoring team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a senior role for the delivery of a military mission system and/or autonomous vehicle
  • Experience writing backend services or embedded software in C, C++, Rust and/or Go
  • Experience writing frontend applications using Typescript and React
  • Experience working with a RTOS
  • Experience with the design, implementation and operation of horizontally scaled cloud technologies
  • Experience with the design, implementation and support of embedded software, particularly in the field of robotics
  • Experience with modeling and simulation
  • Familiarity with communications busses and protocols (e.g. CAN, CANFD, UART/RS232/RS422/RS485, SPI, QSPI, I2C, Ethernet, ARINC-825, ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553, etc).
  • Experience with development of high assurance safety critical software, including with DO-178, IEC 61508, or similar standards
  • Experience in design and development of embedded applications in autonomous vehicle software systems.
  • Experience in developing interfaces to sensors and actuators.
  • Experience working with and testing electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Familiarity with navigation and communications systems.
  • Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Familiarity with Systems Engineering concepts
  • Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Senior Software Engineering Manager, such as Software Engineering Director

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - CAD
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you join the early team as a core architect of the physical body of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. Whatever your background in industrial or humanoid robotics, you bring rock-solid mechanical engineering fundamentals to every joint, structure and interface you touch, and you take pride in getting the basics unquestionably right.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Architectural Design: Turn high-level concepts into production-ready CAD - with a focus on lightweight structures and actuation integration - and define mass distribution and interfaces together with the adjacent engineering teams.

  • Load Path Design: Apply load-path-aligned design so every part carries load efficiently and predictably from point of application to ground.

  • Design Validation: Back your designs with sound hand calculations and work closely with our simulation engineers to reach sign-off fast.

  • DFM/DFA Excellence: Design every component for manufacturability and assembly at scale from day one, working closely with the workshop, suppliers and supply chain to eliminate late-stage redesigns.

  • Mentorship & Standards: Establish the organization's mechanical design standards and mentor junior engineers in mechanical engineering best practices.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.

Must have

  • Experience: 5+ years in high-performance robotics, automotive or aerospace engineering. A proven track record of shipping complex hardware products is essential.

  • Mastery of CAD: Expert level in CAD, including complex assemblies, lightweight structural design and production drawings with GD&T.

  • Mechanical Fundamentals: Rock-solid, first-principles command of bearing selection, fastener calculation, strength assessment and load-path-aligned design.

  • Product Design Experience: Deep knowledge in the functional design of high-tech products (ideally robotics), including layout design and structural mechanics.

  • DFM/DFA Proficiency: Strong command of design for series production, focusing on manufacturing-driven design optimization, parts reduction, assembly-friendly tolerancing and cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) reduction.

  • Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You understand that a robot in the real world faces forces and failures that don't exist in a simulation, and you design accordingly.

Nice to have

  • FEA: Hands-on experience with structural and modal FEA for quick design studies.

  • Thermal Management: A good understanding of passive and active cooling concepts.

  • Lightweight Materials: Experience with composite, magnesium or high-strength aluminum structures.

  • Actuation: Experience integrating actuators together with internal teams or external partners.

  • Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - kinematics, actuation and the interplay between mechanics and control.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Partnerships Manager, Supply Network (F/M/X)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

Industrial companies hold millions of spare parts, and many more are available from resellers, distributors, and the companies that build production lines. Your mission is to connect these worlds. You will build SPARETECH's supply network: the partners who sell parts to our customers and the partners who buy parts from them.

You will define how we work with resellers, distributors, and line builders, win them as partners, and turn these partnerships into new ways for manufacturers to find, buy, and sell the parts that keep their production running.

We offer you the opportunity to

  • Build a new channel from the ground up: Shape SPARETECH's partnership strategy for resellers, distributors, and line builders.
  • Win strategic partners: Lead partner acquisition from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Design the deal: Develop value propositions and commercial models that work for our partners and our customers.
  • Shape what we build: Work with Product and Engineering to bring partner offerings into the SPARETECH platform.
  • Create value in both directions: Help our customers buy the parts they need and sell the parts they no longer use.
  • Take real ownership: Work closely with leadership in a role where your strategy and execution are visible.
  • Work remote-first: Work from within Germany as part of an international team.

Become a part of the team if you

  • Bring experience: Have 6+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, channel management, or key account management.
  • Know the industry: Have worked in or with manufacturing, industrial distribution, automation, or OEM after-sales.
  • Close partnerships: Have structured and negotiated commercial partnerships with senior stakeholders.
  • Think and execute: Can design a partnership approach from scratch and run it hands-on.
  • Stay persistent: Enjoy long sales cycles and building trust over time.
  • Speak fluently: Are fluent in German and English (C1 or higher).

You can expect

  • A remote-yes company, where you can decide every day whether you work from home, at our Stuttgart or Munich office, or at any Design Office in Germany
  • A permanent employment contract, 30 days of vacation, and the opportunity to participate in the company's success through our VSOP program
  • Modern hardware and the frame for a height-adjustable desk
  • An annual training budget of 1000 EURO for your professional development
  • In Germany: A subsidized job bike to escape city traffic and a Wellpass gym membership to stay active
  • To enjoy Corporate Benefits, including discounts on fashion, travel, and much more from various companies
  • A dynamic start-up atmosphere and an international team in which new ideas, creative approaches, and cooperation at eye level are valued

About SPARETECH

SPARETECH's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.

To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.

Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Fokus Google Ads / SEA
descriptionHtml:
Ihre Aufgaben

Dein Hauptfokus liegt auf der operativen und strategischen Skalierung unseres Werbekanals SEA (Google Ads + Microsoft Ads)

  • Du verantwortest unsere Werbe-Accounts und entwickelst die Kampagnenstruktur für lokale und deutschlandweite Nachfrage weiter.
  • Du steuerst Gebote nicht auf möglichst viele Anfragen, sondern auf qualifizierte Anfragen und Aufträge.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Daten stimmen: Conversion Tracking, GA4, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions und die Rückspielung von Lead-Status aus unserem CRM an die jeweilige Plattform.

Zusätzlich übernimmst du den Auf- und Ausbau unserer Paid-Social-Aktivitäten (Meta Ads).

  • Du testest, welche Formate und Zielgruppen bei Meta für Immobiliengutachten funktionieren, und entscheidest auf Basis von Lead-Qualität, ob und wie wir skalieren.
  • Du brieft unser Marketing-Team für Creatives und Landingpages und bewertest Tests anhand klarer Kriterien.

Du arbeitest hands-on in den Accounts, stimmst dich strategisch direkt mit unserem Head of Marketing ab und steuerst das Budget ROI-getrieben.

  • Du baust eigenständig ein passendes Reporting, welches zeigt, was unsere Werbe-Ausgaben an Aufträgen bringt und wie effizient.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen, damit klar ist, welche Anfragen wirklich zu den Aufträgen führen welche wir wünschen.

Ihr Profil

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Google Ads und hast Accounts mit relevantem Budget selbst verantwortet, inhouse oder in einer Agentur.
  • Du kennst Lead-Generierung aus der Praxis und weißt, warum ein günstiger Lead nicht automatisch ein guter Lead ist.
  • Du bist sicher in Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen und Smart Bidding.
  • Du setzt Tracking selbst auf und findest Fehler selbst: Google Tag oder Tag Manager, GA4, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions.
  • Du hast schon Offline-Conversions oder Enhanced Conversions for Leads aus einem CRM an Google angebunden oder eng begleitet.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Meta Ads und Lust, den Kanal bei uns aufzubauen.
  • Du rechnest gern: Du kannst begründen, ab wann zusätzliche Ausgaben sich nicht mehr lohnt.

Pluspunkte, aber kein Muss: Server-Side Tagging, Meta Conversions API, Microsoft Advertising, Erfahrung mit beratungsintensiven Dienstleistungen mit hohem Auftragswert, erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem, wenn dich die Rolle reizt und der Kern passt.

Warum wir?

Bei CERTA beginnt ein Großteil der Aufträge mit einer Suche bei Google oder Bing. Bezahlte Suche ist für uns deshalb teil unseres Kerngeschäfts. Somit hat deine Arbeit direkten Einfluss auf unser Wachstum und unseren Erfolg.

Du bekommst Gestaltungsspielraum. Du bist die erste Person, die bei uns Performance Marketing als eigenen Bereich verantwortet. Entscheidungen triffst du direkt mit dem Head of Marketing und der Geschäftsführung, ohne lange Abstimmungsschleifen.

Du bekommst klare Verantwortung. Du steuerst Kanäle und Budget mit eigenen Entscheidungsbefugnissen. Diese halten wir dir zum Start schriftlich fest, damit von Tag eins klar ist, was du selbst entscheidest.

Du bekommst eine Perspektive. Performance Marketing soll bei uns ein eigener Bereich werden, neben unserem Marketing-Team für SEO, Visuals und Landingpages. Wenn die Ergebnisse stimmen und das Wachstum es trägt, baust du mittelfristig ein kleines Performance-Team auf. Der erste Schritt ist eine zusätzliche Person für Paid Social oder Tracking und deine Rolle als Lead Performance Marketing. Den Weg dorthin und die Kriterien besprechen wir offen im Bewerbungsprozess.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team 

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

The role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join us in supporting our post-purchase experience and international expansion. Design serves a vital role at Affirm: from building narratives through data to creating products that help people make important financial decisions. As a designer, you are responsible for crafting experiences that build trust, confidence and deliver on our principles of honest, transparent financial products.

We’re at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey, with millions of people engaging with our products and new opportunities to expand how they use Affirm every day. We’re also growing globally, reaching new customers in new geographies every day. 

This Product Designer will help shape our post-purchase experiences, as well as building the next new geographies that Affirm will expand into. You can demonstrate a breadth of design experience leveraging your ability to create delightful experiences that simplify our customers’ payment management experience through Affirm as well as contributing to our wider international expansion strategy. You’ll partner well with design leadership, design research, and content design. You’ll work end-to-end, from contributing towards Design and Product vision to delivering class leading design. You are able to work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor unique customer experiences for our merchants & consumers while ensuring cohesion to the core Affirm experience - championing our customers needs no matter where their journey starts.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end design for key initiatives within our UK and international experiences, as well as our post purchase experiences globally, across App and Web. You’ll be driving from discovery through to delivery and iteration—achieving meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Own complex flows and ambiguous problem spaces, defining clear problem statements, success metrics, and design direction.

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and data to make informed trade-offs and deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences.

  • Balance speed and quality, making pragmatic decisions while contributing to a cohesive product experience.

  • Use research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes.

  • Contribute to design systems and patterns, strengthening consistency and scalability across your area.

  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making, ensuring teams move forward with clarity.

  • Support and mentor other designers, helping raise the quality of work across the team.

What we look for

  • Strong Craft & Execution: You consistently deliver polished, thoughtful interaction and visual design with high attention to detail.

  • Product Thinking: You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make sound design decisions and improve end-to-end experiences.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive work forward with minimal oversight.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: You build strong partnerships, communicate clearly, and help teams align on decisions and trade-offs.

  • Data-Informed Decision Making: You use research, experimentation, and analytics to guide your work and iterate toward better outcomes.

  • Team-Level Influence: You’re a trusted design partner within your area, contributing to direction and improving how the team works.

  • Growth & Adaptability: You seek feedback, continuously improve your craft, and leverage modern tools—including AI—to accelerate your workflow.

  • Tools & Experience: Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (Figma, G Suite, Notion, etc.).

  • 5+ years of product design experience or equivalent practical experience.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • You’ll design financial products that genuinely help people.

  • You’ll work on high-impact experiences used by millions of customers.

  • You’ll join a team that values craft, collaboration, and thoughtful iteration.

  • You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope, influence, and leadership over time.

This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: L

Equity Grade: UK 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £101,000 - 149,000

Location: Remote UK

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

Experience that would be valuable

  • Experience building or launching agentic, AI-native or workflow automation products.
  • Working knowledge of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent orchestration.
  • Experience working with responsible AI, data governance, privacy or security considerations in enterprise environments.
  • Experience leading, coaching or developing product managers.

We value relevant skills and experience gained through different career paths. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in place of rigid formal requirements.

How you lead

  • Strategic thinker: You connect product investments to business outcomes and build compelling, actionable roadmaps.
  • Commercially minded: You understand value creation, customer needs, product economics and adoption.
  • Influential collaborator: You build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities and resolve conflicts constructively.
  • Execution focused: You make informed decisions in ambiguous environments and balance speed, quality and scalability.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise Products
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise Products to shape how we position, launch, and scale our enterprise products like Vibe and Studio.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of product, technology, and go-to-market strategy. You’ll translate complex product capabilities into clear, differentiated value propositions that resonate with enterprise decision-makers, technical buyers, and practitioners. You’ll define how we take our products to market, build repeatable messaging and enablement frameworks, and equip our commercial teams to articulate why Mistral is the right partner for organisations adopting AI at scale.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, Developer Relations, and Communications, you’ll influence both how our products evolve and how we bring them to market. You’ll help establish the foundations for scaling our enterprise platform business in a rapidly evolving and highly competitive AI landscape.

What you will do

Product positioning and messaging

  • Own positioning and messaging for Mistral’s enterprise products, translating technical capabilities into differentiated value propositions for enterprise customers.

  • Develop compelling narratives that connect platform functionality to business outcomes, technical requirements, and customer priorities.

  • Tailor messaging to different audiences, from CIOs and technology leaders to developers, AI engineers, and business stakeholders.

  • Define our competitive positioning against proprietary AI platforms, hyperscalers, and emerging alternatives, articulating the value of Mistral’s open-weight models, flexibility, and deployment options.

  • Build a consistent messaging architecture across products, use cases, customer segments, and go-to-market channels.

Go-to-market strategy and product launches

  • Lead go-to-market strategy for new enterprise platform capabilities, from launch planning and audience definition to positioning, activation, and post-launch optimisation.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to understand the roadmap, identify market opportunities, and translate product developments into compelling customer propositions.

  • Identify high-value enterprise use cases and customer segments, developing repeatable GTM plays that support adoption and commercial growth.

  • Establish clear launch frameworks, working cross-functionally to align Product, Sales, Solutions, Marketing, Communications, and Developer Relations around priorities and execution.

  • Measure launch effectiveness and product adoption, using customer feedback and performance data to refine positioning and GTM strategy.

Sales and field enablement

  • Equip Sales and Solutions teams with the messaging, assets, and commercial narratives they need to position Mistral’s enterprise platforms effectively.

  • Develop scalable enablement materials, including use-case playbooks, competitive battlecards, customer presentations, product demos, and objection-handling guides.

  • Translate customer challenges and technical requirements into compelling business cases that support enterprise evaluation and purchasing decisions.

  • Partner with field teams to identify recurring customer objections, competitive dynamics, and barriers to adoption, feeding these insights back into product and marketing strategy.

  • Build repeatable frameworks that help commercial teams communicate platform value consistently across industries, markets, and buyer personas.

Content and customer storytelling

  • Develop a content strategy that brings Mistral’s enterprise platform capabilities to life through product narratives, technical explainers, demonstrations, customer stories, and thought leadership.

  • Work with Content, Communications, Developer Relations, and Solutions teams to create credible, technically grounded content that resonates with enterprise buyers and practitioners.

  • Turn customer implementations and emerging use cases into compelling stories that demonstrate measurable business value.

  • Support integrated campaigns and demand generation initiatives with clear messaging, audience insights, and content tailored to the enterprise buying journey.

  • Ensure our content connects technical differentiation to the practical realities of deploying and scaling AI in enterprise environments.

Market intelligence and customer insights

  • Develop a strong understanding of enterprise AI adoption, platform buying behaviour, competitive offerings, and emerging customer needs.

  • Gather insights from customers, prospects, Sales, Solutions, and partners to identify unmet needs, adoption barriers, and opportunities for differentiation.

  • Build a clear view of the competitive landscape, translating market intelligence into actionable recommendations for product positioning, roadmap priorities, and GTM investments.

  • Identify emerging enterprise AI use cases and market segments where Mistral can establish a differentiated position.

  • Track the impact of positioning and GTM initiatives through relevant measures, including product adoption, pipeline influence, sales enablement effectiveness, and launch performance.

What we're looking for

  • Deep experience in product marketing, ideally within enterprise software, AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or other technically complex products.

  • A proven track record of developing differentiated product positioning and messaging that translates technical capabilities into clear customer and business value.

  • Experience leading product launches and building go-to-market strategies for enterprise technology products, from early positioning through adoption and commercial scale.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys, including technical evaluation, stakeholder alignment, procurement considerations, and the challenges of deploying new technologies at scale.

  • Ability to engage credibly with technical audiences while communicating effectively with executive and business stakeholders.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and other cross-functional teams to drive alignment and execution.

  • A commercial mindset, with the ability to connect product marketing initiatives to adoption, pipeline development, deal progression, and revenue growth.

  • Strong competitive and market intelligence skills, with the ability to turn customer and market insights into actionable GTM strategies.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for simplifying complex concepts into clear, compelling narratives.

  • A hands-on, proactive approach and the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and build repeatable processes in a fast-moving environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing AI platforms, model platforms, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise developer tools.

  • Familiarity with LLMs, open-weight models, AI deployment architectures, and the practical challenges organisations face when moving AI from experimentation into production.

  • Experience marketing products to both technical practitioners and enterprise decision-makers.

  • Understanding of enterprise AI requirements, including security, governance, privacy, scalability, and deployment flexibility.

  • Experience working in a high-growth technology company where product positioning, GTM strategy, and operating models are still evolving.

Why join Mistral?

At Mistral, you’ll help shape how organisations adopt and scale AI through products that give them greater choice and control over their technology. You’ll work alongside world-class researchers, engineers, product leaders, and commercial teams to bring ambitious ideas to market.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on our enterprise strategy, build the foundations for repeatable product marketing at scale, and help define how one of Europe’s leading AI companies competes in a global market.

About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Role:

IonQ is hiring a Senior Quantum Sales Director to drive new and expansion revenue for Capella Data as a Service (DaaS) and satellite systems across EMEA. You will own a portfolio of strategic enterprise, defence and government accounts, selling SAR imagery and analytics subscriptions, tasking capacity and complete satellite systems, and you will report to Garrick Ballantine.

This is a quota carrying, hunter oriented role for a seller who can run long cycle capital programmes alongside faster moving data subscriptions, and who can translate space based sensing into mission and business outcomes. The role is remote, employed through an IonQ entity in the UK (Oxford) or Switzerland, with travel of up to 20%.

Responsibilities:

You will own an annual new business and expansion quota across Capella DaaS subscriptions, tasking capacity and satellite system sales within an assigned enterprise, defence and civil government territory in EMEA. You will build and execute account plans for a named portfolio, mapping stakeholders across mission, programme, procurement and technical functions and building executive relationships at several levels in each account.

You will sell the full value chain, from SAR data and analytics subscriptions and recurring tasking commitments to ground segment integration and dedicated or jointly owned satellite systems. Working with product, engineering and mission solutions teams, you will bring customer requirements back into the roadmap and represent IonQ at industry, defence and geospatial conferences.

You will have command of a structured sales methodology such as MEDDICC or Challenger, with disciplined CRM and forecasting rigour, and the ability to engage credibly with technical and mission stakeholders on remote sensing, SAR, tasking and data delivery workflows. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht en vanuit huis ben jij voor hen hét aanspreekpunt. In een groeiende organisatie waar gebouwd wordt met collega’s die hart voor onze klanten hebben én oog voor elkaar. Kom jij meebouwen?

Jouw baan als senior relatiebeheerder zakelijk

Als relatiebeheerder zakelijke verzekeringen word je de rechterhand van je buitendienstcollega. Samen zijn jullie eigenaar van jullie portefeuille met bestaande én potentiële MKB - relaties in de regio Utrecht en omstreken. Deze portefeuille bestaat voornamelijk uit grotere klanten die o.a. actief zijn in de vastgoedsector. Ondernemend als je bent, bespreek je op jouw initiatief de zakelijke risico’s die jullie klanten lopen en welke financiële gevolgen dit kan hebben. Ook adviseer je over verzekerbare oplossingen én te treffen preventiemaatregelen.

  • Dankzij jou is de agenda van je buitendienstcollega goed gevuld met afspraken.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat je buitendienstcollega goed voorbereid het klantgesprek in gaat.

  • Je brengt op eigen initiatief offertes uit en legt alles netjes vast in onze systemen.

  • Je signaleert commerciële kansen en overtuigt klanten om totaalklant te worden.

  • Je handelt klantgesprekken af en neemt de nazorg volledig voor je rekening.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een goed salaris: schaal loopt van € 3.052,- tot € 5.755,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week. We stemmen de hoogte van je salaris af op je kennis en ervaring.

  • Deelname aan de collectieve pensioenregeling bij BeFrank.

  • Een maandelijkse netto internetvergoeding van € 20,-.

  • 27 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks maximaal 5 dagen bij te kopen.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer tot 40 km enkele reis of volledige vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op je zorgverzekering en de eigen verzekeringsproducten van HZG.

  • De mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen tegen fiscaal voordelige voorwaarden.

  • De flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken. Daarbij zorgen we ook voor een fijne en veilige thuiswerkplek.

  • Werken bij een topspeler in de Nederlandse assurantiemarkt die onderdeel is van de stabiele, internationale NN Group.

  • Blijvende aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en inzetbaarheid.

Jouw profiel

  • Werkervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening in een functie met zakelijk klantadvies.

  • De beroepskwalificaties Adviseur Schade en Inkomen. Heb je deze nog niet (allemaal)? Dan mag je ze op korte termijn en op onze kosten behalen.

  • Een gelukkige klant is jouw prioriteit. Jij houdt van klanten ontzorgen. Je toont interesse: je vraagt door en luistert aandachtig. Je signaleert commerciële kansen, denkt in oplossingen en bent in staat dit door te vertalen naar een duidelijk advies.

De afdeling
Je komt terecht in een team met drie collega’s op ons kantoor in Utrecht. Twee van hen werken ook in de binnendienst en één collega zit buiten bij onze klanten. In deze functie rapport je rechtstreeks aan de manager zakelijk advies Utrecht - Gelderland, Mike Peschke.

Dit zijn wij

Twee sterke bedrijven, Heinenoord Holding en Zicht, risico- en verzekeringsadviseurs. Samengebracht in één toekomstgerichte organisatie: HeinenoordZicht Groep. Een nieuwe naam, gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw ervaring. De kracht van digitale mogelijkheden combineren we met lokaal ondernemerschap én de professionaliteit van een grote landelijke Nederlandse speler.

Wij helpen elkaar en onze klanten vooruit. We geven onafhankelijk en professioneel advies en helpen bij het maken van bewuste keuzes over financiële risico’s. Dit geldt zowel richting onze klanten, als binnen de organisatie. Dit is wat ons energie geeft en waar ons talent ligt. Dit doen wij vanuit ons vakmanschap, onze passie, de rijke ervaring, maar ook de lokale verbinding. Dat is de reden waarom onze collega’s hier werken, waarom onze klanten bij ons komen. En wat ons verbindt. HeinenoordZicht Groep is een gaaf bedrijf: goed geregeld, aantrekkelijk voor medewerkers, aantrekkelijk voor klanten en financieel gezond.

Solliciteren?

Enthousiast geworden over deze vacature van senior relatiebeheerder zakelijk bij HeinenoordZicht Groep in Utrecht? Reageer dan via de solliciteerbutton.

We sluiten deze vacature als we een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden. Voor deze vacature werken wij niet samen met werving- en selectiebureaus.

title: Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) IT-Dienstleistungen
descriptionHtml:
Über Specific-Group Germany GmbH

Die Specific-Group (SPG) wurde 1998 in Wien gegründet und ist bis heute inhabergeführt. Mehr als 400 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten an 12 Standorten in acht Ländern, in Deutschland in München und Landshut. Wir entwickeln Software, beraten, leiten Projekte und stellen Kunden erfahrene Spezialisten zur Seite: Entwickler, Business Analysten, Tester, Projektmanager. Dazu kommen Softwareprodukte, die wir selbst entwickeln oder als Partner vertreiben.

Unser Vertrieb soll wachsen. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Person, die IT-Dienstleistung von innen kennt und mit IT-Leitern über deren Projekte sprechen kann, bevor es um Preise geht.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie gewinnen neue Kunden und bauen bestehende Accounts aus, vom ersten Termin bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag.

  • Sie verkaufen beides: unsere Dienstleistungen (Softwareentwicklung, Consulting, Projektmanagement, Business Analyse, Testing) und verschiedene Softwareprodukte aus unserem Portfolio.

  • Sie führen Bedarfsanalysen und Workshops mit IT-Leitern, Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung. Sie verstehen, was beim Kunden technisch und kaufmännisch los ist, und schlagen eine passende Lösung vor.

  • Sie erstellen Angebote gemeinsam mit unseren Delivery-Teams, kalkulieren Preise und verhandeln Verträge.

  • Sie planen Ihre Accounts selbst: Pipeline, Forecast, nächste Schritte. Alles landet sauber im CRM.

  • Sie halten Kontakt zu Herstellern und Partnern, deren Produkte wir mit anbieten.

Unsere Anforderungen

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Vertrieb von IT-Dienstleistungen, Softwareprojekten oder IT-Lösungen im B2B.

  • Sie wissen, wie ein Dienstleistungsprojekt läuft: Tagessätze, Festpreis, Rahmenvertrag, Staffing. Sie können mit einem Architekten über Technik und mit einem Einkauf über Konditionen sprechen.

  • Erfahrung, Produkte und Dienstleistung in einem Angebot zu kombinieren.

  • Nachweisbare Abschlüsse im Neukundengeschäft und ein Netzwerk sind ein Vorteil.

  • Sicheres Auftreten vor Entscheidern; Sie beraten auf Augenhöhe und sagen auch, wenn etwas nicht passt.

  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an Kundenterminen vor Ort.

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch gut. Führerschein Klasse B.

Was wir bieten

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 40 Wochenstunden und 30 Tagen Urlaub.

  • Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, der an Ihren Abschlüssen hängt. Die Höhe ist verhandelbar und richtet sich nach Ihrer Erfahrung.

  • Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung.

  • Ihr Office wählen Sie selbst: München (Leopoldstraße) oder Landshut. Sie arbeiten im Hybrid-Modell mit der Option auf Homeoffice und Remote-Arbeit sowie flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen fallen schnell.

  • Ein Team aus Entwicklern, Beratern und Projektleitern, das Ihre Angebote fachlich mitbaut.

  • Laptop, Smartphone, Trainings und Zertifizierungen.

Vergütung

Das Gehalt für diese Position liegt bei EUR 75,000–95,000 per year.

Jetzt bewerben

Schicken Sie an Frau Neslihan Pak Ihren Lebenslauf, Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung und Ihren frühesten Starttermin. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) | Singen (Hohentwiel)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen.

Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Bei hairfree erwarten dich klare Strukturen, moderne Prozesse, ein starkes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Beauty Sales Consultant / Kundenberater (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Lounge unseres Franchise-Partners am Standort Singen (Hohentwiel).

Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Interessentinnen und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Beratung, sondern darum, Vertrauen aufzubauen, Bedürfnisse zu erkennen und unsere Kundinnen für die passende Behandlungslösung zu begeistern.

Das Beste: Du arbeitest ausschließlich mit Hot-Leads. Das bedeutet, du erhältst täglich vorqualifizierte Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Attraktives Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provisionen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Hohe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (Coaching, Academy, interne Trainings)

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Unternehmens

  • Mitarbeiter-Events & Teamkultur

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung & gute Ausstattung

  • Mitarbeiter-Rabatte / Vergünstigungen

  • Flache Hierarchien & offene Kommunikation

  • Klare Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten, zum Beispiel zur Teamleitung

  • Wertschätzung, Teamgeist und gemeinsame Erfolgserlebnisse

  • Gute Erreichbarkeit & Parkplätze

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du berätst warme Leads, die bereits Interesse an hairfree gezeigt haben, und baust durch eine empathische und überzeugende Kommunikation Vertrauen auf.

  • Du erkennst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Interessent*innen und führst sie professionell bis zur verbindlichen Terminbuchung.

  • Du fasst offene Kontakte zuverlässig nach und stellst sicher, dass kein potenzieller Kunde verloren geht.

  • Du übernimmst die vertriebliche Verantwortung für deinen Standort und entwickelst ihn gemeinsam mit deinem Team erfolgreich weiter.

  • Du behältst Umsatzziele, Vertriebskennzahlen und die Auslastung des Standorts jederzeit im Blick und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab.

  • Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsalltag, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Vertriebsstandards eingehalten und Kundenanfragen schnell sowie verbindlich bearbeitet werden.

  • Du dokumentierst Gespräche, Termine und relevante Kundeninformationen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung und den anderen Standorten zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um Prozesse, Ergebnisse und die Kundenerfahrung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Und das Beste: Du wirst Schritt für Schritt eingearbeitet und erhältst regelmäßige Trainings, damit du sicher, professionell und erfolgreich in deine Rolle hineinwächst.



  • Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen und kannst durch deine offene, empathische Art schnell Vertrauen aufbauen.

  • Du bringst Interesse an Beauty, Haut, Ästhetik und dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ mit.

  • Du arbeitest gerne vertriebsorientiert und hast Spaß daran, Kund*innen zu beraten, zu überzeugen und zum Abschluss zu begleiten.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, professionell und wertschätzend – am Telefon, im persönlichen Gespräch und im Team.

  • Du bist zuverlässig, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Kontakten und Terminen den Überblick.

  • Du arbeitest zielorientiert, motiviert und hast Lust, dich fachlich sowie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, in der Kundenberatung, im Beauty-Bereich, in der Kosmetik oder im Dienstleistungsumfeld ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.

Auch Quereinsteiger (m/w/d) mit Verkaufstalent und Begeisterung für Beauty sind herzlich willkommen.

Warum hairfree?

Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Der Bewerbungsprozess ist bei uns unkompliziert und schnell. Du musst kein langes Anschreiben vorbereiten, ein kurzer Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Start völlig aus. Wir leiten deine Bewerbung dann direkt an unseren Franchise-Partner weiter, der sich anschließend bei dir melden wird.

Wenn du Fragen zur Position oder zum Team hast, melde dich jederzeit gerne direkt bei uns. Wir geben dir offen und ehrlich einen Einblick in die Rolle und unser Institut.

Wir melden uns zeitnah bei dir zurück.

title: Senior Scrum master
descriptionHtml:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

  • Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.


  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

  • PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

  • Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

  • Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

In this role, you will bring Frontline into new internal and customer projects, take ownership of technical integration, and build trust through technical excellence rather than project management. We support each other as a team and work closely across disciplines to achieve our mission.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20/23) with proven experience reading, debugging, and customizing production C++ codebases.
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating complex real-time distributed systems using technologies such as gRPC, Flatbuffers, WebSockets, MAVLink, or MAVSDK.
  • Demonstrated track record of deploying software solutions to external customers and collaborating with hardware teams during flight tests and platform integrations.
  • Willingness to travel regularly within Germany (up to 40%).

NICE TO HAVE

title: Senior Software Engineer (Nova Core)
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Senior Software Engineer (Nova Core) will design, build, and operate the backend services and platform foundations that enable reliable, secure, and maintainable C2 operations across Nova Cloud deployments. This role focuses on the Nova Core “inner loop”: service architecture, APIs, data models, persistence, authn/authz, observability, and developer experience that other Nova modules and product teams depend on.

What you’ll do

• Own and ship critical Nova Core backend services (e.g., common APIs, configuration service, tenant/environment lifecycle, shared domain libraries).

• Design stable, backward-compatible API contracts (schemas, versioning, deprecation/migration playbooks) to protect dependent services and teams. • Build and evolve data models and persistence layers, including schema evolution, migrations, correctness guarantees, and safe rollout strategies.

• Establish production-grade operability: structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts; write and maintain runbooks.

• Improve reliability over time by reducing incident frequency and driving down MTTD/MTTR through instrumentation and post-incident improvements.

• Implement secure-by-default backend patterns (least privilege, secret management, audit events, policy hooks) and make them reusable across teams.

• Contribute to and enforce consistent RBAC/permissions and authorization checks across services and APIs.

• Add security-focused tests and CI/CD gates informed by threat modeling to reduce regressions.

• Build and maintain shared backend libraries/SDKs with strong documentation and examples to accelerate adoption and reduce duplicated work.

• Improve developer experience: faster local workflows, environment parity (e.g., dockerized deps, seeded data), and rapid test feedback.

• Strengthen test harnesses (contract tests, integration tests, performance baselines) to catch cross-service breakages earlier.

• Diagnose and fix high-impact performance bottlenecks (latency hot paths, caching, concurrency, DB query efficiency) and introduce pragmatic performance budgets.

• Refactor brittle areas and pay down targeted technical debt to improve maintainability and reduce operational risk.

• Communicate trade-offs clearly and collaborate effectively with dependent engineering and product teams.

What success looks like

• Core Nova services are delivered, adopted, and operated reliably with clear SLIs/SLOs and runbooks.

• Observability is strong enough that incidents are detected quickly and resolved faster over time (improving MTTD/MTTR).

• API versioning and compatibility practices reduce integration churn and prevent breaking changes for dependent teams.

• Security and access-control foundations (authn/authz, auditability, secret handling, least privilege) are consistently applied across Nova Core services.

• Shared contracts, libraries, and SDKs meaningfully reduce duplicated service work and accelerate delivery across Nova modules.

• CI/CD and release processes enable safer, more frequent deployments of core services.

• Performance and correctness improve measurably in critical workflows (latency, resource usage, query efficiency, failure handling).

• Technical debt is paid down in targeted areas, improving maintainability and reducing operational risk.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years building and operating production backend systems and services.

• Strong experience in API design, backend architecture, and evolving contracts safely over time.

• Solid data modeling and persistence experience (SQL and/or NoSQL), including migrations and schema evolution.

• Demonstrated operational ownership: observability, on-call readiness, incident response, and production debugging.

• Security-first backend engineering experience, including authn/authz patterns and audit/event design.

• Strong testing discipline (unit/integration/contract testing) and ability to build reliable systems under real-world constraints.

• Clear communication and cross-team collaboration skills; comfortable aligning stakeholders on architecture decisions.

Nice to have

• Experience building platform foundations for multi-service environments (shared libraries/SDKs, service templates, internal platforms).

• Experience with multi-tenant systems, tenant lifecycle management, and environment provisioning patterns.

• Experience with distributed systems reliability patterns (idempotency, retries, transactional workflows, consistency trade-offs).

• Experience with performance engineering (profiling, load testing, latency budgets) and cost-aware backend optimization.

• Experience in defence tech / C2/C4ISR / tactical systems, constrained deployments, or regulated/on-prem environments.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Relevance team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This technical leader is responsible for contributing to the technical direction and vision for our search capabilities, including design and implementation of new search features, enhancements to search functionality, and resolving bugs.   Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead initiatives within Elasticsearch to produce an industry-leading search engine offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.
  • Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you'll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you'll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.
  • Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the vector search capabilities of Elasticsearch.
  • Be an expert on Elasticsearch search relevance. You'll identify and drive improvements this area based on your questions and your instincts.
  • Work with community members from all over the world on issues and pull requests, sometimes triaging them and handing them off to other experts and sometimes handling them yourself.
  • Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!

What You Bring 

  • You have implemented novel techniques in vector similarity on a search platform with a large user base or progressed the field of academic research in vector similarity information retrieval.
  • Professional experience with search or vector databases, and you used HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries on search platforms at scale.
  • You have solid skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as other features like lambdas.
  • You work with a high level of autonomy and are able to take on projects and guide them from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with other engineers to develop needed components.
  • You're comfortable developing collaboratively. Giving and receiving feedback on code and approaches and APIs is hard! Bonus points if you've collaborated over the internet because that's harder. Double bonus points for asynchronous collaboration over the internet. That's even harder, but we do it anyway because it's the best way we know how to build software.
  • You've used several data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before.
  • You've worked with open source projects and are familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.
  • Experience with data storage technology.
  • You have experience designing, leading, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

Contract: Permanent
