Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

Kaluza runs the billing and payments engine behind some of the world's biggest energy retailers. Every bill sent and every payment collected across Kaluza's markets increasingly runs through one shared core platform, and GBPA exists to build and run that core, so foundational billing and payments capability gets built once and reused everywhere, rather than rebuilt separately for every new market or client relationship.

That matters because of where Kaluza is headed: as we grow into new markets and take on more of the world's largest energy retailers as clients, rebuilding core billing and payments capability separately for each one is slower, costlier, and more error-prone than building it once and configuring it at the edge. Getting this right directly shapes how fast Kaluza can bring new markets and clients onto the platform, and how reliable that platform is once they're on it.

We're also in the middle of reorganising how this part of the business works, moving from building billing and payments capability separately per area toward one shared global core that every area configures rather than rebuilds. Senior Engineering Managers across GBPA sit at the centre of that shift, each owning two domains rather than a single team.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead engineering across two GBPA domains through complex, ambiguous, cross-squad initiatives.

  • Own technical and product strategy across both domains simultaneously, rather than handing strategy off to a single team.

  • Diagnose systemic and organisational issues using deep domain knowledge, not just resolve team-level technical problems.

  • Manage cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Delivery, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmap and trade-offs.

  • Carry full people-leader ownership for both teams: goal-setting, performance and pay conversations, hiring and recruitment.

  • Operate in a high-integrity data domain (billing and payments) where reliability and reconciliation come before speed.


What you'll bring

Ideally you’ll have:

  • A proven track record leading engineering team(s) through complex, ambiguous, cross-squad initiatives — not single-team delivery.

  • Experience owning technical and product strategy across multiple domains or services simultaneously.

  • Track record of diagnosing systemic or organisational issues and resolving them with deep domain knowledge, not just fixing team-level technical problems.

  • Be a strong cross-functional stakeholder manager, working with Product, Delivery, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmap and trade-offs.

  • Have full people-leader experience: goal-setting, performance and pay conversations, hiring and recruitment for the team(s) you lead.

  • Be comfortable operating in a high-integrity data domain (billing or payments), where quality and reconciliation matter as much as delivery speed.

  • Demonstrable record of applying AI/LLMs to deliver customer impact, not just adopting AI tooling internally.

  • Demonstrable customer obsession and a working-backwards practice: start from the customer problem and ship the simplest solution that solves it, rather than the most sophisticated one available.

  • Have a track record of successfully navigating complex stakeholder and leadership dynamics, influencing the wider organisation beyond your direct scope to improve product quality and team experience.

What will set you apart: 

  • Direct experience in billing, payments, or API platform domains.

  • Experience operating a "global core, configurable edge" or multi-market platform model (one engine, configuration at the edge, no client-specific forks of core logic).

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers toward people-leadership roles.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Senior Specialist, Information Security
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

As an Information Security Senior Specialist, you will lead and scale major elements of our security governance in a regulated fintech environment. You’ll own complex, cross-functional GRC domains (e.g., ISMS/ISO 27001 at scale, regulatory readiness, enterprise technology risk, third-party risk for critical vendors, compliance in key partnerships), drive measurable improvement in control effectiveness, and act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

What you’ll do 

  • Information Security Operating Model & GRC Ownership: Own and evolve one or more GRC domains end-to-end (e.g., ISMS operations, BCM, risk governance), including strategy, annual plan, cadences, and success metrics. Drive control rationalization and proportionality: tighten controls for critical/regulated assets and streamline low-risk areas to ensure an efficient, risk-aligned posture.

  • Risk Management & Strategic Decision Support: Facilitate and challenge high-impact risk assessments (new products, major architectural changes, critical vendors), ensuring consistency and defensible rationale. Drive risk treatment at scale: align owners, negotiate timelines, track commitments, and escalate where residual risk remains above appetite.

  • Audit, Assurance & Continuous Control Testing: Lead complex audits and assessments end-to-end (multi-entity, regulator-facing), including readiness, walkthroughs, and remediation. Design and run a risk-based control testing program to identify weaknesses and drive durable remediation (process fixes, automation, tooling) while translating regulatory requirements into structured internal work programs.

  • Third-Party Risk & Critical Supplier Oversight: Set due diligence depth and ongoing monitoring requirements for critical suppliers (e.g., cloud, payments, identity, SaaS); partner with Procurement/Legal on security contract requirements to ensure enforceable obligations and measurable oversight across the supply chain.

  • Enablement & Leadership through Others: Mentor Specialists, Associates, and Senior Associates; set quality standards for documentation, evidence, and stakeholder engagement. Act as a “GRC translator” for engineering and operations teams, helping them implement requirements efficiently and consistently across the organization.

Who you are 

  • Typically 6–10 years of experience in information security GRC, audit/assurance, risk management, compliance, or adjacent security roles.
  • Proven track record leading audits/assessments and driving remediation across multiple teams and systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and DORA (and/or SOC 2 / PCI DSS / NIST) with ability to design controls, define evidence, and test effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of technology risk across cloud, IAM, SDLC governance, incident management, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, and third-party risk.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to produce executive-ready materials and auditor-facing narratives.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

descriptionHtml:

As a part of Sony Computer Entertainment, the Gaming, Developer & Future Technology Group (GDFT) is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.

Our Site Reliability Engineering team plays a significant role in delivering on the promise of a great cloud gaming experience to our customers. We do this by influencing design and operational decisions towards the overall stability of the gaming service. Our SREs focus on three main things: overall ownership of production, production code quality, and deployments. The successful candidate will be self-directed and able to participate in the way we make decisions at different levels.

We expect our SREs to have opinions on the state of our service and provide critical feedback during different phases of the operational lifecycle. We are engaged throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring the operational readiness and stability.

  • Be involved in creating High Level Designs (HLDs) for new products and platforms

  • Lead incident response and post-mortem activities within your assigned service team
  • Work with other Engineers in a cross-functional team to prioritise reliability improvements to address technical debt and toil
  • Contribute to code to improve reliability
  • Implement automation to reduce ongoing toil

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum of 5+ years working experience in Software Development and/or Linux Systems Administration role.
  • Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.

  • Configuration Management (ansible, saltstack, puppet, chef)

title: Software Engineer, Backend (BI Platform)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to join our London team. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

About the Team

The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.

We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the backend services, APIs and infrastructure our BI platforms run on. This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role: services and integrations, identity and access automation, observability, reliability and developer experience. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.

You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on

  • Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work

  • L'automatisation par l'IA pour simplifier la gestion de la paie et le suivi réglementaire : c'est dans la transformation des usages métiers que l'IA a le plus de potentiel, et le marché de la paie et du social, largement ignoré depuis plus d'une décennie, est un terrain d'innovation immense.

  • Une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, connectée à l'ensemble des outils métiers des cabinets, qui fluidifie les échanges entre les gestionnaires de paie et leurs clients.

  • Une gestion avancée des données pour offrir à plus long terme un conseil social à 360° sur l'ensemble des problématiques paie et social : budgétisation de la masse salariale, construction intelligente des grilles salariales, gestion contractuelle avancée, avantages salariés, mutuelle, etc.

L'objectif : développer le « Pennylane de la paie », une plateforme centrale de gestion paie et social pour les cabinets comptables et leurs clients TPE/PME.

  • Intérêt marqué pour les secteurs à forte composante métier

title: Software Engineering Internship Program (Summer 2027)
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the role 

Join Roku as an Engineering Intern, where your passion for technology and creativity will drive our success. We offer a paid 12-week internship, running from June to early September 2027. 

As an Engineering Intern, you’ll be assigned a scoped project with one of our engineering teams, working on real Roku products and platforms. We’ll match you to the team that best fits your skills and interests, so you may work on anything from user interfaces and embedded or platform software to automation, developer tooling and AI-powered workflows.  

Our teams work across a variety of languages and technologies and embrace GenAI-assisted development to boost productivity and quality. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Own a well-defined project that contributes to the success of your team. 
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code using modern languages, tools and engineering practices. 
  • Debug, test and profile your work, and document it so others can build on it. 
  • Collaborate with engineers and mentors, take part in code reviews, and share your progress and learnings. 

Apply if 

  • You are a penultimate-year student, or a final-year student planning to go on to a one-year master’s course. 
  • You hold a permanent right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates on a student visa. 
  • You are available for full-time work for the whole 12-week program, from June to early September in Manchester. 
  • You are keen to work with AI technologies and have previous experience building AI agents and automated workflows. 

We’re excited if you have 

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
  • Proficiency in one or more of C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript or similar languages, ideally with projects, open source or hackathon work beyond your coursework. 
  • A solid grounding in computer science fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, and operating systems or networking concepts. 
  • Hands-on experience using GenAI tools in your coursework, projects or personal work. 
  • Strong problem-solving and technical communication abilities. 
  • Proactive mindset with passion for continuous learning and fast iteration. 

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

Intitulé du posteSpa praticien(ne)

Rattachement hiérarchiqueDirection Générale

Missions principales

Réaliser principalement les massages et soins du corps du Spa Sothys, ainsi que les soins esthétiques du visage, en assurant un parcours client d’excellence ; contribuer à la satisfaction, à la fidélisation et à l’image de l’hôtel.

Responsabilités et tâches

Accueil et soins

  • Accueillir les clients avec chaleur, courtoisie et professionnalisme.
  • Réaliser principalement les massages et soins du corps, selon les protocoles Sothys.
  • Assurer également les soins esthétiques du visage grâce à une qualification en esthétique.
  • Préparer les cabines et l’espace d’accueil avant chaque prestation.

Hygiène et qualité

  • Maintenir le spa propre, rangé et conforme aux normes d’hygiène et de sécurité.

Vente et fidélisation

  • Promouvoir, conseiller et vendre les prestations et produits de soins.

  • Assurer la gestion des ventes en boutique.

Équipe et coordination

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe spa pour assurer un service fluide.
  • Communiquer avec la réception et les autres services pour coordonner les prestations.

title: Specialist Digital Tax (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die TXG - Tax Group ist eine moderne, wachstumsorientierte Steuerberatungsgruppe, die mittelständische Kanzleien in ganz Deutschland übernimmt und gemeinsam mit ihnen die Zukunft der Steuerberatung gestaltet. Unsere Kanzleien verbinden persönliche Betreuung vor Ort mit den Vorteilen eines starken Netzwerks und innovativer Technologien. Für TXG Leipzig-Süd | Müller & Sachse suchen wir deshalb einen engagierten Specialist Digital Tax (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

Aufgaben

  • Prozessanalyse und -optimierung: Aufnahme und Dokumentation bestehender Arbeitsabläufe in der Kanzlei; Identifikation von Schwachstellen und Engpässen.
  • Digitalisierungskonzepte entwickeln: Erarbeiten von Strategien, um manuelle Tätigkeiten durch digitale Lösungen zu ersetzen oder zu vereinfachen (z. B. Dokumentenmanagement, Workflow-Automatisierung).
  • Implementierung von Softwarelösungen: Einführung und Anpassung von Fachanwendungen (z. B. DATEV, ADDISON, elektronische Beleg-Verarbeitung); Schnittstellen zu Mandantensystemen einrichten.
  • Schulung und Support: Schulung der Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter im Umgang mit neuen Tools und Prozessen; Ansprechpartner/in bei Anwenderfragen und Problemen.
  • Projektkoordination: Planung, Steuerung und Dokumentation von Digitalisierungsprojekten; enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsleitung, IT-Dienstleistern und Mandanten.
  • Kontinuierliches Monitoring: Überwachung der implementierten Lösungen auf Effizienz und Funktionalität; fortlaufende Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung/Studium: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Steuerfachangestellte/r, Kaufmann/-frau für Büromanagement) oder ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft mit Schwerpunkt Digitalisierung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Berufserfahrung: Praktische Erfahrung im Prozessmanagement und/oder in der Einführung digitaler Lösungen – idealerweise in einer Steuerkanzlei oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.
  • Fachkenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit Kanzleisoftware (DATEV, ADDISON oder ähnliche Systeme) sowie grundlegendes Verständnis von IT-Infrastrukturen (Netzwerke, Cloud-Lösungen). Erfahrung mit Dokumentenmanagement-Systemen und digitalen Workflows ist von Vorteil.
  • Methodenkompetenz: Kenntnisse in Prozessmodellierung (BPMN, Flowcharts) und Projektmanagement-Tools (z. B. Trello, Jira, MS Project).
  • Arbeitsweise: Analytisches Denken, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen und eine hohe Serviceorientierung – sowohl intern gegenüber Kollegen als auch extern gegenüber Mandanten und Dienstleistern. Teamfähigkeit und ein sicheres Auftreten runden Ihr Profil ab.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Vier Tage pro Woche vor Ort im Büro in Aurich und ein Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche – für eine optimale Work-Life-Balance.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Leistungsgerechte Bezahlung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Verantwortung entspricht.
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einer etablierten, mittelständischen Kanzlei mit klarer Digitalisierungsstrategie.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz in zentraler Lage mit guter Verkehrsanbindung. Wir setzen durchgängig auf digitale Arbeitsprozesse und zeitgemäße Technik.
  • Kollegiales Betriebsklima: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein teamorientiertes Miteinander, in dem gegenseitige Unterstützung und Wertschätzung selbstverständlich sind.
  • Weiterbildung & Entwicklung: Unterstützung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Schulungen, externe Workshops und Zertifizierungen (z. B. Prozessmanagement, IT-Zertifikate).
  • Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Verantwortungsvolle Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf die Effizienz unserer Kanzlei und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mandanten.

Wenn Sie sich in dieser anspruchsvollen und abwechslungsreichen Aufgabe wiedererkennen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe Ihres frühestm.glichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible)
descriptionHtml:
Et si ton expertise comptable devenait un véritable levier pour aider les entrepreneurs et les cabinets à mieux piloter leur activité ?

Chez Pennylane, nous construisons le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PME européennes. Notre plateforme aide les entrepreneurs à gagner du temps sur les tâches comptables et financières, et permet aux cabinets d’expertise-comptable de se concentrer davantage sur le conseil et l’accompagnement de leurs clients.

Aujourd’hui, nous recrutons une personne ayant exercé comme collaborateur ou collaboratrice comptable en cabinet, et souhaitant mettre son expertise métier au service de l’accompagnement de nos utilisateurs. Ta connaissance de la comptabilité et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de comprendre rapidement leurs problématiques, de leur apporter des réponses adaptées et de les aider à tirer pleinement parti de Pennylane.

🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ?

Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible

🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

🎯 Ton rôle

Tu rejoins l’équipe Support applicatif et technique en tant qu’expert métier et plateforme.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié des dirigeants, des comptables internalisés et des cabinets d’expertise-comptable qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur comptabilité et leurs finances.

Au quotidien, tu analyses leurs problématiques, les accompagnes dans la résolution de leurs demandes et les aides à tirer pleinement parti de la plateforme. Tu contribues également à l’amélioration du produit en faisant remonter des retours structurés aux équipes internes.

📋 Tes missions

Support et résolution de problèmes

  • Réceptionner, qualifier et analyser les demandes des utilisateurs

  • Comprendre leur problématique et leur contexte métier

  • Apporter des réponses claires, pédagogiques et adaptées

  • Assurer le suivi des tickets jusqu’à leur résolution complète

  • Escalader les sujets complexes aux équipes techniques ou produit

  • Garantir un haut niveau de qualité de service

Accompagnement des migrations

  • Aider les comptables en entreprise et en cabinet à intégrer leurs données dans Pennylane

  • Comprendre les enjeux liés à la migration depuis un autre logiciel comptable

  • Identifier les éventuelles difficultés et coordonner leur résolution

  • Participer à l’amélioration des processus et de la documentation associés

Amélioration continue et partage d’expertise

  • Créer et mettre à jour les supports d’aide destinés aux utilisateurs

  • Identifier les questions récurrentes et favoriser l’autonomie des clients

  • Partager tes connaissances comptables avec l’équipe

  • Faire remonter les irritants et les besoins aux équipes produit

  • Proposer des améliorations sur les process et les outils internes

🚀 Tes premiers mois chez Pennylane

 

  • Tu te formes sur le produit et les process de l’équipe

  • Tu découvres l’entreprise, sa vision et ses différents départements

  • Tu apprends à identifier les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement

  • Tu commences à traiter des demandes liées à la comptabilité

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends en charge tes demandes de bout en bout

  • Tu traites des problématiques de plus en plus complexes

  • Tu contribues aux supports d’aide et au partage de connaissances

  • Tu deviens un relais de la voix du client auprès des équipes produit

Et ensuite

Tu deviens progressivement un expert produit et métier, capable d’identifier les axes d’amélioration et de porter des projets. Des évolutions vers des sujets Support plus complexes, la gestion de comptes ou la mise en œuvre de Pennylane sont également possibles.

🙋 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Formation comptable : BTS CGO, DCG, BTS Assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Bachelor Responsable administratif et comptable, Master CCA ou équivalent

  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience en cabinet d’expertise-comptable

  • Idéalement, au moins trois périodes fiscales réalisées

  • Une expérience en contact direct avec des dirigeants est un plus

  • Solides connaissances des principes comptables et de la réalité des cabinets

  • Appétence pour les outils numériques et les nouvelles technologies

  • Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à résoudre des problèmes

  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogie

  • Sens du service et aisance dans la relation client

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe et à s’adapter rapidement

  • Envie d’apprendre et de suivre les évolutions du produit

  • Anglais professionnel (compréhension écrite, orale et expression écrite)

  • La connaissance de Pennylane est un plus

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange avec un recruteur, 30 minutes

  2. Un entretien et un cas pratique avec un membre de l'équipe, 1 heure

  3. Un entretien final avec la manager d'équipe, 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t’offrir

  • Une mutuelle Alan Blue et Alan Mind

  • Des tickets restaurant via Swile

  • Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

  • Un budget mensuel pour travailler depuis chez toi ou dans un espace de coworking

  • Des bureaux situés à quelques minutes de Saint-Lazare, à Paris

  • Une enveloppe de BSPCE

  • Un accès à 8 000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités bien-être via Gymlib

  • Un Mac

  • Un accès à Busuu pour perfectionner ton anglais

  • Des Tech Days tous les 3 mois et un séminaire annuel

  • Des activités sportives et des événements réguliers entre collègues

🌱 Pour t’épanouir chez Pennylane

  • Tu apprécies évoluer dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Tu fais de la collaboration une priorité

  • Tu sais prendre du recul et prioriser les actions à fort impact

  • Tu es à l’aise avec l’idée d’apprendre et d’améliorer continuellement tes pratiques

  • Tu peux travailler en anglais, selon les exigences du poste

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. Les parcours les plus intéressants ne sont pas toujours linéaires. Ce qui compte, c’est ta trajectoire, ton expertise, ta façon de réfléchir et ton envie de contribuer.

🔒 Information importante à destination des candidats

Les candidatures doivent être envoyées uniquement via nos canaux officiels, notamment notre site carrière et les pages officielles de nos partenaires.

Nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles se terminant par ----- ou ----- style="min-height:1.5em">Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement ni d’informations financières dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est adressée, ne répondez pas et signalez-la-nous immédiatement.

Pennylane encourage la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sous toutes leurs formes. Nous offrons un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux comme à distance.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

  

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert des services financiers et du compte professionnel.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.

Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :

  • à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ;

  • au dépôt de capital ;

  • à l’encaissement de leurs clients ;

  • aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ;

  • au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers.

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne.

Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients.

Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers.

Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Lorsque cela est nécessaire, tu transmets la demande aux équipes internes ou aux partenaires concernés et assures son suivi jusqu’à sa résolution.

Au quotidien, tu :

  • échanges avec les clients dirigeants et leurs équipes ;

  • comprends et qualifies leurs demandes ;

  • les accompagnes sur les sujets liés au compte professionnel, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement ;

  • interagis avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les demandes et opérations liées aux services financiers ;

  • coordonnes les échanges entre les clients, les équipes internes et les partenaires concernés ;

  • analyses les situations et identifies les prochaines étapes ;

  • apportes une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée ;

  • formalises les informations utiles au traitement des dossiers ;

  • assures le suivi de chaque demande jusqu’à sa résolution ;

  • veilles à maintenir une communication claire avec le client à chaque étape.

Tu traites les demandes en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et tu collabores avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

Au démarrage :

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur Pennylane et ses services financiers.

  • Tu développes tes connaissances sur le compte professionnel, le dépôt de capital, l’encaissement et les moyens de paiement.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu’avec les différents départements.

  • Tu te familiarises avec notre réseau de partenaires bancaires et les interactions liées aux différents services financiers.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu commences à traiter les demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

Après quelques mois :

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends progressivement en charge ton portefeuille de demandes.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes concernant les comptes professionnels, les dépôts de capital et les encaissements.

  • Tu analyses les demandes, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches la solution la plus adaptée.

  • Tu échanges directement avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement.

  • Tu assures la coordination et le suivi des demandes nécessitant l’intervention de plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu formalises les éléments utiles au traitement des dossiers et à leur résolution.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages avec tes collègues tes connaissances et ton expérience de terrain.

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes internes des retours construits.

  • Tu contribues à fluidifier les échanges entre Pennylane, les clients et notre réseau de partenaires bancaires.

 

Et ensuite...

  • Tu deviens une personne référente sur les services financiers et le compte professionnel.

  • Tu aides ton équipe à gagner en efficacité en identifiant les axes d’amélioration.

  • Tu contribues à des projets liés à l’amélioration de l’expérience client et des processus financiers.

  • Tu portes la voix des clients auprès des équipes Produit et Opérations.

  • Tu participes à l’amélioration continue de l’accompagnement des clients germanophones.

  • Tu contribues à renforcer la qualité des échanges avec nos partenaires bancaires.

 

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu apprécies les échanges avec des partenaires externes et sais maintenir une communication professionnelle et efficace.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

 

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo, Senior Recruiter : 30 minutes

  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert, Responsable de l’équipe : 1 heure

  • Test pratique en allemand : lecture d’un message client et rédaction d’une réponse

  • Dernier échange en visio avec Nathan Robinet, Senior Team Lead Customer Support, Financial Services : 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating/collecting, licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured data that is both self-sourced and from third party content providers. The team reports to the Chief Content Officer and has strategy, product management content, collection operations, and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing rapid growth across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust, and accountability in our relationships within the team and with external partners and internal stakeholders.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a Sr. Product Manager to oversee our M&A Transactions and Valuations content. Candidates should have deep knowledge of the fundamentals of capital markets and investment research combined with extensive experience of managing 3rd party or proprietary M&A Transactions content feeding into financial research platforms and investment analysis workflow functionality. 

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience working in Product, Content, Operations, or equivalent roles at a financial institution, investment research platform, or market intelligence firm, focused on the delivery of content, features, analytics, and models for front-office investment professionals
  • 3+ years of experience managing or working closely with a globally distributed content generation operation
  • Expert knowledge of various market data and investment research databases, products, and tools (e.g.: Fundamentals, Estimates, M&A Transactions data, Ownership data, Market data, Excel plug-in, XML feeds)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a dedicated cross-functional development team of engineers, data experts, QA, scrum master
  • Thorough understanding of the logic and concepts of relational databases (eg: SQL); demonstrated experience using them is strongly preferred
  • BSc, MSc, or MBA degree with a concentration in finance or economics or a CFA certification 
  • Demonstrated passion for corporate finance, capital markets, financial analysis, and modeling demonstrated either in previous capacity in a buy-side or sell-side analyst role or have managed products/features/data used by investment professionals
  • You have a natural enthusiasm for working at the intersection of data, technology, and finance
  • You thrive in a builder’s role - you have designed, built, launched and managed a marquee product, module, or functionality for the investment community or have set the foundation and successfully run an extensive content generation operation
  • You excel at aligning diverse, cross-functional teams through clear, persuasive communication and executive-level presentations
  • You demonstrate empathic communication, with the ability to listen and identify problems in need for solutions
  • You’re highly analytical, tech-savvy, and meticulous, with a strong ability to set priorities, manage deadlines, and deliver results
  • Material experience in the financial industry as a front office professional (e.g. research analyst or investment banker) leveraging platforms and and content similar to AlphaSense’s is preferred
  • Prior experience at a market intelligence or financial research SaaS start-up is preferred
  • Experience using iterative / agile development methodologies is preferred
  • Experience working with distributed teams is preferred

Responsibilities:

The role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities and outcomes: 

  • Identify the Need: Understand the market and use cases of various AlphaSense user personas. Collaborate with Sales and Clients/Users to solicit feedback for new content and functionality or enhancement needs
  • Define the Roadmap: Create and manage a content roadmap by working with the content organization leadership, engineering, and operations stakeholders to plan and optimize costs, benefits, timelines, and technology personpower mix for all aspects of content 3rd party sourcing or in-house generation
  • Own the Content Life-cycle: Take ownership of key projects to evaluate and integrate third party or self-source proprietary datasets and their related features from initial research and definition to testing, delivery, feedback, and on-going enhancements.
  • Own the Content Generation Process: Lead the collaboration between content engineering and operations in designing the end-to-end data collection process including building and maintaining taxonomies and optimizing for the best mix of technology (speed, automation) and personpower (expert interpretation of reporting, exception handling), integrity checks, and QA process
  • Launch the Content: Contribute to the successful launch of new features into the market, including the creation of internal and external comms/announcements, marketing collateral, documentation, training material, and client engagement
  • Own Content Collection Policies: Be the ultimate owner of content collection methodologies, rules and policies. Establish and maintain the balance between inbound expert user feedback on one hand, and process or technology/personpower limitations on the other
  • Industry and Competitive Intelligence: Track industry trends and deliver competitive intelligence to better evolve product and content vision. Analyze other relevant competing content sets in the market and interact with customers to understand their workflows and pain points and gather and document actionable feedback 

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

Senior AI Engineer - Security

Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Technology adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today's workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they've learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe's first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren't stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We're building a world where tech skills unlock people's potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Agentic Work Environment team

The Agentic Work Environment (AWE) owns the environment everyone at Multiverse works in, wherever they are in the world. That covers the devices, workplace tools and accounts colleagues use every day, the platform our product is built and run on, and the identity and access that decide who, or which agent, can do what across all of it. Product teams own what they build; we own the ground it stands on, the path it takes to production, and the baseline standards it meets on the way. Our mission is to make the safe way the fast way for every colleague and the agents they put to work.

For a security-minded AI engineer, that remit runs in two directions. In the product platform, you build security into the path itself: review agents that check every change against our baseline standards, one identity for customers, staff and agents, and detection and response through our SIEM and SOAR, so nobody, person or agent, has to remember to be secure. In the workplace, you secure the devices, tools and accounts colleagues around the world rely on. As more of them put agents to work, whatever their job title, you make sure every agent has its own identity, a named owner, scoped access and evals, so autonomy is earned on evidence rather than granted on trust.

What your day-to-day will look like

Every day will be different, but you can expect it to include:

Build security into the path to production. You turn our baseline standards into checks that run on every change: policy as code, review agents that check each change against the baseline and a team's own standards, and gates matched to the risk of what's changing. Staying on the path should meet the security requirements without any extra work.

Secure the agents we and our colleagues build. You threat-model agent systems end to end, from prompt injection and tool misuse to data leaking through context and retrieval, and design the controls that stop it: scoped tool permissions, permission-aware retrieval, sandboxing, and human approval where the risk calls for it.

Give every agent an identity. You build the identity and access layer for agents. Each one has its own identity, a named owner, least-privilege access that is reviewed and can be revoked at once, and a full record of what it did.

Build detection and response with agents. You write detections and automated responses on our SIEM and SOAR, and build agents that triage alerts, gather context and carry out bounded, reversible responses, so people spend their time on the cases that need judgement.

Secure the workplace, worldwide. You apply the same approach to the devices, workplace tools and accounts colleagues use every day: automated controls rather than manual checklists, and access that is granted and removed as people join, move and leave.

Prove it holds with security evals. You build eval pipelines and red-team exercises that show whether our agents and controls stand up to attack, and produce compliance evidence as a by-product of the work rather than as screenshots for an auditor.

Influence technical direction. You have opinions about how things should be built, and you back them up with evidence. You contribute to architectural decisions, push back when the team is heading in the wrong direction, and propose better approaches.

What We Are Looking For

  • Security Engineering: You have built security into systems rather than reviewed it after the fact, across some mix of application and cloud security, identity and access, and detection and response. You understand how AI systems get attacked, through prompt injection, tool misuse and data leaking through context, and you design controls that make the secure option the easy one for the people using them

  • Production AI Agent Engineering: You have shipped AI systems that serve real users at scale. In this role, you will focus on building systems that ingest, process, and organise massive volumes of data into efficient, queryable structures. You will work primarily on offline and nearline pipelines, ensuring that data is fresh, complete, and efficiently accessible by downstream retrieval systems. You will operate in an environment where throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical; designing systems capable of handling tens of gigabytes per second across continuously evolving datasets.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines that sit at the core of our search infrastructure
  • Develop and optimise indexing strategies balancing performance, freshness, and resource efficiency
  • Work on storage formats, compaction strategies, and update mechanisms to keep data accessible and current
  • Ensure reliability and predictability of pipelines under high-throughput conditions
  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interaction contracts, while remaining flexible as the system evolves
  • Define and implement observability primitives, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals across offline and nearline pipelines
  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations when business needs require it
  • Collaborate with runtime and ML teams to ensure indexing outputs meet retrieval and ranking requirements
  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and data processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals

You may be a good fit if you:

  • 8+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems
  • Strong Go experience (C++/Rust is a plus)
  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems (10+ GiB/sec throughput, petabyte-scale datasets, etc.)
  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability
  • Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents
  • Systems-thinking mindset and ability to reason about end-to-end data flows

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • Distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark, Flink, MapReduce, or Beam
  • Content systems including, scraping, proxying, or anti-bot infrastructure
  • Ad tech, social networks, or other large-scale content platforms
  • DBMS internals (open source or SaaS) and cloud infrastructure
  • Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community
  • Competitive programming or CTF participation (ICPC, IOI, or similar)
  • SHAD or similar advanced technical programmes
  • Conference talks or technical publications

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
